mi rtog pa snang med spros bral gyi cha ni de'i 'od gsal dang*/ lha sku dang bde ba 'tshogs shing de nyid stong pas rgyas thebs pa ni skabs de'i zung 'jug go /de rnams thams cad kyang bskyed rim mam/ lus dben mtshan nyid pa yin kyang*/ ngag dben la sogs pa lnga btags pa'o/ /de bzhin du ngag dben gyi rim pa'i lha sku tsam lus dben dang*/ rlung gi rnal 'byor dngos ngag dben dang*/ snang ba gsum sems dben dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu sgyu lus dang*/ lhan skyes spros bral gyi rnam pa 'od gsal dang*/ de rnams gcig tu 'tshogs pa zung 'jug ste/ de'i ngag dben ni dngos dang*/ yon tan yar ldan yin pas lus dben yang lus dben dngos so/ /sems dben la sogs pa rnams btags pa ba yin par shes bya'o/ des gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre ste/ des na btags pa ba de rnams kyang dngos kyi rgyu'am gzhi 'dings pa yin la/ de bas na las dang po dmigs pa gsal 'debs lugs dang*/ rmi lam 'od gsal bar do la sogs pa'i gdams pa mtha' yas pa de dag sems dben dang bden pa gnyis la sogs pa'i ye shes dngos min kyang der 'jug pa'i thabs bla na med pa'o/ /de'i phyir zung 'jug gi rim pa'i sku lus dben/ gsung ngag dben/ thugs sems dben/ sgyu ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cha nas sgyu lus/ bde chen spros bral gyi cha nas 'od gsal/ thams cad mnyam nyid kyi cha nas zung 'jug yin te/ drug kar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yang yin la/ zung 'jug kho na yang yin no/ /des na zung 'jug dang zung 'jug gi rim pa la khyad par med kyang*/ lus dben nas 'od gsal gyi bar la de dang de'i rim pa lnga po dang*/ de dag lnga po la khyab che chung yod pa shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa yan lag drug gi dbye ba ni/ rgyud phyi ma las/ bsnyen pa yan lag drug tu ni/ /byas nas mchog tu bsgrub par bya/ /gzhan dag gis ni bsgrubs gyur na/ /dngos grub mchog tu mi 'gyur ro/

/so so'i sdud dang bsam gtan dang*/ /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*/ /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin rnams/ /sbyor ba'i yan lag drug ces bya/ /dbang po bcu po rnams kyis kyang*/ /rang gi 'jug gnas thams cad du/ /'dod pa so sor sdud pas na/ so sor sdud pa zhes bshad do/ /'dod pa lnga ni mdor bsdus nas/ /sangs rgyas lnga ru sbyor ba yis/ /brtag pa bsam gtan zhes bshad de/ /bsam gtan de ni rnam lngar 'gyur/ /rtog dang dpyod dang dga' ba dang*/ /de bzhin bde ba nyid dang yang*/ /sems kyi rtse gcig nyid dag ste/ lnga po der ni bsam gtan bsdu/ /gsang ba'i rgyud ni thams cad du*/ /rnam pa du ma yongs bshad pa/ / gsang ba gsum byung rtog pa ste/ /de yi longs spyod dpyod pa'o/ /dga' la reg pa gsum pa ste/ /bde bas bsdus pa bzhi pa'o/ /shes dang shes bya byung zad pa'i/ /rang sems lnga par shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bzhi pa ni/ / 'dod pa kun la rab tu gnas/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs/ /'byung ba lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /gong bu'i gzugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /sna yi rtse mor rab tu brtag/rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa/ /srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad/ /rang sngags snying gar bsams nas ni/ /srog ni thig ler gyur pa bzhag/rang dbang rin chen dgag pa yi/ /gzung ba 'dzin pa yin par bshad/ /sems ni 'gog pa'i rdo rjer 'gyur/ /mtshan ma nyer 'dzin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma'i khams ni rnam pa lngar/ /byang chub rdo rjes gsungs pa yin*/ /smig sgyu 'dra ba dang po ste/ /du ba lta bu gnyis pa yin/ /mkha' snang 'dra ba gsum pa ste/ /mar me ltar 'bar bzhi pa'o/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bur ni/ /rtag tu snang ba lnga pa'o/ /brtan gyur rdo rje'i lam nas ni/ /nam mkha'i khams su spro bar bya/ / rjes dran gang zhig rnam bsgom pa/ /de dang 'dra ba spro bar bya/ /rjes su dran pa zhes bshad de/

/so sor snang ba de las skye/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pas/ /dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus pa/ /gong bu'i tshul gyis bsdus nas ni/ /dbus su gzugs ni rnam par bsgom/ /yud kyis ye shes rdzogs byed pa/ /ting nge 'dzin zhes btags pa yin/ /zhes pa ste/ sgron gsal 'gos 'gyur du lung drangs pa bzhin bris pa'o/ / de la rgyud phyi ma las bshad pa'i yan lag drug po 'di ni/ dus 'khor gyi lugs de nyid 'di'i tshig don la yang shin tu 'byor bar yod do/ / 'on kyang 'dir ni sgron gsal ltar bshad na/ rnam grangs kyi sgo nas cung zad mi 'dra yang*/ gnad ni sems 'grel skor gsum dang gcig par mthong ngo*/ 'on kyang 'di la rgya bod kyi 'phags skor ba rnams 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba shin tu mang zhing*/ phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig gis sgron gsal gyi lugs gtsang ma yin gsung nas sor sdud mnyam bzhag lus dben yin pas lha mi sgom pa dang*/ bsam gtan rjes thob lus dben lha sgom pa dang*/ 'dzin pa don gyi 'od gsal dang*/ rjes dran ni 'od gsal mthong lam las langs pa'i tshe/ 'bar snang lugs zlog tu 'byung ba dang ting nge 'dzin zung 'jug gi skur 'chad pa ni/ 'grel pa'i tshig rigs la 'grel rung yod kyang*/ sems dben dang*/ sgyu lus ma tshang bas mchog gi bsnyen pa ma rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin dus mnyam du song bas mchog dman med par thal ba dang*/ lus dben gyi mnyam gzhag rjes thob ngos ma zin pa sogs lugs 'di la yang mi 'thad pa du ma yod do/ des na rang lugs 'di ltar bya ste/ sor sdud ni/ lus dben gyi thog ma'i cha la/ gzhi lus tsam ma gtogs snang ba thams cad lha skur 'char mi thub pas mnyam gzhag gzhi lus kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rjes thob dbang yul thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa'i bde bas rgyas btab cing ma bkag par bsten pas/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes la gzugs sogs mchog dman 'bring gsum dang mthun pa'i bde ba'i snang ba shar ba de'o/

/'di la mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis kar yod do/ /bsam gtan ni lus dben gyi rim pa'i phyed phyi ma la snang ba gang dang gang yin thams cad la bde ba dang lha skur 'char thub pa'i skabs te/ bde bas rgyas btab pa'i tshe tshur la bde ba 'phel ba'i grogs byed cing*/ lha sku sogs nyams kyi snang bas rgyas btab pa na/ der 'gyur ba ni sangs rgyas lngar sbyor ba'i don no/ /de'i tshe dbang yul shes pa gsum bde ba dang lhar snang du gyur pa ni rtog pa/ de'i rang bzhin stong par mos shing shes pa ni dpyod pa/ stong par myong la khad pas yid la bde ba ni dga' ba/ stong pa'i gsal snang myong bas lus la shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde pa skyes pa ni bde ba/ mnyam bzhag gi skabs der gnyis snang rags pa tsam 'gags pas rtse gcig pa ste/ bsam gtan la yang mnyam rjes gnyis kar yod do/ /'di dag tu thun mong ma yin pa'i zhu bde yang cung zad yod mod kyi bde ba na sems rtse gcig pa'i bde ba shas che'o/ /'on kyang 'di shin tu goms pa las snang gsum gyi ye shes gsal po skye bar bshad do/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin zhes sogs srog rtsol gyi yan lag ste ngag rnam par dben pa yin la/ tshig 'di gzhung gi dkyus la yod pas 'og tu 'chad do/ /rang dbang rin chen sogs 'dzin pa ste/ sems rnam par dben pa yin no/ /de la rang ste yul lnga dang dbang po lnga dgag pa ni rags pa thim pa'o/ /rin chen dgag pa ni rnam rtog rlung dang bcas pa thim pa'o/ /sems 'gog pa'i rdo rje ni/ sems skad cig bzhi pa'i 'od gsal du thim par byed pa ste/ smig sgyu du ba mkha' snang mar me rnams sngon du song nas/ sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'i rtags la snang ba bzhi po 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i lam rtags lnga'i rim pas/ nam mkha'i khams 'od gsal gyi snang bas chos thams cad la stong nyid kyi ye shes spro bar bshad do/ /'dir 'grel pa las/

yang dag pa'i mtha' dang mya ngan las 'das pa zhes sogs bshad pas/ don gyi 'od gsal yin no snyam na ma nges te/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang mya ngan las 'das pa dngos kyi dbang du byas na/ rim pa bzhi pa don gyi 'od gsal tsam la'ang mi rung ste/ yang dag mtha' dang myang 'das zhes pa/ yul chos dbyings dngos dang*/ yul can rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos sku kho na la 'chad dgos kyi/ shes sgrib kyi phyin ci log mang pos bsgribs shing*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i skye ba sogs yod pas/ mthong lam tsam yang dag pa'i mtha' dang myang 'das su mi 'gyur ro/ /des de rtogs pa yin pas lam dus kyi de dang de yin no snyam na/ 'dir yang mtshungs te des na rjes mthun pa la de dang de'i ming bzhag pa shin tu mang ba'i phyir/ sems dben gyi nyer thob skad cig ma bzhi pa la yang dag pa'i mtha' dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i ming gis btags pa ste/ 'dis yang dag pa'i mtha' rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi tshul gyis ma rtogs kyang nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas gsal bar mtshon nus pa yin no/ /rjes dran gang zhig sogs rjes dran gyi yan lag ste 'di ni sgyu lus kyi rim pa'o/ /de yang thog mar sems dben gyi 'od gsal la ji ltar zhugs pa'i rim pa rnams de dang 'dra ba las lugs zlog gi tshul du bsgyur te/ snang gsum dang rtags bzhi lugs zlog tu 'byung ba las sgyu lus kyi lha sku'i dkyil 'khor rtsa ba dang yan lag dpag tu med pa spro ba'o/ /de nas sgyu lus kyi rim pa mthar phyin phyin gyi bar du sngar gyi rim pas dpe'i 'od gsal du 'jug pa sngon 'gror btang nas/ de las langs te sgyu lus su spro ba/ dngos gzhi'i tshul du sgom pa'i rim pa de yang yang sbyangs pa'i lhar snang gong 'phel du 'gro ba ni/ rjes dran gyi yan lag ste/ rjes dran bcu drug gi skabs las sangs rgyas rjes dran la sogs pa rjes dran gyi yan lag tu sbyor rgyu rnams kyang skabs 'dir 'grig ste/

sbyang bya sna tshogs pa sbyong ba'i don du rnam pa mi 'dra ba yang yang sgom pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ni/ thabs dang sogs te/ thabs sgyu lus dang*/ shes rab 'od gsal mnyam par 'jug pa ni/ sgyu lus kyi snang ba 'od gsal bde stong du 'jug pa yin la/ dngos po thams cad gong bu'i tshul du bsdus pa ni/ bsam gtan gnyis la brten nas snod bcud thams cad bde chen gcig tu bsdu ba'o/ /de nas de las zung 'jug dang 'dra ba'i lha sku yud tsam gyis ldang ba ni/ sgyu lus dang 'od gsal gyi rim pa gnyis po sgom don gyi rim pa 'dra yang*/ khyad par ni sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i skabs 'od gsal du 'jug pa sngon 'gro'i tshul gyi yun thung bar byed cing*/ lhar snang du spro ba dngos gzhi'i tshul gyi yun ring du sgom pa yin la/ 'dir ni 'od gsal du bcug nas bde stong sgom pa dngos gzhi'i tshul gyi yun ring du mnyam par bzhag nas/ lhar snang spro ba rjes kyi tshul du yun thung bar bsgom pa'i khyad par yin no/ /de ltar tshul 'di nyid yang nas yang du goms par byas pas/ mthar mngon par byang chub pa'i dbang bskur la brten te/ don gyi 'od gsal rtogs nas zung 'jug tu 'gyur pa yin mod kyi/ zung 'jug ni mchog gi dngos grub yin pas bsgrub bya 'bras bur bsdu zhing*/ yan lag drug ni de sgrub byed kyi bsnyen pa'o/ /bdun pa rnal 'byor gsum gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lung sgron gsal du drangs pa/ rnal 'byor gsum du shes bya ste/ byin gyis rlabs dang yongs brtags dang*/ /gzugs nyid yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ /rnal 'byor sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /sngags kyis byin rlabs nga rgyal bskyed/ /rnal 'byor byin rlabs yin par gsungs/ /byang chub sems ni dag pa dang*/ /gsang sngags sa bon skye ba che/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs su brtags pa yi/

/rim gyis gzugs ni rdzogs byas pa/ /de ni brtags par brjod pa ste/ /rnal 'byor cho ga yin par gsungs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ /spro dang bsdu ba byed pa po/ /yud kyis ye shes rdzogs pa ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do/ /zhes yongs su brtags pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor te gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sa bon phyag mtshan la sogs pa'i rim pas zhal phyag can gyi lha sku rdzogs par bskyed pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi lha'i rnal 'byor dngos dang*/ yig 'bru thig le 'od zer spro bsdu sogs la dmigs pa'i mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim du grags pa rnams kyang bde ba bskyed pa'i cha nas lha'i 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /sngags bde stong gis byin gyis brlabs pa las skad cig gis bskyed pa/ zhal phyag can gyi lha lus dben dang*/ rlung sngags dbyer med dang*/ sems dben gyi bde ba sogs ma brtags par skad cig skad cig la grub pa zhal phyag spangs pa'o/ /gsum pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ zhal phyag dang ldan pa sgyu lus zung 'jug dang*/ zhal phyag spangs pa 'od gsal bde chen te lha'i rnal 'byor gsum du rim pa lnga car 'dus pa'o// //gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ mdor byas las 'byung ba ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor bshad/ spyod bsdus las 'byung ba ltar lus rnam par dben pa bshad/ gzhung 'di nyid kyi tshig don dang 'brel ba rnams rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la dang po ni/ 'di skad du/ bskyed pa'i rim pas ma smin pa la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes skye ba yod dam med ce na/ spyir yod pa ni yin te/ sgron gsal las kyang/ de bzhin du 'tshams med pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba spyad pa rnams kyi dbang du byas nas/ de rnams kyang 'dir bla ma'i drin gyis rdzogs pa'i rim pa thob nas 'grub par 'gyur zhing/

sangs rgyas nyid thob par 'gyur na rigs ngan la sogs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes 'byung ste/ dbang po rnon po zhig las kyi sgrib pa chen po byas kyang*/ rdzogs rim kho nas sbyong thub par gsungs na/ las kyi sgrib pa chen po dang mi ldan pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ yang ci ste bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa sngon song gi rdzogs rim thob pas sbyong ba yin na ni/ rin pa gnyis kyi ye shes zhes brjod dgos te/ rdzogs rim gyis sbyong ngo zhes pa mi mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /de lta na yang da lta'i gang zag phal gyi dbang du byas na/ skas kyi gdang bu'i dpe ltar rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye ba la/ bskyed rim bsgom pa sngon du 'gro ba'am/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi sgrub pa gnyis ka cha mnyam du bsgom pas/ thog mar bskyed rim dang thun mong gi yon tan rnams shar/ de rjes rdzogs rim gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan skye ba yang yod do/ /de yang bsnyen pa'i rim pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i rim pa dang*/ sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa la brten nas/ bskyed rim dang de'i 'bras bu rnams mngon du byed pa yin no/ /de la bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi rnal 'byor yin te/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u brgyad pa las/ /gal te 'gal ba yod pa ma yin yang*/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i dngos po sbyang ba yod/ /kun rdzob bden par yang dag gnas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis chos tsam rnam par bsgom/ zhes dang*/ le'u bcu bzhi pa las/ phal ba'i gnas skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sgom pa yang dag rab tu bsgrags/ /rang bzhin gnas skabs thob pa'i phyir/ /sgom pa yang ni sgom pa min/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rtogs pa de bzhin te/ 'on kyang mi gtsang ba'i tshad mnyam par sbyang pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gzugs bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ phal ba'i gnas skabs ces pa/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog ste/

snod bcud rnams yul dus nges pa sogs rang rang gi mtshan ma can 'dres shing 'gal bar 'dzin pa dang*/ de nyid kyi phyir rang gi rang bzhin 'di la mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ma yin par mngon par zhen pa nyid do/ /de'i gnyen por bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yang*/ ma dag pa'i dngos por zhen pa'i gnyen por stong pa nyid dang lha snang gnyis kar sgom pa yin la/ dkyil 'khor ma yin par zhen pa'i gnyen por dkyil 'khor nyid sgom pa yin no/ /'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog rtsa ba nas drung 'byin par nus pa'i 'gal ba can gyi gnyen po de 'dra min yang*/ gnyen po sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa yid la byas pas/ spang bya mi gtsang bar zhen pa'i rnam rtog tshang can te/ phyogs re la mngon par zhen pa de 'dra sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po'i tshul gyis sbyong ba ni yin no/ /de yang spyir phyi rol pa sogs 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis srid rtse man chad thob pa srid kyang*/ bdag lta ma spangs pa'i nyams shing ldog par 'gyur la/ nyan rang dag gis bdag med rtogs pas phyir ldog pa min yang snying rje chen po dang bral bas zhi ba'i mthar ltung ngo*/ /byang chub sems dpa' dag ni chos kyi bdag med rtogs shing snying rje chen po dang ldan pas na/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la nges par phyogs pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang de tsam gyis tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa drung 'byin par mi nus pas lha sku bsgom pa dgos la/ yid ngor ches gsal bar shar ba'i lha sku/ de yang las dang po pa dag gis ni bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas bsgrub dgos pa shas che zhing*/ myur du 'grub pa'ang yin pa'i phyir de bsgom pa yin no/ /de las kyang dang por ni/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa lta bu bsgoms te sems shin tu brtan par gyur ba na/ rim pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom par bya ba ste/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor las yang lha grangs mang nyung sna tshogs yod mod kyi/

lugs 'di la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ dang por dbang bskur ba dang*/ gnas skabs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir lha bsnyen pa dang*/ phyis bsgom pa'i nus pa thob pa na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par sgom pa ste/ gnas skabs gsum po der lha so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la bsngags par mdzad do/ /rnal 'byor sgom pa'i dus ni/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i go rim gzhung 'ded thun bzhir bsgom kyang gsal snang mi 'grub pas/ dpa' bo gcig pa la yun ring du bsgoms pas nam zhig gsal snang grub pa na rim gyis rim gyis bslabs pas/ de rjes nas mi ring bar dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsal snang dang*/ nga rgyal dang sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa gsum brtan pa thob pa na/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa bsgom pa'i nus pa thob pa yin no/ /de lta bas na mdor byas las/ gnas kyi nges pa'i skabs su/ dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs su zhes sogs rgyud kyi lung drangs shing*/ lung de'i don 'chad pa na/ sgron gsal las/ dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa'i gnas bstan pa'i phyir/ dgon pa chen po'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ zhes sgrub pa'i skabs su yin par gsungs pa dang*/ phyi rol las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'byin par gsungs pas kyang*/ las dang po kho nas bsgrub pa min par gsal te/ de ni lugs 'dir ma zad gsang sngags spyi'i tshul du snang la/ 'on te las dang po pas kyang mos sgom gyi tshul gyis de ltar nyams su blangs na/ bag chags khyad par can 'jog pa ni nges par yin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor rags pa yongs su rdzogs pa la/ gsal snang thob pa tsam ni bskyed rim nyid la bltos pa'i sngags la gzhol ba yin la/ /phra thig gi rnal 'byor la brten nas dkyil 'khor phra mo la gsal snang thob pa de'i tshe bskyed rim nyid la bltos pa'i nang la mchog tu gzhol pa yin no/

/yang rgyud las/ rtse gcig ma gyur pa yis kyang*/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas 'di dag bya/ zhes ting nge 'dzin ma thob kyang las tshogs phra mo 'ga' zhig 'grub par bshad la/ spyir las dang grub pa thams cad gtso bor ting nge 'dzin 'grub pas bsgrub par bya ba yin te/ ye shes zhabs lugs pa rnams ye shes la cung zad dbang ba na thun mong sgrub cing*/ ye shes la dbang ba na mchog sgrub par bzhed pa ltar yin pas so/ /'dir rtsa ba'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ rags bshad kyi dbang du byas na/ dgug pa'i cho ga dang*/ rdo rje rgya mtsho rkang pas gnon pa'i cho ga dang*/ skul byed ma sgrub pa dang*/ dzambha la sgrub pa dang*/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa dang*/ zhi ba'i las kyi rim pa ni/ spyan mas nad zhi ba dang*/ spyan mas shi ba slong ba dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dug zhi ba dang*/ mi bskyod pas dug zhi ba dang*/ 'od dpag med kyis nye ba'i dug zhi ba dang*/ rta mgrin gyis dug spo ba dang*/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur bas dug spo ba dang*/ rnam snang gis nad zhi bar byed pa dang*/ mi bskyod pa dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/'od dpag med dang*/ don yod grub pas nad gso ba rnams so/ /rgyas pa'i las kyi rim pa ni/ 'od dpag med kyis rgyas par byed pa dang*/ gos dkar mos rgyas par byed pa dag go / dbang gi las kyi rim pa ni/ don yod grub pas dbang du bya ba dang*/ sgrol mas dbang du bya ba dang*/ lha mo mda' can mas dbang du bya ba dang*/ 'jam pa'i rdo rjes dbang du bya ba rnams so/ /mngon spyod kyi las kyi rim pa ni/ rdo rje khro bos bsad pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyis bsad pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bsad pa dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas bsad pa dang*/ dbyug sngon can gyis bsad pa dang*/ khro bo gang yang rung bas bsad pa dang*/ khro bo gang yang rung bas phur bus gdab pa dang*/ rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyis phur bus gdab pa gsum dang*/

gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbrul gyis 'dzin du gzhug pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyis 'gas par byed pa dang*/ g.yang du lhung bar byed pa dang*/ srin pos 'dzin du 'jug pa dang*/ mgul dgag pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gis dgra bos byas pa'i las bzlog pa rnams so/ /gnas nas spo pa'i cho ga ni/ rang gi lha'i sbyor bas skrod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sbyor bas skrod pa rnams so/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sbyor bas bsgrub bya srin pos 'dzin du gzhug pa yang ngo*/ /yang dgug pa'i cho ga rnams la rnam snang dang*/ mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'od dpag med gsum gyis dgug pa'i cho ga gsum dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyi sbyor bas dgug pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang*/ mi g.yo ba dang*/ gnod mdzes rgyal po dang*/ khro bo gang yang rung ba dang*/ thor tshugs gcig ma klu'i bu mo dgug pa dang*/ khro gnyer mas rig 'dzin gyi bu mo dgug pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyis srin po bkug nas skyes pa'am bud med dgug tu gzhug pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyi sbyin sreg gis dgug pa rnams so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas tshar bcad pa dang*/ khro bo'i 'khor los dpung gnon pa gnyis dang*/ phur bus dpung gnon pa dang*/ stobs po ches char dbab pa dang*/ stobs po ches zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis char dbab pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyis dbab pa dang*/ klu'i dkyil 'khor bris nas char dbab pa dang*/ mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg gis dbab pa dang*/ gnod mdzes kyis stobs po che mnan te char dbab pa dang*/ mā ma kis bsgrub bya srung ba dang*/ khro bos bsam gtan gyi bgegs srung ba dang*/ mngag gzhug sgrub pa ste de rnams ni las kyi tshogs so/ /dngos grub dam pa sgrub pa ni/ glang chen sha yis mngon shes sgrub/ /rta yi sha yis mi snang sgrub/ /dgug pa ba lang sha yis sgrub/ khyi yi sha yis thams cad sgrub/ / ces bya ba ste/

sha bzhis rang gi lus khyad par bsgrub pa'o/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ mi bskyod pa dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ don yod grub pa'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa po ste lnga dang*/ yang de dag phyag mtshan gyis sgrub pa dang*/ yang de dag ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrub pa dang*/ yang de dag bzlas brjod kyis sgrub pa dang*/ 'jam dpal dang khro bos rig 'dzin sgrub pa dang*/ nam mkha'i snying pos mi snang ba bsgrub pa dang spyan ras gzigs kyis tshig sgrub pa dang*/ byams pas mtshon chas mi tshug pa dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi bzlas pas mi snang ba sgrub pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po gang yang rung bas ril bu sgrub pa dang*/ rang gi lhas mi snang ba bsgrub pa dang*/ mig sman sgrub pa rnams so/ /spyod pa spyad pas phyag rgya chen po bsgrubs te/ ye shes la dbang du gyur pas so/ /'di tsam zhig mdor bstan pa'i tshul gyis thog mar shes par byas nas/ don gyi mdo 'di nyid blo la gzung nas te/ rgyud 'grel chen po nyan na/ blo la mi 'dzings par 'gyur mod/ mngon rtogs kyi tshul du zhib mor rtogs 'dod na 'gos lugs kyi gtong thun chen po na/ bla ma'i man ngag dang bcas te gsal bar bris gnang bas/ de dag la sogs pa lugs rnying pa'i yi ge zhib mo rnams las rtogs par bya zhing*/ de dag la sgron gsal nyid dang zhus dag bya dgos pa cung zad tsam yod mod/ bshad pa dang man ngag gi 'gangs rnams shin tu bzang por rtogs par bya'o/ /da ni nye bar mkho ba sgrub thabs nyid kyi dag bya dag byed cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de la ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa bshad pa/ sgrub thabs kyi chings bshad pa/ las dang dngos grub sgrub tshul la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul bskyed rim rnal 'byor gnyis gsal bar ngos gzung pa'o/ /dang po la rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro /rnal 'byor dngos gzhi/ rjes thun mtshams kyi spyod pa ste gsum mo/

/ dang po ni/ 'dir rgya gar ba phyi ma 'ga' zhig dang*/ bu ston chen po nas gzung bod phyis byung thams cad mgrin gcig tu tshogs zhing spyan 'dren sogs bsod nams tshogs gsog gzhan dang mthun pa zhig mdzad la/ rgya gar lnga rabs pa rnams kyis ni ma bshad cing*/ bod snga rabs pa rnams la ni byed pa dang mi byed pa sna tshogs 'dug kyang*/ 'dir rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams dang rtsa ba'i gzhung min yang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs sogs lugs rnying pa rnams las ma bshad pa nyid mi dgos pa'i sgrub byed yin zhing*/ ci ste tshogs gsog zhig sngon du 'gro bar 'dod na ni/ sgom pa'i sngon du maṇḍal mchod pa nyid bya yi/ dmigs pa'i rim pa blos btags bsnan pa ni dgos pa chung la/ 'on kyang skyon du 'gyur ba ni ma yin mod/ phyis kyi bod thams cad ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags snon pa ni shin tu mi 'brel la/ kha cig gur nas 'byung ba ltar byed pa yang*/ rgyud tshig yin pas bzang mod kyi/ rgyud sde'i rim pa ltar na cung zad mi 'brel te/ thabs rgyud kyis shes rab kyi rgyud la kha 'gengs pa 'thad kyang de las go zlog pa mi 'thad pa nyid kyi phyir te/ ma rgyud ni rnal 'byor bla na med par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /ci ste tshogs zhing mchod pa gdon mi zad par byed 'dod na ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags zhig bcug na legs so snyam mo/ /de lta bas na/ rab tu mthun pa'i gnas btsal ba dang sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed pa gnyis nges par sngon du 'gro dgos la/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag ltar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i rnal 'byor sogs byas kyang don de nyid grub pa yin no/ /de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa la/ stong par sbyangs pas ni/ srung 'khor stong nyid kyi ye shes su 'char ba'i ched yin la/ lugs 'di la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu bsgom pa yang mi dgos te/

rang gzhung las ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud phyi ma las gsungs kyang*/ lugs 'di la dgongs pa mthun pa'i dbang du byas nas rgyud phyi ma'i lung mang du 'dren mod kyang*/ lugs 'di'i bskyed rdzogs dang rgyud kyi chings rnams rgyud phyi ma la mi brten pa'i phyir dang*/ gal te brten du chug kyang de nas bshad tshad bsgom dgos na ha cang thal bar 'gyur te/ 'phags skor gyi dkyil 'khor la rdo rje ma drug kyang dgod par byed dam ci/ srung 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar por mdo sde las gsungs shing*/ rtsa ba'i lha yin pa'i phyir phyag gnyis pa bsgom pa 'thad la/ khro bo bcu hūṃ las bskyed pa le'u bcu gsum pa rtsa 'grel las gsungs pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod par bsgyur ba ni/ le'u bcu bzhi pa rtsa 'grel las gsungs shing*/ dgos pa ni bgegs la phur bus gdab pa sogs drag po'i las bsgrub pa'i phyir yin no/ /kha cig nag po dam tshig rdo rje zhe sdang rdo rje/ ye shes sgron ma rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul gyis zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgyur bar gsungs pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa yin dgos te/ mi bskyod par bsgyur ba de ye shes sgron me rdo rje'i tshul yin na/ rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje'i tshul yin dgos pa gang zhig/dam tshig 'byung ba rdo rje'i skabs zhal gsum pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes smra ba ni sgrub byed kyis 'phongs pa ste/ mi bskyod pa mngal 'byin byas nas/ rang la bstim pas rang nyid mi bskyod par gyur pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs kyi de 'dra zhig bsgom pa la de ltar gsungs kyi/ ye shes sgron me bsgom pa'i gzhi dam tshig 'byung ba yin pa sogs de 'dra'i sngon du de 'gro ba sgrub byed du byed na/ dam tshig 'byung ba'i sngon du zil gnon rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom dgos pa sogs ha cang thal ba mang por 'gyur la/

yum yang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma nyid kyis chog gis reg bya rdo rje mar bsgyur mi dgos te/ rig ma 'du bya ba'i skabs reg bya'i bde ba 'bul pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyal mchog gi skabs phyi dkyil la lha grangs sgrigs pa'i phyir mi bskyod pa'i yum reg bya rdo rje mas byas pa yin gyi/ mi bskyod pa'i rtsa ba'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma ma yin pas/ mi bskyod pa byung ba'i sa thams cad du reg bya rdo rje ma dgos pa ma yin no/ /gzhung las khro bo rnams spro ba tsam du gsungs kyi/ mkha' nang nas spro ba'i gsal kha med pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar thugs ka nas spro ba yin no/ /ci ste mkha' nang nas spro na ni rgyal mchog ltar 'byin sngags dang mdzad pa sogs dang bcas nas spro dgos kyi/ rang gi blo la ci ran ran gyi spro tshul la snying po med do/ /spro bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa tsam gyis mkha' nang nas spro bar sgrub pa ni/ dbang che'i rig pa kho na yin no/ /rdo rje'i rwa ba sogs la 'god pa ni/ gnas srung ba yin la/ khro bo rnams sam gtso bo'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'god pa ni bdag nyid srung ba yin zhing*/ rnal 'byor srung ba ni kha cig ye shes kyi sgom pa nyid yin no/ /zer yang spyir stong nyid bsgom pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnal 'byor srung bar bshad pa mang du yod mod/ skabs 'dir srung ba gsum kar srung 'khor nyid kyi nang tshan nas phye ba zhig dgos pa yin pa la/ ye shes kyi sa bskyed pa ni srung 'khor gyi cho ga ma yin pas 'chad tshul de ni mi 'thad do/ /de bas na skabs 'dir stong ba'i ngang las khro bor bskyed pa nyid rnal 'byor srung ba yin la/ phur btab kyang gnas srung gi yan lag tu bsdu bar bya'o/ /tshogs gsog dang srung 'khor la/ sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi rim pa mang du sbyor tshul mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis mdzad kyang*/ 'di'i phyogs kyi gzhung man ngag khungs ma gang na'ang gsal bar mi snang bas btang snyoms su bzhag go

/gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos la/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom tshul/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom tshul/ las rgyas mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom tshul lo/ /dang po la/ dang sbyor nyid kyi sngon 'gro dang dang sbyor dngos so/ /dang po la snod sbyang ba'i bsam gtan dang*/ bcud sbyang ba'i bsam gtan gnyis so/ /snod sbyang ba'i bsam gtan la 'jig pa'i bskal ba'i dus snod kyi 'jig rten stongs pa dang chos mtshungs par/ ye shes kyis sgom pa'i ming can snod bcud stong par bsdus te bsgom pa 'di yin no/ /skabs 'dir/ rnam thar gsum gyi rim pas bsgom pa ni/ ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag yin pas spyir bzang mod kyang lugs 'di dang ma 'brel lo/ /kha cig snod bcud 'di dag cang med du song bar bsgoms nas chad ltar 'gyur ro zer mod kyang*/ cang med gang la zer ngos 'dzin rgyu mi 'dug pas/ sdang shugs kyis myos pa'i bla brdol tsam du zad la/ skabs 'dir snod bcud bden med du shes pa tsam du ma zad*/ snang ba 'di yang blo'i yul du dgag dgos pa yin te/ de ltar ma bkag na 'jig rten stong pa dang chos mthun sbyar du med pa dang*/ ma dag pa'i snang ba snang bzhin du dag snang gi lha sku bsgom du med pa'i phyir ro/ /cang med bya ba don dam par yod pa mi srid pa la bya na ni/ khyed rang gi 'dod pa yang der 'gyur zhing*/ kun rdzob tu yang med do zhes skur pa 'debs pa la 'jog na ni/ de ltar 'dod mkhan su yang med pa'i phyir/ phyogs snga med pa'i dgag pa yin la/ snod bcud med par bsgom pa 'khrul te/ snod bcud yod pa'i phyir ces zer pa ni/ shin tu tha chad yin pa'i rig pa yin no/ /yang 'di skad ces/ snang ba 'di med pa gnas lugs su 'dod pa ni/ rgyang phan ba las kyang tha chad zer ba sogs bdud kyi gsang tshig tu snang yang*/ gzhan du 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir dgag pa rgyas par ma brjod la/

bden med sgom pa lta ba rnam dag yin na/ bden med kyi don gnas tshul la ye ma grub kyang snang ba 'byung ba tsam la zer ba yin pas/ da lta'i snang ba 'di gang du yang ma grub pa de ka ci'i phyir gnas lugs ma yin te/ gnas lugs la ci yang ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ kho bo cag ni kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du rig pa de/ gnas skabs kyi lta ba rnam dag ma nor ba yin yang*/ dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug ma yin te/ 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang bcas pa'i phyir ro zhes smra'o/ /'phros pas chog go /de ni gzhan dag sbyang gzhi zhes zer ba de/ rang lugs la sbyang bya zhes tha snyad bya ste/ sbyang ba byed pa'i gzhi ni gdod nas grub pa'i chos nyid kho na las gzhan ma dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes nges par byas nas/ skabs 'dir snod gyi 'jig rten zhig pa dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'chags pa dang*/ bskal ba dang po'i mir skye ba dang sbyor rgyu'i chos mthun 'di rnams ji lta bu zhig ce na/ bod snga phyi thams cad bskal ba bzang po 'di'i sngon rol gyi bskal pa de'i gzhug gi 'jig zhig gi bskal ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dang po 'chags pa dang*/ bskal pa dang po'i mi sngon byung ba de dag dang sbyor rgyu yin par kha 'cham la/ de las gzhan pa'i go ba khyad par can su la yang ma skyes bar snang ngo*/ /de dag las snga ma phal cher ni/ sngar byung de dag sbyang gzhi yin la/ de sbyong byed dmigs pa 'di dag sgom mo zhes/ dpyad pa ma gtang bar 'chad la/ 'phags skor ba phyi ma rnams ni 'das zin pa la gnyen pos sbyang thabs med pa'i rig pas/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ma yin/ chos mthun tsam yin no zhes smra'o/ /yang phyis byung ba ma sbyangs pa kha cig ni/ snga rabs pa'i zhen du bsgoms nas/ de 'dra de rtog ge'i dug chus bslad pa yin zhing*/ 'das pa'i dngos po la sbyang gzhir byed pa gsang sngags kyi zab khyad yin no skad pa'i mu cor smra bar byed do/

/de dag la rgal brtag mang po 'byung bar snang yang*/ dgos pa chung bas re zhig bzhag ste/ rang lugs ni 'di lta bu yin te/ 'das pa'i dngos po la dngos su sbyang du med pa ni bden la/ 'das pa'i dngos por 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni da ltar bar dang ma 'ongs pa rnams sbyang du yod cing sbyang dgos pa'ang yin pas/ rnam rtog dang de 'brel ba'i sgo nas 'das pa la sbyang bya'i rnam gzhag byas kyang mi 'gal ba tsam ni yin no/ / 'on kyang 'chi bar skye gsum gyi srid pa rang rgyud la ma 'ongs pa na/ 'byung 'gyur gyi sa bon de dag sbyang byar bzhag nas/ sbyong byed lam gyis sbyong tshul 'chi bar skye gsum dang rnam pa mthun par bsgom pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang sbyor tshul la khyad par med de/ ma 'ongs pa na snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa'i snang ba 'char rgyu'i sa bon dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag rnams 'chags pa'i snang ba 'char rgyu'i sa bon dang*/ bskal pa dang po'i mi mtshon byed de/ rdzus skyes kyi 'gro bar 'gro ba'i las kyi sa bon rnams sbyang bya dngos yin la/ ma 'ongs pa rang rgyud dang 'brel ba la 'byung 'gyur gyi 'jig pa'i srid pa dang*/ 'chag pa'i srid pa dang*/ rang nyid bskal pa dang po'i m-ir skye 'gyur rnams dngos por da lta ma grub kyang*/ 'byung rung tsam yin pa'i phyir dang*/ sa bon de dang 'brel ba'i tshul du 'jog dgos pa'i phyir sbyang bya'i rnam grangs su bya'o/ /des na song tshod la de ltar yin zhing*/ mos pa'i ngor ni dus gsum gyi dngos po thams cad la dmigs pas rung ngo*/ /sngar gyi bod rnams la snod kyi 'jig rten 'chags pa dang*/ 'jig pa dang*/ bskal pa dang po'i mir skye ba rnams sngar byung ba de gcig po ma gtogs/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi nyams thog tu 'bab pa/ slar 'byung 'gyur zhig yod med tsam la'ang rtog dpyod ma zhugs par dgos med kyi dpyad pas 'khor bar snang ngo*/

/ye shes kyis bskyed pa'i 'og tu 'byung ba bzhi sgom pa rdo rje'i sa gzhi bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rim pas chags pa sbyong bar byed/ de las gzhal yas khang rdzogs pa ni/ brtan pa ri gling mtsho'i bkod pa rnams chags pa sbyong bar byed/ lha'i gdan bskyed pas ni rang rang gi spyod yul thun mong ma yin pa'i snod rnams sbyong bar byed/ lhag mos kyi lha rnams skad cig gis bskyed pa ni/ bskal pa dang po'i mi la sogs pa brdzus te skye ba rnams sbyong bar byed/ lhag mos kyi mdzad pa la/ sgos su chos mthun gsal kha ma gsungs kyang*/ bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi spyod pa'i khyad par phyis kyi mi rnams dang shin tu mi 'dra ba de dag sbyong bar byed/ kha cig lha pho mor bsgom pa bskal pa dang po'i mi phyis pho mor gyur pa dang chos mthun zer ba sogs ni/ ha cang thal ba yin zhing*/ lhag mos lus la bsdu ba ni/ bskal pa dang po'i mi'i 'od lus rags pa'i lus su gyur pa mtshungs par bshad pa bzhin/ gzhan yang 'od lus las rags pa'i lus su 'gyur ba'i rigs thams cad sbyong*/ de ltar na de yan chad dang sbyor gyi sngon 'gro kho na yin la/ lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdu ba ni dang sbyor dngos gzhi'i phyogs su bsdu dgos so/ /lugs 'di la spyir lhag mos bsgoms phyin lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdu ba nges par dgos la/ rnal 'byor bzhi pa tsam bsgom pa sogs lhag mos mi sgom pa'i rigs la/ de'i dod du snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdu ba spyi khyab kyi lugs bsgoms pas kyang don ston par 'gyur ro/ /de la kha cig bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams tha mal du gyur nas/ khams drug ldan pa'i lus de 'chi ba na thim rim 'di lta bu 'byung ngo zhes 'chad kyang*/ spyir khams drug ldan pa yin mod kyang*/ 'phags skor gyi gzhung kun nas khams drug ldan pa'i lus kyi tha snyad gsungs pa ni ma mthong pas/

lugs gzhan gyi brda' 'chad smra bzhin du 'phags skor ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag yin skad dang*/ khyad bcos du ma yod skad kyis nga rgyal ba yang mi mdzes so/ /de la lha rnams 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i go rim ni/ sems dben gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar phung khams 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i rim pa de nyid yin la/ de ltar bsgoms pas gzhi'i dus su 'chi ba'i srid pa sbyong zhing*/ 'bras bu'i dus na chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rnam pa lam du byed pa yin la/ rdzogs rim gyi dus na 'od gsal gyi rim pa gtso bor smin par byed pa'i thabs yin pas/ sems dben gyi 'od gsal yang shin tu rnam pa mthun pa'i sgo nas smin par byed cing*/ spyir rdzogs rim gyi 'od gsal thams cad kyi yang smin byed du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdus pa'i tha ma stong nyid rnam med la mnyam par 'jog po yin yang sngar gzhal yas khang 'od gsal du bsdus pa med pas/ phyis skyed chog gis bskyed mi dgos te/ sngar yod kyi rgyun du mos nas gsal btab pas chog go /de'i 'og tu shu n+yā ta'i sngags don bsams shing brjod de/ de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa'o/ /de la bar dor longs sku lam khyer la/ sbyang bya ni sems can rnams 'chi ba 'od gsal las langs pas bar do 'grub pa de yin la/ sbyong byed ni mngon byang lhag ma rnams te/ rnam pa mthun pa'i sgo nas sbyong tshul ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng gi nyi zla pad gsum bsgom pa/ 'chi ba 'od gsal las langs pa'i thob mched snang gsum 'byung ba dang chos mthun sa bon yi ge gsum ni/ snang ba gsum po de'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung dang chos mthun/ padma'i steng du yi ge gsum rtseg bsgom pa ni/ snang ba gsum po des bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum bskyed pa dang mthun thams cad gcig tu 'dres nas zla bar gyur pa ni/

bar do'i sgo gsum de ma thag tu 'grub 'gyur gyi sems gsal bar gyur pa de mtshon/ snod bcud zla bar gyur pa ni bar do'i lus 'grub pa ste/ zla ba las byang chub pa'o/ /'di la ngharm+ma ngha tu'i sngags 'byung ba ni/ de thams cad 'od gsal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i don no/ /de nas sa bon las byang chub pa ni bar do'i ngag dang*/ phyag mtshan las byang chub pa ni bar do'i yid dang*/ de nas dang po'i mgon por bzhengs pa ni/ sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa ste/ bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bor rdzogs pa'o/ /de rnams 'bras bu la sbyar na/ gtso bor rim pa bzhin me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya sgrub chos dbyings te/ ye shes lnga po lam du byed pa yin pa dang*/ gzhan yang zla ba sku rdo rje ste/ de yang rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir/ yi ge 'bru gsum las bsgrub pa yin la/ rdo rje gsum po de yang thabs dang shes rab kyi cha gnyis gnyis su phye bas/ shes rab kyi phyogs la nyi zla padma/ thabs kyi phyogs ni yig gsum brtsegs pa'o/ /sku de yang spyod bsdus las dngos med dag pa nam mkha' mnyam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ mkha' mnyam yin pa'i phyir snod bcud thams cad zla bar bsdu'o/ /yig 'bru las byang chub pa gsung rdo rje mtshon la/ de yang rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi phyir yi ge gsum mo/ /phyag mtshan las byang chub pa ni/ thugs rdo rje mtshon zhing*/ nyes pas gdod nas ma gos pas dkar ba/ mi 'gyur zhing brtan pas rdo rje/ de yang rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi phyir/ yig gsum gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de las dang po'i mgon por bzhengs pa ni/ sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs mnyam pa nyid bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /rdzogs rim gyi ye shes smin par byed tshul ni/ sems dben gyi rim pa mthar thug gi dpe'i 'od gsal las snang gsum 'byung ba nas rim pa bzhi pa'i mthar thug don gyi 'od gsal las/

snang gsum lugs zlog tu 'byung ba'i bar gyi 'od gsal las ldang tshul ni/ nyi zla padma gsum gyis mtshon/ steng gi yi ge gsum bskyed cing 'dres pa ni/ snang gsum 'od gsal gyi rlung dang 'brel ba las rim pa gsum pa'i sgyu lus dang*/ zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa dang grub nas yang yang snang ba de 'char ba mtshon/ sa bon dang phyag mtshan las byang chub pa yang zung 'jug de nyid kyi gsung brjod bral sgra dbyangs thams cad pa dang*/ thugs bde stong shes bya kun rig cing sgrib pa kun 'joms pa de mtshon/ 'od zer spro bsdu rnams ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las mtshon zhing*/ de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs mnyam nyid dngos sam/ rjes mthun thob pa ni/ sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa'o/ /mngon byang gnyis pa'i skabs kyi yi ge 'bru gsum la snang ba gsum dang go rim 'dra min cung zad yod kyang*/ spyi rigs pa dang mthun na/ go rim phra mo ma mthun kyang skyon med par bzhed la/ sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa zhes pa'i sku ni zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i don yin gyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi zlas phye ba'i sku'i dag par ston pa min pas/ de'i phyir mngon byang phyi ma gsum la/ gsung thugs sku'i rim par 'dod pa ni shin tu mi legs te/ go rim de 'dra rdo rje gsum lugs 'byung lugs zlog su dang yang mi mthun pas so/ /rdzogs rim gyi smin byed 'di ni mtshon byed de/ phra thig gi bde stong las lus dben gyi lha sku ldang ba dang*/ ngag dben gyi rim pa dang*/ sems dben gyi rim pa dang*/ sgyu lus kyi rim pa la gnas pa rnams kyi bde stong dang*/ lha sku thams cad la 'byor bar 'gyur ro/ /dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar por byed pa ni/ rgyu'i rdo rje sems dpa'i don yin la/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa byed pa las zhal gcig phyag gnyis par byed pa legs te/ rtsa ba'i lha yin pa mtshon pa'i phyir dang*/

rgyud las/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje de nyid zhal gsum pa lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gzigs par gyur to/ /zhes pa lugs 'di la sprul sku rdor sems su bsgyur ba na/ zhal gsum par gyur pa'i dmigs bsal du sbyor ba mdzad pas/ de'i sngon du zhal gcig par gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /da ni skye ba sprul sku lam khyer la/ dang po'i mgon po'i mdzad pa nas gzung ste/ rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa'i bar te/ de la mdzad pa ni dang po'i mgon po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas rnams bskul nas/ de rnams rjes chags mdzad pa ni/ bar do'i sems can gyi las kyis bskul nas pha ma rnams rjes chags la 'jug pa mtshon byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i mi bskyod pas 'gro ba rnams la byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ pho mo gnyis kyi rtsa bdun khri nyis stong nas thig le zhu ba dang mtshungs/ sems can rnams bde ba thob pa ni/ phung khams skye mched thams cad bde bas byin gyis rlabs pa dang mthun/ gzhal med khang mngal gnas dang mtshungs pa'i nang du mkha' khyab kyi lha de rnams 'dus shing 'dres pa khams dkar dmar dang mtshungs pa la/ bar do dang 'dra ba'i dang po'i mgon po thim pas/ skye ba bzung ba dang 'dra ba'i sprul sku rdor sems su gyur pa yin no/ /de nas lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa ni/ mngal du phung khams skye mched thams cad rim gyis yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum so so dang*/ gsum ka gong nas gong du 'phel ba mtshon pa dang sems dpa' gsum brtseg ni/ lus rags pa dang*/ snying ga gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa nang gi thig le dang*/ de la brten pa'i rlung dang rig pa'i mthu stobs gong 'phel du 'grub pa sbyor ba'i phyir yin no/ /rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa ni/ rang gi rigs kyi bya ba la dbang bsgyur ba rnam par dag pa ste/

de yang dang po'i mgon por bsgyur ba dang*/ lus dkyil ni gtso bor mngal gyi gnas skabs rnam par dag pa dang*/ rdo rje gsum byin rlabs/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs rnams btsas nas lus rdzogs kyi bar dang sbyar ro/ /'bras bu'i dbang du byas na/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de skye bo rnams kyis mi mthong bas 'gro ba rnams kyi snang ngor sprul pa'i sku sprul pa ni/ sprul sku rdor sems su bsgyur ba ste/ rtsa ba'i sprul sku yin la/ de nas gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa sna tshogs 'byung ba ni/ yan lag gi sprul sku ste/ lus dkyil gyi lha bsgoms pas lam du byed la/ de dag ye shes gcig nyid las byung ba ni/ lha rnams rdor sems kyi lus nang du chud pas mtshon pa'o/ /rdo rje gsum byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid kyi go 'phang brnyes pa dang*/ sems dpa' gsum brtseg la/ dam tshig sems dpa' ni rtsa dang bcas pa'i lus/ ye shes sems dpa' ni rlung dang bcas pa'i thig le/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ni 'od gsal gyi sems te/ de rnams kyi chos nyid mngon sum du gyur pa'o/ /rigs bdag gis rgyas btab cing*/ byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur ba ni/ bde ba chen po'i sku brnyes pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i don la dbang bskur ba yin pas mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyi don spyod pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa'o/ /rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gyur tshul ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba la bdag nyid zhugs pas sprul sku rdor sems su gyur pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi mnyam bzhag bde stong las langs pa na snang ba thams cad la bde stong rjes su zhugs pa mtshon zhing*/ kha cig dben gsum gyi skabs kyi sgyu lus rjes mthun pa dang*/ rim pa gsum pa'i rlung sems kyi lha sku de rags pa'i lus la 'jug pa mtshon no/

/zhes kyang 'dod de mi 'gal bar mthong ngo*/ /'on kyang snang ba thams cad la bde ba rjes su zhugs pa de ni rdzogs rim gyi skabs su sprul sku lam 'khyer gyi gtso bo yin la/ gzhan dag ni rnam grangs so/ /lus dkyil bsgom pas ni/ phung khams snyigs ma rnams 'od gsal du thim pa dang*/ dngas ma rnams lha skur spro ba'i smin byed dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ lus dben nas brtsams zung 'jug gi bar du snang ba gsum gyi ye shes khyad par can bskyed pa'i gzhi 'dings pa dang*/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsgom pas kyang*/ rtsa khams rlung sems kyi dngas ma lha skur 'char ba'i smin byed dang*/ rgyas btab dbang bskur ni/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bor brtan pas/ phung khams thams cad bde chen du gyur pa'i smin byed do/ gsum byin gyis rlabs pa man chad lam dang 'bras bu'i sprul sku kho na dang sbyor ba min te/ sku gsum char gyi thun mong du snang ngo*/ 'on kyang skye ba sprul sku lam byed kyi skabs su byung bas de'i sde tshan du bzhag go /'dir lus dkyil gyi lus zhes bya ba ni/ lha'i sku lus de yin la/ de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa tshang bar byas te bsgom pa la lus dkyil zhes bya yi/ lus dkyil gyi go don sgrub gzhi lus yin pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'chad pa don ma yin te/ kho bo cag ltar na bsgrub gzhi lus ma yin pa'i khyab pa yod mod/ gzhan khyed dag ltar yang rten dang brten pa gnyis ka'i skabs su bsgrub gzhi shes pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas du ma khas len dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lus dkyil gyi gzhal yas khang ni lha'i sku nyid gzhal yas khang du mos pa kho nas 'grub kyi/ phyi dkyil gyi gzhal yas khang gi rgyun de/ lus kyi 'bras bur mos pa tsam la lus dkyil du 'chad pa ni gang nas kyang ma bshad do/ /skabs 'dir sbyang bya sbyong byed rnams 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi dang mthun par 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan 'jig rten so so skye bo phal gyi snang ba la/

sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'i tha snyad 'jog pa de/ 'dzam bu gling gi rten kho na la 'byung bar 'dod pas/ 'dzam bu gling gi rten de mchog tu bsngags pa'i phyir/ 'di dag mthun par sbyar ba ni/ sdom 'byung la sogs pa'i rgyud las kyang 'byung zhing*/ bla ma'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bstan pa yin gyi/ spyir 'chi bar skye gsum gyi srid pa sbyor tshul gcig bsgoms pas/ 'gro ba so so tha dad pa'i 'chi bar skye gsum thams cad gcig car sbyong nus pa yin te/ rigs 'dra ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /des na gang dag tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba'i rten la 'dzam bu gling pa kho na dgos pa dang*/ gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam du byed nus pa yang 'dzam bu gling pa kho na la yod pa dang sngags la brten nas sangs rgyas sgrub pa rnams 'og min gyi zhing du sangs mi rgya bar/ ma dag pa'i zhing du ma dag pa'i lus rten la sangs rgya ba dang*/ 'dzam bu gling du sangs rgya mkhan de'i 'chi bar skye gsum sbyang gzhi dngos yin gyi gzhan rnams min par 'dod pa sogs ni/ gnad ma go ba'i cal col tsam du snang la/ gzugs med khams na gzugs med pa dang*/ gzugs khams na gnyis sbyor med pa dang*/ lha'i lus rten la khams dkar dmar med pa sogs mngon pa'i lung gis sgrub pa ni/ spyir theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhung lugs ma go zhing*/ sgos su gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan dang 'gal ba'i bshad par snang ngo*/ /lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdu ba nas rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa'i bar ni/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i mtshan nyid can dang po sbyor ba dngos yin la/ rig ma 'dus bya ba la sogs pa ni yan lag go /de yang gong du smos pa ltar sgrub pa'i skabs yin na/ dngos kyi rig ma 'am/ yid kyi bsgom pa yin yang las kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i khyad par las/ rdo rje'i rigs la smin sha can/ /rnam snang rigs la btso rlag ma/

/rin chen rigs la gar mkhan ma/ /padma'i rigs la 'phreng rgyud ma/ /las kyi rigs la bzo byed ma rnams sgom par byed dgos pa las/ skabs 'dir sme sha can no/ /de yang yid kyis bsgom pa yin na/ de dag snying ga nas sprul te slar yang bskyed bya lha mo dgu yod pa las rdo rje'i rigs la mā ma kī'am/ reg bya rdo rje ma gang rung du bskyed pa yin la/ las dang po pas bsnyen pa'i dus su sgom pa la ni/ reg rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo nyid bsgom pas chog gi mi'i bud med bsgom mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang bla ma rnams ni bsgom par mdzad do/ /rig ma de'i lus la lha nyer dgu 'god pa ni/ rig ma 'dus bya ba yin la/ mkha' gsang byin gyis rlabs nas/ rin 'byung gi nga rgyal gyis rjes chags byed cing nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ rjes chags dngos dang*/ yang rdo rje 'chang gi nga rgyal gyis hūṃ 'don zhing 'od zer gyis gang bas rjes chags brtan par byas/ don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnyis sbyor gyi mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ mchod pa dngos yin yang rjes chags dang sdoms nas mchod pa zhes spy-i ming du bya'o/ /skabs 'dir nga rgyal so sor 'pho ba yin gyi/ sku'i rnam pa bsgyur ba ni mi dgos so/ /rig ma 'du bya ba dang*/ mchod pa 'di gnyis lus dkyil gyi lha mchod pa'i don dang*/ lha'i sku la bde stong gis rgyas 'debs pa'i phyir bsgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ rjes chags kyi rkyen gyis sangs rgyas thams cad lus la bcug sangs rgyas de rnams dang lus dkyil gyi lha rnams zhu ba'i thig le rgyur byas nas/ gnas yum gyi mkha' nang du dkyil 'khor bskyed dgos pa la/ rnam gzhag rim pa las gzhal yas khang bsgom par gsungs pas gzhal yas khang bsgom dgos shing*/ lha rnams bskyed pa la cho ga gsum gyi sgo nas bskyed pa dang*/ thugs kar drangs nas phyogs bcur spro ba dang*/

spyi dang sgos kyi mdzad pa mdzad pa dang*/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu bsdu ba dang*/ de la rang rang gi ye shes pa rnams bsre ba dang*/ thog ma nyid nas rigs bdag rang chas su bskyed nas/ skabs 'dir rigs bdag yab yum gyi thig les dbang bskur ba dang*/ slar byon te rang gnas su 'khod pa rnams la/ bskyed pa'i sgo/ spro ba'i sgo/ mdzad pa'i sgo/ bsdu ba'i sgo/ 'dres pa'i sgo/ dbang bskur ba'i sgo/ gnas su 'khod pa'i sgo ste sgo bdun gyi tha snyad mdzad la/ de'i dang po cho ga gsum ni/ thig le so gnyis zla ba las byang chub pa dang*/ sa bon de nyid gsum spel can so gnyis rnams ni yig 'bru las byang chub pa dang*/ phyag mtshan so gnyis ni phyag mtshan las byang chub pa ste/ rgyu cho ga gsum gyi sgo nas 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa'o/ /rnam gzhag rim par phyag rgya rgyas 'debs kyi dogs gcod mdzad pa'i dgongs don snying po 'di yin te/ rnal 'byor rgyud du phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs gsungs pa'i dod la de las kyang bzang ba ting nge 'dzin kho nas 'grub pa ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog 'di la phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs pa'i don tshang ba yin te/ sa bon yig gsum dang spel ba gsung chos kyi phyag rgya/ phyag mtshan so gnyis thugs dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ lha so gnyis sku phyag rgya chen po/ spyi sgos kyi mdzad pa rnams 'phrin las las kyi phyag rgya ste/ lha so gnyis skyed chog bzhi po de tshang ba las gzhan du mi 'da' ba ni/ phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'i don no/ /gsum pa las rgyal po mchog ni/ gdong gi sna rtser nyi gdan la rdo rje rtse lnga pa phra mo bsgoms te/ reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed cing brtan par gyur na/ mtha' yas pa'i bar du spro zhing bsdu ba la bslab/ de yang brtan na lha'i skur bsgyur te mtha' yas pa'i bar du spro bsdu la bslab/ de la brtan na rdo rje'i rtse mor thig le'i gzugs la bslab/

de yang brtan na padmar spros te/ thig le'i dbus su dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la bslab/ de yang brtan na dkyil 'khor de'i gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thig le'i dbus su yang dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la bslab po/ 'on kyang bsnyen pa rkyang ba'i bsnyen pa dang po'i skabs su ni gdong gi sna rtse'i phyag mtshan dang*/ nor bu'i thig le tsam bsgom pas chog go /rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba la dmigs nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi de kho na nyid dran bzhin pas yi ge 'bru gsum yid bzlas sam/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /phyir rol gyi bzlas pa ni/ bzlas pa'i man ngag spyi dang mthun*/ bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ dbang bskur sogs kyi don du/ gtso bo la 'bum 'khor rnams la khri/ bgegs mthar byed kyi 'phreng sngags la khri/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags 'bum de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pas rdzogs pa'o/ /dngos grub sgrub pa la ni tshad med de/ lhas byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ dngos grub so so'i mtshan ma thob kyi bar du'o/ /bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ni lha thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi snying poragasungs la/ badzra dhri ka la sogs pa 'byin sngags rnams ni/ snying po'i snying po yin par gsungs pas nye snying ngo*/ /'byin sngags sa bon dang bcas pa de nyid gsum spel lam/ lnga spel du byed pa ni snying po yin zhing*/ phaṭa dang spel ba yang dpal ldan a ti sha'i rgya dpe la mngon sum du mthong bas/ nor pa'o zhes smra bar mi nus so/ /'phreng sngags ni rtsa rgyud duyum bzhi dang*/ khro bo dgu'i 'phreng sngags tsam gsungs so/ /de yang rang gtso bor gsal ba dang*/ gtso 'khor thams cad rgyud gcig pa dang*/ lha thams cad bde stong gi rnam rol du bltas nas/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskul ba'i don du lha thams cad kyi zhal nas bzlos par bsam dgos so/ /de nas rjes chags kyi rkyen gyis gtso bo sems dpa' gsum brtsegs 'od gsal du gzhug pa dang*/

lha mo bzhis bde ba chen po la bskul nas ldang ba dang*/ de la bstod pa dang*/ mchod pa byed pa rnams kyang ste/ rjes bsdu nyid kyi sngon 'gro yin la/ de'i mthar rjes yongs su bsdu ba yin no/ /rig ma 'du bya man chad la rnam gzhag rim pa las/ sbyang dang sbyangs 'bras ji ltar yin gyi gsal kha med kyang*/ rig ma 'du bya ba ni/ rigs dang mthun pa'i khyim thab bam/ chags pa'i yul don du gnyer zhing*/ de'i don du yo byad gsog pa sogs sbyong*/ mchod pa ni pho mo snyoms par 'jug pa sbyong*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gis ni bu dang*/ tsha bo spro ba la sogs pa sbyong*/ las rgyal mchog gi phra thig ni/ gnyid dang rmi lam la sogs pa'i snang ba sbyong*/ bzlas pas ni ngag gi smra ba sna tshogs dang*/ der 'dzin pa sbyong la/ bla ma snga rabs pa kha cig gtso bo 'od gsal du gzhug pa ni tshe'i mthar 'chi ba sbyong*/ glus bskur ba ni/ nye du mya ngan byed pa sbyong zhes kyang 'chad kyang*/ nyer bsdu 'chi ba dang sbyor dgos na/ rjes kyi rim pa kho na la 'chi ba sbyong byed rim pa gnyis mi dgos pas de ni mi legs la/ des na 'di ni 'od gsal du bsdu ba rgya chung ngu'i dbang du byas te/ gnyid 'thug po sbyong pa la gtso bo gzhug pa sbyong byed du bya'o/ /bskul zhing blang ba ni/ yang rlung gi stobs las/ snang bzhi dang 'byung bzhi'i rim pas gnyid sad kyi snang ba rags pa sbyong*/ mchod bstod la sogs pas de'i longs spyod rnams sbyong ba yin no/ /'bras bu dang sbyar na/ rim ma sbyang ba dang*/ mchod pa ni ye shes kyi sku kha sbyor gyi rnam pa dang*/ thugs bde bas gang ba mtshon/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa mtshon/ yang na sprul pa'i sku'i dbang du byas na/ 'dod chags chen po'i gdul bya la gzigs nas kha sbyor gyi skur ston zhing*/

'dod chags chen po'i spyod pas dkyil 'khor sprul pa yang mtshon/ phra thig gis ni rang gi ye shes kho na las grub pa'i sku dang*/ zhing khams dang mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa mtshon/ bzlas pa ni/ gdul bya gzhan snang du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mtshon/ gtso bo 'od gsal du bsdu ba ni/ gdul bya gzhan snang gi sku de dngos kyi gdul bya med pa na/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa dang 'dra/ glus bskul zhing bzhengs pa ni/ gdul bya yod pa'i zhing der tshad med bzhis bskul nas/ gzugs kyi skur ston pa dang chos mthun/ mchod bstod ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi yon gnas dam par gyur ba mtshon no/ /de dag rdzogs rim dang sbyar ba ni/ rig ma 'du bya ba dang*/ rjes chags ni/ las kyi phyag rgya dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs rim kun gyi gzhi 'dings par byed/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog sprul pa ni las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor gyi rkyen mthar thug pa las/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i sgyu lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba dang mthun/ phra thig gis ni lus dben gyi rgyu byed cing*/ lus dben nyid dang rnam pa mthun/ bzlas pas ni ngag dben smin par byed/ gtso bor 'od gsal du gzhug pas sems dben dang*/ bskul zhing ldang ba mchod bstod bcas pas ni/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi sgyu lus smin par byed do/ kha cig rjes bsdu ba ni/ thun mtshams dang 'brel ba kho na yin pa'i phyir*/ dag bya dag byed ni mi sbyor te/ tshe'i mthar gyur ba'i 'chi ba sbyong byed ni gong du song zin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa ni mi 'thad de tshe mtha'i 'chi ba sbyong byed gtso bo 'od gsal du bsdu ba la shin tu 'byor ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni lhag mos bsdu ba dang nyer bsdu gnyis ka la sbyor dgos rgyu yin pa/ de la rnam gzhag rim par 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

der kun gyi 'jug tu 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang lha tshogs rnams lus dkyil la bsdu ba dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad sbyang ba dang*/ rang nyid 'od gsal du 'jug pa rnams yin la/ de'i phyir thun mtshams kyi lha sku yang slar srid pa'i 'byung ba mtshon/ yang kha cig rig ma 'du bya ba man chad sbyangs 'bras kho na'i skabs yin pas/ gzhi dang sbyor ba mi 'thad do/ /zhes zer/ 'o na lus dkyil yan chad gzhi'i gnas skabs dang sbyor ba'i skabs yin pas/ 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang sbyor ba mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /des na snga ma rnams la gzhi 'khor ba dang mthun pa dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang mthun pa gnyis gnyis yod pa bzhin du 'di dag la'ang rigs pa kho na'o/ /rig ma 'du bya ba man chad 'khor ba'i chos la sbyar ba ni mi rung ste/ sangs rgyas zin pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyor dgos pa'i phyir snyam na/ mngon byang phyi ma nas lus dkyil gyi bar/ bar srid skye srid sogs dang sbyor du mi rung bar 'gyur te/ chos sku thob zin pa'i gnas skabs dang sbyor dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid sbyang gzhi dang sbyangs 'bras kyi phrugs so so yin no snyam na/ 'dir yang de ltar yin pas sbyang bya rigs kyi bag ma blang ba sogs dang sbyar ba de/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas zin pa'i phrugs kyi 'phro la 'thud rgyu ga la yin/ 'di ni sbyang bya'i phrugs dang sbyor te sbyang bya skye ba blangs shing*/ lus tshad phyin pa'i 'phro la 'thud rgyu yin pas 'gal ba ci yang med do/ /'on kyang sgrub thabs kyi stod rnams sbyang gzhi sangs rgyas ma thob gong dang smad rnams sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus dang sbyor dgos pas mi 'dra'o snyam na/ sgrub thabs la sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi dum bu gnyis su 'byed pa 'di 'dra rgyud gzhung man ngag gang gi yang khungs med cing*/ ma dag pa'i lus rten la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i grub mtha' blo bzo ma de dang bsgrigs pa yin gyi/

don la shin tu mi 'thad de/ 'dzam bu gling du sangs rgyas par ston pa dang*/ de'i skye ba dang bar do sogs ni sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul gyi mdzad pa yin gyi/ bar do dang skye ba phal pa yin pa mi srid pas nam du yang sbyang byar mi 'gyur ro/ /sbyang bya'i gtso bo ni/ 'khor ba mtha' med pa'i srid pa kho na yin gyi/ srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la bar do dang skye ba mtshan nyid pa mi srid mod/ gal te srid du chug kyang de ma sbyangs kyang skyon med la/ sbyangs kyang phan yod med pa'i phyir dang*/ de ni sbyangs 'bras dang lam gyis bsdus pa kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam gzhag rim pa las/ phyag rgya bzhi tshang tshul la dogs pa dpyad pa'i don ni/ gong du dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog phyag rgya bzhir bshad pa de yin la/ zhal gyi dag pa'i zhu lan ni/ lha thams cad zhal gsum par byed pa dag pa ci la dgongs/ zhes dris pa la/ rdo rje thal mo'i nges don dbang lnga yul lnga 'od gsal du bcug pa nges don du bshad nas/ shes rab 'od gsal dang thabs sgyu ma'i sku dang*/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa te sde gsum po de mtshon pa dang*/ lung ston las/ skyabs gsum de nyid gsum yin te/ /sku gsum rnam par thar gsum gyi/ /zhal gsum yin te mdog gsum yin/ /sbyor gsum dam tshig gsum sbyor bas/ khams gsum du ni lha gsum gyi/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dus gsum du/ /lam gsum gyi ni mchog gsum gyi/ /ji snyed du ni rtogs pas bskul/ /zhes gsum tshan gyi chos bcu gnyis sam/ bcu gsum dag pa'i zhal gsum du bshad la/ gzhung nas mi gsal yang*/ snang gsum lugs 'byung lugs zlog dag pa dang*/ phar phyin drug dag pa'i phyag drug go /'di ni mtshon byed tsam ste/ phyag mtshan la sogs pa'i dag pa rgyas pa rtogs dgos pa'i don yin la/ de yang mdor byas su dag dran gyi gsal kha med pas/ dag pa dran pa bsam pa dang shes dgos zhes pa'i don te/

de dag kyang man ngag snye ma sogs las gsal bar 'byung ba ltar shes par bya yi/ gang dag zhal gsum phyag drug pa ma yin pa'i lhas rdzogs rim smin byed kyis bskyed rim mi 'grub pa dang*/ rgyud gzhan las sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ zung 'jug gsum dpyis phyin pa mi ston pas/ lha thams cad zhal gsum par mi byed ces pa dang*/ rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang lha zhal gsum phyag drug ma sgoms na sangs mi rgya zhes zer zhing*/ res 'ga' rgyu mtshan rtogs dka' ba zhig yong gyu ba byed la/ res 'ga' zhal gsum gyi dag pa kho na go bas ches blun po ma gtogs/ gsang 'dus 'ba' zhig la dad pa skye dgos zer ba sogs ni mu cor kho nar zad do/ lha'i grangs la dogs gcod kyi don yang*/ slob dpon so sos gsang 'dus kyi rgyud la lha grangs mi 'dra ba du ma byas pa las/ 'dir sum cu so gnyis mdzad pa la/ dag sbyor gyi dgos pa ci yod ces dris pa'i lan du lus dkyil gyi skabs su sbyang bya phung khams skye mched yan lag rnam par dag pa'i sbyong byed lha so gnyis yod pa bzhin du phyi dkyil la yang dag bya dag byed de dag tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ lha so gnyis su byas/ dag bya yang phung po lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi*/ dbang po drug yul lnga lus kyi rten khog pa la tshigs dang rtsa rgyus yan lag bsngoms pas bcu gnyis rnams te/ de rnams dag byed kyi dbang du byas pas dag pa cha tshang phrugs gcig la sum cu so gnyis dgos pa'i skabs byung zhing*/ de las lhag pa mi dgos pa'i gnas skabs zhig kyang yod pas/ sum cu so gnyis su byas zhes pa'i don yin te/ zhal dang lha tshogs kyi grangs nges 'di gnyis kar dgos pa la bltos pa'i grangs nges yin gyi/ phung gsum sel ba'i grangs nges ma yin pas/ tshad ma'i kha skad 'brel med 'ga' zhig 'dir bcug nas/ rtsod pa la yid dga' mi bya'o/ /des na phyis 'ga' zhig zer ba ltar slob dpon gzhan gyi lugs lha grangs so so ba de dag la/

dag sbyor rnam dag med cing*/ so gnyis pa la dag sbyor rnam dag yod pas/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor gzhan de rnams ma dag ces pa'i don ye min no/ /spyir rnam gzhag rim pa la/ mngon pa mdzod kyi lung drangs pa dang*/ 'dus pa la slob dpon tha dad kyi sgrub thabs mang po brtsams pa yang*/ phyis rgyal po pā la bdun gyi ring la phal cher byung gi /sngon cher med pas sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba'i dogs gcod bkod pa 'dis kyang*/ 'phags pa'i dngos slob kyi klu byang min no zhes/ rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig smra ba yin la/ skabs 'dir ni don la rton pa nyid kyi phyir dang*/ 'phags skor gyi gzhung rnams brtsams tshul gong du smos pa bzhin yin pas mi 'gal bar shes so/ /gnyis pa sgrub thabs kyi chings bshad pa la/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rgyud 'grel pa dang mthun pa'i 'gyur las/ de nyid dbye ba bco lnga yin/ /dang por sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /bcu bdun rjes su rnal 'byor sogs/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi/rnal 'byor mchog la dbye ba lnga/ /de las kyang ni las rgya mchog/rnal 'byor dbye ba bcu gnyis so/ /de nyid dbye ba bzhi bcu dgu /zhes de nyid bzhi bcu zhe dgur 'dod la/ de yang a lang ka ka la sha'i 'grel pa der/ rang gi sems la so sor rtog pa dang*/ rnam thar bzhi dang*/ mchod pa bzhi dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ gnas dang*/ bgegs bskrad dang*/ stong nyid bsgom pa dang*/ ye shes kyi sa dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang*/ lhag mos bsgom pa ste/ 'khor gyi de nyid bcu dang*/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de las ldang ba dang*/ bar srid dag pa dang*/ chos dbyings kyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa dang*/ sngags kyis bsten par byed pa ste/ /sgyu lus su gyur ba'i de nyid lnga/ de ltar bco lnga dang po sbyor ba'o/ /rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ yan lag byin gyis rlabs pa ste bzhi dang*/

sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis rlabs pa gsum/ sems dpa' gsum ste drug/phyag rgya'i dbye ba/ de 'du bya ba/ rdo rje padma byin gyis rlabs pa/ rjes chags kyi sngags brjod pa/ bde chen gyi mchod pa/ sngags kyis brtan pa ste/ rjes su rnal 'byor man chad kyi dbye ba bcu bdun dang*/ gshegs pa gshegs ma/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo spro ba ste/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la lnga'o/ /phra mo dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ zhu ba dang*/ bskul ba dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ nyer bsdu dang*/ sgong skyes kyi rim pas rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa dang*/ lus gso ba dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba dang*/ bza' ba'i cho ga dang gshegs su gsol nas nyal ba'i cho ga ste bcu gnyis so/ /zhes bshad pa la/ sgron gsal dang mi 'grig pa 'ga' re byung yang*/ 'phags skor gyi mngon rtogs kho na'i dbang du byas pa min/ 'phreng ba rang gi dbang du byas par snang bas rgyu mtshan de tsam gyis ma dag par 'jog mi thub bo/ /bar skabs dang*/ phyis byung ba'i mkhas pa bu ston chen po dang mkhas pa gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang*/ de nyid zhe dgur bzhed par 'dra ba la/ rnam grangs mi 'dra tsam kho na 'chad do/ /'on kyang skabs 'dir rdo rje 'phreng ba 'gyur gzhan las 'di skad ces 'byung ste/ rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /de nyid dbye ba bco brgyad kyis/ /dang po sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /de las dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi/rnam 'byor mchog la dbye ba brgyad/ /de las kyang ni las rgyal mchog/rnal 'byor dbye ba bcu gnyis so/ / de nyid dbye ba sum cu brgyad/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsdus pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar de nyid sum cu rtsa brgyad du byas na legs so/ /snga ma mang po zhig zhe dgu dag par 'dod de/ 'grel pa'i lugs de mi 'dod phyin/ 'phags skor gyi mngon rtogs la so brgyad du sbyar ba 'di 'grig cing*/

'gos lugs pa rnams kyang so brgyad nyid bzhed do/ /rnal 'byor srung ba dang*/ gnas srung ba dang*/ bdag srung ba ste srung 'khor la gsum/ ye shes kyi sa bskyed pa/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ lhag mos 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ dang sbyor gyi sngon 'gro la gsum/ de nas mngon byang lnga la re re/ sprul sku rdo rje sems dpar bsgyur ba dang lus dkyil dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs dang*/ rgyas btab ste/ dang sbyor dngos gzhi la bcu'o/ /rig ma 'du bya ba dang*/ mchod pa ni/ dang sbyor gyi yan lag kyang yin la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi sngon 'gro yang yin pas/ gnyis po gang du sbyar yang mi 'gal mod/ re zhig dang po sbyor ba nyid du bsdu bar gsungs pas de gnyis dang po sbyor ba rjes te/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes bsdoms pas dang sbyor la bco brgyad de/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa la gcig dang*/ lha bskyed pa la sgo bdun te/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi dbye ba brgyad do/ /phra thig steng gi sna rtser bsgom pa la/ gzhi'i rnal 'byor dang spro bsdu'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ 'og gi sna rtser bsgom pa la yang de ltar gnyis te bzhi/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ ngag bzlas gnyis/ gtso bo 'od gsal du bzhugs pa/ glus bskul zhing bzhengs pa/ bstod pa/ mchod pa/ nyer bsdu/ thun mtshungs su bzheng pa ste drug/de rnams bsdoms pas bcu gnyis ni las rgyal mchog go /yang mdor byas las gsungs pa'i rim pa don tshan nyi shu rtsa lngar bsdu ba ni/ 'phags pa nyid kyi mdo sde las/ 'di skad ces gsungs te/ da ni mdor bsdu ba'i phyir/ mdor bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ de la thog mar gnas nges pa dang*/ snying rje chen po la dmigs pa dang*/ bka'i 'khor lo dang stong pa nyid la dmigs pa dang*/ sa'i cha bskyed pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'god pa dang*/

don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang*/ ldang pa ste nyi ma la dmigs pa dang*/ mthar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po bskyed pa dang sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs pas phung po la sogs pa dag pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa dang ldan pa'i 'dus byas pa dang*/ rdo rje padma 'dus byas pa dang*/ rjes su chags pas rdo rje byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor phyung ba dang*/ phra mo'i sbyor ba dang*/ rdo rje bzlas pa dang*/ ngag gi bzlas pa dang*/ don dam pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i bskul ba dang*/ yang blang ba dang*/ bstod pa byed pa dang*/ nye bar bsdu ba dang*/ las kyi rab tu dbye ba rnams su shes par bya'o/ /zhes don mtshan nyi shu rtsa lngar yang gsungs so/ /rdo rje bzhi'i chings kyi dbang du byas na rgyud phyi ma las/ dang po stong nyid byang chub ste/ /gnyis pa sa bon bsdus pa yin/ /gsum pa gzugs nyid rdzogs pa ste/ /bzhi pa yi ge dgod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la phyogs mthun tsam du sbyar nas/ de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa yan chad/ stong nyid byang chub thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ de nas phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'i bar ni sa bon bsdus pa gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ de nas lus dkyil rdzogs pa'i bar ni gzugs rdzogs pa sku rdo rje'i rnam 'byor/ gtso rkyang bsgom pa yin na/ de nas mchod pa'i bar dang*/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ltar na/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rdzogs kyi bar/ yi ge dgod pa rdo rje gsum thun mong gi rnal 'byor ro/ /rnal 'byor drug gi khungs ni/ rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor rnal che/ dang po sbyor ba mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog/las kyi rgyal po rnal 'byor mchog/ces gsungs nas/ mngon byang dang po gnyis yan chad rnal 'byor/ mngon byang phyi ma gsum rjes su rnam 'byor/

sprul sku rdor sems su bsgyur ba dang lus dkyil shin tu rnal 'byor/ de nas rjes chags kyi mchod pa rdzogs kyi bar rnal 'byor chen po/ de nas gzhal yas khang sbros zin pa'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog/de nas thun mtshams kyi bar las rgyal mchog yin la/ thun mtshams kyi spyod pa dang*/ las dang dngos grub sgrub pa rnams spyir las rgyal mchog tsam du 'chad pa'i gnas skabs 'dug kyang*/ mngon rtogs rim pa gcig gi las rgyal mchog la mi bgrod pas/ yan lag drug gam ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi las rgyal mchog la bgrong pa ni mi bde'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi dbang du byas na/ bshad ma thag pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi po ni dang po sbyor ba yin la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog gong bzhin no/ /bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i dbang du byas/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin rab sbyor ba/ /byang chub mchog gi bsgom par bya/ /nye bar sgrub pa grub mchog la/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par dpyad/ /sngags kyi bdag po bsgom pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i tshe na skul bar gsungs/ /sgrub pa chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /rang sngags rdo rje can gyi gzugs/ /dbu rgyan la ni bdag po bsam/ /ye shes rdo rje 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsnyen pa'i yan lag ni mngon byang dang po yan chad de/ yul stong nyid la yul can ye shes bsnyen par byed pa'i phyir/ byang chub mchog stong nyid la dmigs pa'o/ /nyer sgrub ni/ de nas lus dkyil rdzogs kyi bar te/ ye shes kyi longs spyod rdzogs sku la khad nye ba'i sngags kyi longs sku sgrub pa yin zhing*/ lha'i skyed mched sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas rjes chags kyi bar ni sgrub pa'i yan lag ste/ rang gi sgo gsum dang*/ sngags kyi bdag po sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje gsum gcig tu sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrub chen ni mchod pa'i rjes nas nyer bsdu'i bar te/

gzhan don rgya chen po sgrub par byed pa dang*/ rang sngags sems dpa' gsum dang rigs bdag dbu rgyan bya ba byed pa'i phyir ro/ / gsum pa las dang po pa'i dngos grub sgrub tshul ni/ yang de lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi kar bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang*/ le'u bcu pa las gsungs pa ltar spyod pa la brten nas snying po bskur ba ni/ nyer sgrub kyi yan lag dang*/ bskyed rim pa'i spyod pa dang*/ drag shul sbyor ba ni/ sgrub pa'i yan lag dang*/ zhi sogs kyi las dang*/ dngos grub kyi sbyor ba ni/ sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /bsgrub bya las dang dngos grub ni/ zhi sogs bya ba'i cho ga dang*/ de bzhin grub pa brgyad dang ni/ zhes gsungs pa ltar las/ zhi sogs kyi las la/ las thams cad kyi thun mong gi rjes su 'gro ba brgyad de/ phyogs dang*/ dus dang*/ cha byad dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ yul dang*/ kha zas dang*/ cho ga'i khyad par rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor la gsal snang thob nas dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la brten te/ las tshogs sgrub pa shes che bar gsungs la/ mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'am ma yin te/ dpa' po gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /thun mong gi dngos grub la lha mo bzhis zhus las/ rdzas brgyad yan lag sgrub ba bshad/ / ri lu mig sman dngos grub dang*/ /sa 'og ral gri'i dngos grub dang*/ /mkha' la phur dang mi snang dang*/ /'chi ba med dang nad mjoms so/ /zhes gsungs la/ de dag kyang rags pa la gsal snang thob pa sngags la gzhol bas ni/ bzlas pa dang/ sbyin sreg dang*/ rdzas dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pas bsgrub dgos la/ phra mo la brtan pa thob pa nang la gzhol bas ni/ de dag la ma bltos par bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub bo/ bskyed rim gyi spyod pa la brten nas zhor byung du grub pa brgyad la sogs pa 'grub pa yod kyang*/ spyir grub pa brgyad sogs sgrub pa'i yan lag tu bskyed rim gyi spyod pa spyod pa dang sdigs sbyor dgos pa ni ma yin no/

/nang la gzhol ba'i sngags pas/ bskyed rim gyi rig pa 'dzin pa chen po sgrub pa la/ spogs chog dang snying po bskul ba mi dgos shing*/ sngags la gzhol bas spyod pa zla ba drug tu spyad kyang ma 'grub na/ spyod pa lan gsum gyi bar du spyod dgos pa dang des kyang ma 'grub na drag shul gyi sbyor ba bya la/ rdzogs rim gyi dngos grub ni mi 'grub pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ de dag mi dgos so/ /zhes bod kyi 'phags skor ba snga phyi rnams 'chad do/ / 'on kyang nang la gzhol ba la mi dgos par bshad pa ni/ bskyed rim pa'i nang la gzhol ba de ma yin gyi/ rdzogs rim pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bskyed rim pa'i de gnyis kar la dgos pa srid do/ /de bas na de dgos mi dgos dbang po rno rtul gyi khyad yin te/ rno na bogs 'don gyi spyod pa dang po kho nas mchog la/ 'bring na spyod pa lan gnyis sam gsum spyod cing*/ tha mas de'i steng du sbogs chog sdigs sbyor yang dgos pa yin par bshad la/ 'o na sngags la gzhol ba de dang nang la gzhol ba de la bzang ngan med par 'gyur ro snyam na mi 'gyur te/ dngos grub phal pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i khyad par yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzogs rim pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la yang thun mong sgrub pa med pa ma yin la/ 'on kyang zhor byung du 'grub pa shas che zhing*/ thun mong kho na'i ched du spyod pa dang*/ drag shul sbyor ba mi byed kyang mchog sgrub pa la drag shul sbyor ba'i skabs srid par grub pa'i slob dpon 'ga' zhig bzhed pas/ de yang med ces mtha' gcig tu smra bar mi bya la/ bskyed rim pa'i sdigs sbyor gyi dbye ba rgyud 'di las sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba gsum du gsungs so/ /rtsa rgyud le'u bcu pa las/ snying po bskul ba 'di dag rgyas par gsungs/ sdigs sbyor le'u bcu bzhi pa las gsungs/ rgyud phyi ma las/

ji srid mthong ba de srid du/ /rnam gnyis zla ba drug tu bsgom/ /'dod pa kun la longs sbyod pas/ /thams cad du ni rtag tu bya/ /gal te zla ba drug gis ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa ma mthong na/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga dang*/ /sdom pa lan gsum brtsam par bya/ /de ltar byas kyang sgrub pa pos/ /mthong ba byung bar mi gyur zhing*/ /gal te byang chub ma grub na/ /drag shul sbyor bas bsgrub par bya/ /de tshe de yi ye shes ni/ /'grub pa nges par nye bar 'gyur/ /rigs kyi dbye ba'i sbyor bas ni/ /rdo rje phur bus phur bu gdab/ /de nas dbang du bya ba dang*/ /srung ba'i sbyor ba dag kyang bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /cho ga dang bya ba'i rim pa de dag gis spyir las dang dngos grub thams cad bsgrub la/ sgos su rgyud 'di las gsungs pa gong du smros pa rnams ni nges pa kho nar spyad do/ /bzhi pa bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gnyis ngos gzung ba las/ dran pa gcig pa dang*/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis so/ /dang po la don tshan thog ma rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gyi ngo bo ni/ khyad par gsum ldan gyi lha'i rnal 'byor rags pa la sems zin pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de la khyad par gsum ni/ rang bzhin stong nyid mdangs snying rje rnam pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lam khyer ro/ /de la nang tshan du dbye na/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/ bsdus pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis so/ /dang po yang me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i dbye bas dkyil 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis yin la/ de re re la'ang sems dpa' gsum gsum gyi dbye bas sbyor ba dgu bcu rtsa drug go /dpa' bo gcig pa la yang*/ dbang po rab rnal 'byor bzhi bskyed sum cu so gnyis dang*/ 'bring mngon byang lnga bskyed sum cu so gnyis dang*/ tha ma rdo rje bzhi bskyed sum cu so gnyis te/ de re re la yang sems pa gsum gyi dbye bas/ sbyor ba dgu bcu rtsa drug pa gsum mo/

/rtsa rgyud le'u bcu drug pa las/ rdo rje 'dzin mchog gang yin pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bri bar bya/ /de yi ming dngos rnal 'byor ba/ /dkyil 'khor yin zhes sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes sungs te/ de yang rnam snang gtso bor byed na dbus su rnam snang dang*/ shar du mi bskyod pa bzhag /gshegs pa gzhan rnams la'ang des rigs 'gre/ rigs lnga la dbu rgyan rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ gzhan la rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor gyi gnas su mi 'gro/ 'khor gyi lha rnams la go 'pho na/ rnam pa 'khor de dang de la ngo bo rang rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs par gnas gyur nas dbus su bzhugs pa yin te/ dper na spyan ma dbus su bzhugs na de yang rnam snang gi ngo bor mos/ rnam snang gi go sar mi bskyod pa bzhag/spyan ma'i gnas su yang spyan ma gnyis pa bzhag go /de la rjes 'gos la sogs pa bla ma gong ma rnams ni/ sprul sku rdor sems su bsgyur ba'i dod rnam snang dang spyan ma la sogs pa der bskyed/ rjes chags kyi skabs/ rang nyid sangs rgyas spyan ma rtags bsgyur te/ lha yab du bsgyur/ rig ma yang spyan mar bskyed/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs rang la rnam snang bcug/ngo bo rnam snang la rnam pa sangs rgyas spyan pho mo'i tshul gyis mkha' nang nas dkyil 'khor lhag ma spro/ /des dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog grub zin pa na/ rang nyid spyan ma yum rkyang gi nga rgyal du gnas par bya/ gnod mdzes kyi bar du rigs 'gre ste/ rang rang gi rigs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i nga rgyal du byed pa yin gsung*/ yang 'ga' zhig ni/ dang po sbyor ba spyi dang 'dra ba la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs su gang gtso bor byed pa de dang spros shing rang la bstim pas/ rang nyid lha de dang de'i rnam par gyur pa yin la/ lha mo rnams la gong du smos pa bzhin gyi rtags bsgyur ba de dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ma rdzogs kyi ring la dgos la/

de'i 'og tu lha mo yum rkyang du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /rig ma byin gyis rlobs pa yang*/ reg bya rdo rje ma nyid du nges par byas na/ lha so gnyis kyi grangs dang ngo bo tshang bas legs par 'dod cing*/ reg rdo rje ma nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs/ reg rdo rje pho mo'i rnam pa byed par bzhed do/ /lugs de gnyis kar la 'gal ba ma mthong ngo*/ lha gcig pa'i phyogs la rnal 'byor bzhi bskyed ni/ rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ rnal 'byor rjes kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ / shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ zhes pas bstan zhing*/ mngon byang lnga bskyed ni/ de nyid las/ mngon par byang chub rnam lnga zhes/ /ming gis rab tu bskul ba yin/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje bzhi bskyed ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ yang na rdo rje bzhi dag gi/brtul zhugs brtan pas bsnyen par bya/ / zhes pas bstan zhing*/ rgyud phyi ma'i dang po stong nyid byang chub ste/ sogs kyis kyang ngo*/ /skabs 'dir man ngag la sdang ba kha cig rnal 'byor bzhi bskyed las bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs lugs 'di la med ces zer ba ni/ sbyang bya sbyong byed phyogs gcig tsam go ba'i nga rgyal gyis khengs shing*/ cho ga spros pa che ba kho na la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur du zad la/ rgyal ba rigs lnga las gzhan pa'i gtso bo go 'pho mi 'dod pa yang*/ bdag cag gis ni mos pa tha dad pa'i gang zag rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mi shes so/ /zhes gsal bar ston pa las rgyu mtshan gzhan ci yang med do/ /don tshan gnyis pa sgra don ni/ lha'i rnam pa la dran pa ste sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir dran pa gcig pa'o/ /don tshan gsum pa dran pa gcig pa'i shes bya ni/ rgyud las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ zhes pa la sogs pas phung khams kyi rang bzhin lha'i 'khor lo tsam du shes pa thun mong ba dang*/

ji skad du/ sku dang gsung thugs bdag med par/ /ye shes sems kyis yang dag spro/ /'di ni ye shes spyan phye pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni kun gyi yin/ /zhes lha sku de yang bde stong gi rnam rol du shes pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i shes bya'o/ /don tshan bzhi pa spang bya ni/ 'khor ba'i gnas lus longs spyod la zhen pa ste gong du bshad zin to/ /don tshan lnga pa nyams su len tshul ni/ yig 'bru la bslab/ phyag mtshan la bslab/ rtsa zhal la bslab/ sku la bslab/ rgyan la bslab/ sgra la sogs pa rkyen dang bsre ba la bslab/ de rnams la lobs nas dkyil 'khor sgom du rung bas dkyil 'khor bsgom ste/ rnam pa la bslab/ go rim la bslab/ thun mtshams la bslab/ yun bsring pa la bslab/ rgya bkyed pa la bslab bo/ de ltar bslabs pas lobs pa'i tshad/ bsgom bya lha sku gsal stong rtsol med lhun grub tu yun ring po dang*/ shin tu gsal bar mthong ste/ gsal ba'i tshad ni rig pa dang*/ mthong ba'i mtshan ma rnyed pa yin la/ gzhan yang lha dang bla ma la yid ches pa sogs rtag du ma zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /reg mthong gi mtshan ma la bla ma gong ma rnams dbang po gnyis kyis spyod yul gyur pa zhes tha snyad mdzad mod cung zad mi legs te rnam pa 'dra ba tsam yin gyi/ don du ni mig dang lus kyi dbang po'i spyod yul ma yin te/ chos kyi skye mched kho nas bsdus pa nyid kyis phyir ro/ /don tshan drug pa phan yon ni/ tha mal pa'i snod bcud kyi zhen pa bzlog /tshogs gnyis dang khyad par du bsod nams kyi tshogs khyad par can gsog /bdag nyid rnam par grol ba'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rjes mthun pa thob/ lha tshogs thams cad kyis bdag rgyud la byin gyis rlabs shing*/ sems can gzhan la byin gyis rlobs par nus/ lha dang lha min dang dud 'gro chu las skyes pa dang*/ thang las skyes pa sogs dbang du 'du/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ba la sogs pa'o/
