/gnyis pa rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la/ don tshan dang po ngo bo ni/ phra mo'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs pas sems rnam par sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin yin la/ de la dbye na steng sgo la brten pa dang*/ 'og sgo la brten pa'o/ / dang po ni/ ji skad du/ rin chen chen po kha dog lnga/ /yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshad tsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom/ / zhes gsungs shing*/ de la dbye na/ dang po sna rtser phra mo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ shin tu brtan pa thob nas spro ba gnyis te/ rin chen brtan par gyur na spro/ /brtan par ma gyur yongs mi spro/ /zhes so/ /'og sgo la brten pa la yang gnyis te/ byang chub sems kyi thig le bsgom pa dang rang lha'i mtshan ma bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar yang le'u drug pa las/ utpal mthing ka'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rtse mo lnga pa khyad par du/ /nas kyi 'bru tsam nan tan du/ /sna yi rtse mor rnam par bsam/ /tsa na ka yi 'bru tshad tsam/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas/ /sna yi rtse mor 'di shes te/ /bsgom pas byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ 'og gi sna rtser lha'i mtshan ma brtan par bslab/ de la lobs nas dbang du gyur pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ mtshan ma'i spro bsdu dang*/ lha spro bsdu la slob pa yin no/ /don tshan gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ cha phra zhing rtogs dka' ba la dmigs pa'i phyir phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo'i dkyil 'khor la rtog pa'i phyir/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor zhes kyang 'dod la/ yang na rang rgyu rtog pas bsgom dgos pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad kyi mthar thug pa yin pa'i phyir rtog pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /don tshan gsum pa ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul ni/ sngags la mchog tu gzhol bas bzlas pa mthar phyung ste sbyin sreg gi lha mnyes par byed la/ de ltar yang*/ yang na khro bo thams cad ni/ /dben pa'i gnas ni thams cad du/ /sngags pas 'bum du bzlas byas

na/ /las rnams thams cad byed par bshad/ /ces dang*/ dngos grub kun gyi 'bras 'dod pas/ /sngags shes pas ni sbyin bsreg bya/ zhes gsungs*/ nang la mchog tu gzhol bas ni/ ngag gi bzlas pa spangs te sgom pa kho na mthar 'byin par bya'o/ /man ngag las ni/ steng 'og gi sna rtse gnyis kar la/ thig le'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ yi ge'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor te bzhi bzhi'i dbye ba yod pa/ de re re la yang gtso bo go 'pho'i dbye bas/ sbyor ba brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod do zhes 'byung la/ don tshan bzhi pa mthar phyin pa'i tshad ni/dang por dmigs pa'i gzhi la brten par slob pa'i tshad mthar phyin pa ni/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor phra mo de dang de la reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed pa yin zhing*/ rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan gnyis la reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed na yang de dang de'i rtags mthar phyin pa yin la/ 'bad rtsol med par spro bsdu la reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed na/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor shin tu mtha' phyin pa yin no/ /don tshan lnga pa phan yon ni/ /dngos grub thams cad yon tan gnas/ /nyams dga' byang chub gnas 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnal 'byor 'di thob pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par byed na/ zung 'jug ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa la yang tshegs med de/ lo gsum la sogs pas bde bar 'grub pa dang*/ rnal 'byor 'di thob pa kho nas/ 'dod na ljon shing dang lteng ka la sogs pa skad cig tsam gyis skem par byed cing*/ 'dod na yud tsam gyis ljon shing skam po las me tog 'byung ba dang*/ rdo rje dril bu nam mkhar 'jog pa la sogs pa ya mtshan sna tshogs 'byung zhing*/ thun mong gi dngos grub che chung thams cad nyams 'og tu chud pa'o/ /gal te 'dis rig pa 'dzin pa chen po dag thob par 'dod na/ ji skad du/ gzugs dang sgra dang ror ldan pa/ /shes rab can gyis zla drug bsgom/

zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyod pa zla ba drug spyad pas/ /thun mong gi dngos grub chen po la sbyor bar nus shing*/ /spyir rdzogs rim ma bsgoms par spyod pa spyad na/ dngos grub mchog la cung zad 'gyang bar bshad kyang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus grub nas/ rdzogs rim la brten te rim pas dngos grub mchog la sbyor nus pa'i phyir/ skyon can gyis 'gyangs pa ma yin no/ /gang log par lhung ba sogs sdug bsngal dang*/ rnam g.yeng dang*/ nyon mongs can gyi las bsags pa dang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i 'gyangs pa ni/ nyes can yin yang 'di de ltar ma yin la/ thun mong gi dngos grub ched cher 'dzin pa ni dbang po rtul po yin yang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pas thun mong don du gnyer ba ni/ dbang po rtul po'i yan lag tu mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir rgyud sde rnams las thun mong gi cho ga mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams dman pa la mos pa kho na'i don du mi gzung gi /thun mongs zhes pa'i tshig nyid kyis kyang dman pa kho na'i ma yin te/ mchog dman gnyis ka'i yul du go bar bya dgos so// //de ltar na bskyed rim gyi mngon par rtogs pa zhib mo blo la nges par byas nas/ da ni sgrub pa'i thabs/ rgya skad du/ bi na ti kra ma/ bod skad du/ mdor byas zhes bya ba'am/ rim pa lnga las bsdus pa'i rim par grags pa'i gzhung 'di la/ sa mtshams rnam par dbye ba cung zad tsam bya ste/ de yang khams gsum spyod pa las grol zhes sogs ni/ don dam pa'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal ba'i sgo nas mchod par brjod pa'o/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi ni/ zhes sogs ni rtsom par dam bca' ba ste/ dgos 'grel gyi ngag kyang yin no/ don bsdus zhes pa rgyud mtha' dag gi don bsdu la mi zer gyi/ rgyud las bskyed rim 'thor thabs su gsungs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i don no/ /rnam rtog bag chags zhes sogs kyis bskyed rim gyi dgos pa yang bstan zhing*/

snying rje chen po la dmigs pa yang bstan te/ rnam rmongs la legs bltas zhes pa'i tshig zur gyis so/ /'dod pa lnga ni zhes sogs kyis sngags lam gyi ngo bo chags lam gyis bsdus par bstan no/ /des na 'di ni zhes sogs kyis sgrub pa po'i mtshan nyid dang*/ sku gsung sogs kyis bsgrub bya'i dngos bstan no/ /dgon pa chen po'i sogs kyis gnas kyi nges pa dang*/ 'jam pa'i stan la sogs kyis sgrub pa po'i spyod lam bstan no/ /zhe sdang rdo rje ting nge 'dzin gnas/ zhes pa nas steng 'og yang dag byin gyis brlabs*/ zhes pa'i bar gyis srung ba'i 'khor lo ste/ zhe sdang rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas/ gnas srung ba ni bsam par bya/ zhes pa ni mdor bstan yin la/ lhag ma rnams rgyas bshad do/ zhe sdang rdo rje ni mi bskyod pa yin yang*/ nag po pa'i 'grel par/ hūṃ mdzad du 'chad pa yang mi 'gal te/ de nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi khro bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe drag po dang dkar mo zhabs 'og tu mnan pa yang 'brel med do zhes smra bar mi bya ste/ khro bo de'i mtshan nyid la rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir dang*/ gnod byed med pa'i phyir ro/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rtse mo la/ zhes 'don pa ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu bsgom pa'i rang 'dod kyis bsgyur bar zad kyi/ yi ge dag pa kun las dkyil 'khor cha ru ni zhes 'byung ba nyid tshad ma'o/ gnod mdzes la bka' stsal ba ni/ hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags nyid yin la/ phur bus gdab ces pa 'og gi phur gdab rgyas pa'i mdor bstan no/ /phyogs bcu phur bus sogs ni/ gnas srung rgyas par bshad pa'i don bsdu'o/ /dam pa'i don du zhes sogs ni ye shes kyi sa gzhi bsgom pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas pa sogs ni/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi bsgom pa ste/ de la nam mkha'i khams ni chos 'byung ngo*/ /hūṃ gnyis ni rdo rje gnyis kyi sa bon te/

'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng 'og tu bsgom par bya ba'o/ /rdo rje'i sa zhes pa sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa'i gzhi dang*/ dkyil 'khor zhes pas de nyid zlum por mtshams bcad pa'i mtha' bstan pas rā ba dngos su bshad par 'gyur zhing*/ 'bar ba'i 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i khor yug kyang shugs la 'phangs pa yin no/ /der ni bhruṃ las byung ba yi zhes sogs kyis gzhal yas khang bstan te/ thig bzhi zhes pa ni/ nang gi dkyil 'khor zlum po la re mig dgur gcod pa'i thig bzhi ste/ rnam grangs su ni thig brgyad yod mod kyi/ gdung bzhi po'i phyi thig nang thig gcig tu bsdoms pas bzhi'o/ /rdo rje nor bu sogs dra phyed dang lhan cig pa'i rgyan yin zhing*/ bre'i 'phreng ba ni thog phub kyi gdung 'degs byed yin par gsal la/ 'on kyang kha cig rta babs 'degs byed yin no zhes 'chad do/ /bdag nyid phyag rgyar ldan pa ni/ zhes pa la sogs pas lhag mos kyi dkyil 'khor bstan/ zhal gsum phyag drug lta bu la sogs pa ni/ gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen po'o/ /'o na 'dir mi bskyod pa med pa'i phyir/ rigs lnga ma tshang ngo snyam na/ rgyu 'bras kyi khyad par ma gtogs/ ngo bo gcig tu dgongs pa'i phyir skyon de med do/ /'dir lhag mos kyi mdzad pa ni/ rgyud 'grel nas kha bskang ba yin gyi/ gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan la med pas/ bsdu na ma sgoms kyang skyon med do/ /slar yang kha sbyor ba yi/ zhes sogs kyis lhag mos lus la bsdu ba bstan te/ kha sbyor gyi don ni/ gtso bo la 'khor rnams thim zhing sbyor ba ste/ rim pa ji bzhin zhes pa 'chad par 'gyur pa'i lus dkyil gyi rim pa ji lta ba'i don no/ /don dam pa yi 'khor lo yi/ zhes sogs ni/ lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdu ba bstan te/ rtsa rgyud dang rdo rje 'phreng ba'i lus drangs pas so/ /de la lha rnams gcig la gcig thim pa'i rim pa 'di ni/

dngos su na lhag mos kyi yan lag tu sbyor kyang*/ de bzhin nyid las mngon par byang chub pa'i sngon 'gro yin te/ de gnyis sdoms pa la/ mdo sde dang rnam gzhag las/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /rang bzhin gyi ni snang ba nyid/ ces sogs ni mngon byang lnga'i dbang du byas na/ de bzhin nyid la mngon par byang chub pa yin te/ 'dir rnam shes kyi phung po'i ngo bo gtso bo nyid la lha thams cad zhugs shing thim pa dang*/ gtso bo de yang 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sbyangs nas/ de brten bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs kyi sngags brjod pa yin la/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ thams cad stong pa dang chos kyi sku ni ming gi rnam grangs te/ dmigs pa 'dis de dag lam du byed pa'i don no/ /gzhung 'di nyid ltar na/ 'od gsal 'di kho na don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du bshad de/ dngos kyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ phyogs mthun gyi dbang du brtsis pa yin pas/ gzhung rnams dgongs pa 'gal ba ni ga la zhig/de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ zhes pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad don dam gzigs pa las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'od gsal bar ni zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi ni/ mngon byang phyi ma bzhi po'i mdor bstan yin no/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi zhes pa la sogs pa zla ba las mngon par byang chub pa ste/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus zhes pa*/ stong pa'i ngang las bzhengs pa'am/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang dbus kyi gdan la zhes kyang 'chad do/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu zhes sogs ni/ /snod bcud zla ba la bsdu ba'i don no/ /de ltar sbyor ba zhes pa ni/ de yan chad mngon byang gnyis po de/ rnal 'byor bzhi las sbyor ba ste rnal 'byor dang po yin la/ de'i 'og tu rjes su rnal 'byor brtsam par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /rnal 'byor pa yi yig gsum zhes sogs ni/ sa bon las mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /yig gsum las byung ba zhes pa ni/

'bru gsum las byung ba rdo rje kun da dang zla ba ltar dkar ba yin te/ phyag mtshan las mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /dang po'i mgon po zhes sogs sku yongs rdzogs las byang chub pa ste/ mngon byang phyi ma gsum po de ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /bsam nas kyang zhes pa snga phyi'i go rim ston pa'o/ /thub pa dpal gyi 'grel par lung drangs pa/ de kho na nyid grub par nā ga bo dhi'i zhabs kyis gsungs pa yang*/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i phyogs gnas de/ /skad cig nyid la lha bzang po/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis par ni/ /lha 'di bsgom par bya ba yin/ /zhes 'byung bar bshad pas/ spyir thub pa dpal gyis bshad pa tsam la nges pa med du chug kyang*/ klu byang gis bshad par snang bas de dang nag po dam tshig rdo rjes phyag gnyis par bshad pa yang nor pa min no/ /'di'i mngon byung gnyis pa'i skabs/ yig 'bru zla bar bsdu ba dang*/ snod bcud zla ba bsdu ba gnyis byung ba lugs gzhan las ā li kā lis mtshan pa'i zla ba gnyis 'byung ba dang dod mtshungs la/ mdo sde las/ don dam pa las ldang ba nyi ma la dmigs pa zhes 'byung ba ni nyi zla padma yi ge gsum brtsegs pa bsgom pa'i skabs yin la/ yi ge thim pa dang*/ snod bcud thim pa ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa zhes gcig tu bsdus pa yin cing*/ snod bcud zla bar bsdu ba la byang chub kyi sems la dmigs pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /mngon byang phyi ma gsum dang*/ sprul sku rdor sems su bsgyur ba rnams sdoms pa la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po bskyed pa zhes zer ro/ /mi bskyod pa ni rjes zhugs pas zhes pa la sogs pa shin tu rnal 'byor te/ de las dang por/ g.yon pa'i phyag tu bsam par bya/ zhes pa sogs kyis sprul sku rdor sems su bsgyur ba bstan/ 'di la 'dod tshul mi gcig pa mang du byung yang mi bskyod pa thugs ka nas spro ba 'thad par mthong ngo*/ /de nas phung po zhes pa nas sku'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs gyur nas/

zhes pa'i bar lus dkyil yin la/ de yang sa bon las lhar bskyed pa ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin zhing*/ lha'i ngo bo sngags kyi yig 'brur bsgom pas kyang*/ lus dkyil du mi 'gyur ba ni ma yin te/ sngags nyid lha'i rang bzhin du bshad pa'i gnas skabs shin tu mang bas so/ /'dir lus gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa'i rnam gzhag ma byung bas bsdu na gzhi lus nyid gzhal yas khang du mos pa tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas par na rnam gzhag rim pa las kyang zur tsam gsungs shing*/ bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /zhes sogs lus kyi cha shas so so dkyil 'khor gyi cha shas so sor mos dgos pa yin la/ de'i tshe lus kyi steng 'og gi sgo bzhi ni/ kha sna gnyis dang*/ 'og sgo gnyis yin la/ sna rtse bzhi ni/ gsang gnas kyi sna rtse/ lte ba'i sna rtse/ snying ga'i sna rtse/ gdong gi sna rtse ste bzhi'o/ /yang dkyus la gti mug dga' sogs sngags zhes pa'i skabs su 'dod tshul sna tshogs yod kyang*/ sa bon dang mtshan sngags sogs gang bsgoms kyang dgos don 'dra bas/ so so'i man ngag bzhin du byas pas chog gi dgag sgrub don med do/ /skabs 'dir rnam gzhag rim pa las/ lus la lha 'god pa'i dogs gcod cung zad gcig mdzad pa'i don ni/ mi gtsang ba'i lus la lha bkod pa 'gal lo zhes dogs pa bkod pa la/ zangs kyi rang bzhin gcig la/ bkru bshal gyi snod byas pa'i tshe/ zas kyi snod mi byed/ phyag kyang mi 'tshal/ de nyid zas snod du byed pa'i dus/ bkru bshal mi byed/ phyag mi 'tshal/ de nyid la lha'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i tshe/ gzhan gnyis m-i byed cing phyag 'tshal ba ltar/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi rang bzhin chos nyid de/ 'khor ba'i gnas skabs dang 'brel ba na/ sems can rnams la ngan par snang zhing*/ 'khor ba cung zad dag pa'i gnas skabs na/ 'phags pa rnams lam gyi chos su snang*/ 'khor ba shin tu spangs pa'i skabs na/

sangs rgyas rnams la 'bras bu'i ye shes sam chos nyid du snang yang*/ chos nyid ngo bo la bzang ngan med de/ gnas skabs gsum gyi zangs kyi rang bzhin la khyad par med pa bzhin no/ /zhes lan du bkod pa'i don ni/ mi gtsang ba'i phung po dngos por yod pa zhig la/ de dang ma 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas gtsang sbra can cig phyogs gzhan nas spyan drangs te/ de'i nang du dgong pa yin na rigs pa ma yin pa bden kyang*/ tha mal gyi lus 'di nyid kho na'i rang bzhin nam chos nyid gdod nas sangs rgyas su bzhugs pa de gsal 'debs pa yin pas/ lus la sangs rgyas gdod ma nas bzhugs pa yin gyi/ mi gtsang ba'i dkyil du spyan drangs pa med pas nyes pa med ces pa dang*/yang mi gtsang ba'i lus dngos gnas ma grub kyis/ mi gtsang bar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gis bzhag pa yin pas/ bkru bshal byed pa'i zangs la mi gtsang bar 'dzin pa dang 'dra ste/ bkru bshal gyi snod byas kyang zangs kyi rang bzhin mi gtsang bar ma song ba ltar/ mi gtsang 'khor ba rang gdong nas ma grub pas/ lha la ma gus pa 'byung ba'i nyes pa'i gzhi med ces pa'i don yin no/ /'o na dri ma dang bcas pa'i chos nyid de/ phyis rnam par dag tshul ji lta bu snyam na/ gser 'gyur rtsi'i dpe lta bu ste/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi yis zangs lcags kyi dri ma nag po sbyangs nas/ zangs lcags kyi rang bzhin kha dog gsal ba de mngon du gyur pa la gser du gyur to zhes 'jog pa ltar gdod ma nas lhun rdzogs de mngon du gyur pa la/ sangs rgyas thob bo zhes tha snyad btags pa yin no/ /de ltar yang dgongs pa lung ston las/ phung po 'di dag sangs rgyas yin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rkyen du 'gyur*/ /gnyis med de bzhin gshegs 'jug pa/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs zhes brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ phung po rnams kyi chos nyid sangs rgyas yin te/ lam bsgom pa'i rkyen gyis de mngon du gyur pa na rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo zhes bya la/

mngon du 'gyur pa nyid kyang lam gyi yon tan gsar du bzhag pa ma yin gyi/ 'khor ba gzung 'dzin gnyis gdod nas med pa la/ med par rtogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas lugs de bzhin nyid la zhugs par byed pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs yin no/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs gyur nas/ zhes pa nas brtsams te rnal 'byor chen po yin la/ de la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang dag rdzogs/ zhes sogs sku rdo rje byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ a ni kha dog dmar ldan pa/ zhes sogs gsung rdo rje byin gyis rlobs pa dang sngags pas snying gar nyi ma yi/ zhes sogs thugs rdo rje byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ so sor byin gyis rlabs nas ni/ zhes sogs rdo rje gsum kar thun mong du byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /de ltar bdag nyid byin rlabs nas/ zhes sogs ni sems dpa' gsum rtseg bsgom pa'o/ /gzhung 'di las skabs 'dir dbu rgyan gyi gsal kha ma mdzad pa ni/ 'og tu dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bsgom pa'i tshe/ rigs bdag gis dbang bskur ba yod pas/ rgyal mchog bsgom phyin dbang bskur lan gnyis mi dgos par dgongs la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog mi bsgom pa rnal 'byor bzhi bskyed lta bu 'dir nges par dgos te/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i/ /bdag nyid sku gsung thugs rdo rjes/ /snying gar ye shes dam tshig dang*/ /dbu rgyan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog/sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes 'gyur pa/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin te/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa'i mchog/dam tshig mchog gis rab tu bya/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ da lta'i lag len la ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog sgom par 'gyur yang*/ skabs 'dir rigs bdag bsgom pa nyid de/ 'di nyid kyi 'grel pa rnams kyi yang dgongs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir rgyas pa'i lugs la de ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang gzhung gi dngos bstan la/

rgyal mchog gi skabs su yang dbu rgyan rigs bdag bshad pa tsam ma gtogs/ dbang ji ltar bskur mi gsal yang 'grel pa rnams dang man ngag phal cher mthun par/ byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba nyid yin pa/ rigs bdag bstan pas de yang bstan pa'o/ /de ltar sbyor ba che bskyed nas/ /zhes pa ni/ de yan chad kyis rnal 'byor chen po dngos song ba yin te/ rig ma sgrub pa dang mchod pa ni/ rnal 'byor chen po'i yan lag gam rjes kyi bya bar bsdu'o/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yi ni/ /zhes sogs rig ma sgrub pa ste/ gzugs bzang zhes pa nas shin tu mos kyi bar ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i dbang du byas so/ /dbang gi spyi bor zhes pa la sogs pa/ oṃ las byung ba'i rnal par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i don no/ /lha mo gzugs rdo rje la sogs zhes sogs la rig ma'i lus la lha mo bsgom pa de/ yab kyi sku la bkod pa'i sa'i snying po sogs dang mnyam par sbyor ro/ /zhes pa nyid tshig don du snang ngo*/ khro mo rnams ni cha byad yab khro bo bcu dang mtshungs pa yin la/ ral gcig ma bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i yum du byed pa ni/ spyi'i rnam gzhag dang mi mthun yang/ de sgrol ma'i rigs kyi khro mo yin pas/ las kyi rigs su mtshungs par sbyar ba la dgongs pa ste 'gal bar mi bsam mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi ni/ rang snang gi yum la mtshan so sor btags pa'o gsungs shing*/ nam mkha'i rdo rje ma dang sa 'dzin lha mo gnyis kyang rang snang gi yum nyid yin nam snyam mo/ /spyir khro bo drug po de la shes rab ma nges can rgyud gzhan du gsungs mod kyi lugs 'dir ni de tsam mo/ /de ltar 'dus byas rnal 'byor bas sogs ni rdo rje dang padma byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /de 'og sgrub pa brtsam par bya/ zhes sogs rjes chags dang*/ phyung nas sngags pas slar yang ni/ zhes pa la sogs pa mchod pa'o/

/rang sngags yi ge las byung ba/ zhes pa nas/ sa yi 'og tu de bzhugs so/ /zhes pa'i bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha tshogs spro ba bstan pa yin te/ dngos su na sangs rgyas thams cad lus la zhugs pa nyid mchod pa dang*/ de las dkyil 'khor sprul pa lta bu'i tshig tu gsal la/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang sgron gsal sogs gung bstun na/ mchod pa yan chad dang po sbyor bar bsdu ba gtso che bas/ dang sbyor dang rgyal mchog sa mtshams phyed pa dgos pa'i phyir/ slar yang sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/ yab yum gyi lus dkyil zhu ba dang lhan cig padmar babs pa la dkyil 'khor bskyed na/ sgrub thabs gzhan dang mthun pas legs par 'gyur la/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa gzhung 'dir gsal bar mi 'byung bas/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe yum gyi mngal gnas nyid gzhal yas khang gi dod yin pas/ gzhal yas khang ma bsgoms kyang skyon mi skyed par mngon la/ 'on kyang 'grub na bsgom pa legs shing*/ lag len du yang bsgom pa nyid la snga phyi thams cad mthun no/ /'on kyang bla ma gong ma rnams rjes chags kyi byang chub kyi sems cha gsum du byas/ cha gcig mchod pa cha gcig gzhal yas khang*/ cha gcig cha so gnyis su gyur pa las/ lhar bskyed cing bsrung ba dang*/ lus dkyil gyi lha rnams zhu bas lha dang*/ lus kyi gzhal yas khang zhu ba las gzhal yas khang bskyed par bzhed do/ /rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs dag/ces pa ni/ sa bon hūṃ ngam 'byin sngags badzra dhri ka ces pa la sogs pa rnams yi ge 'bru gsum gyi bar du spel ba'i don no/ /zhe sdang rdo rje zhes pa ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /snga ma'i gzugs ni yongs gyur nas/ zhes pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang la mi bskyod pa thim pas rdo rje 'chang mi bskyod par gyur pa'i don yin no/ /'bras bu'i mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal du 'pho ba dang*/ drag po zhing dang 'dod chags cha/ zhes pas/ rtsa zhal khro ba/

g.yas zhal zhi ba/ g.yon zhal chags pa'i nyams can du bsgyur ba yin gyi/ lhag ma sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs la mi 'dra ba med do/ /phyag mtshan 'di dag la 'phags yum gyi shing rta chen po 'ga' zhig / g.yas yas rim dang*/ g.yon mas rim du bzhed pa'ang byung mod kyi/ thams cad yas rim du byed pa nyid 'phags skor pa phal cher gyi 'dod pa'o/ /dpa' bo rang gi phyag rgyas 'khyud ces pa ni sngar gyi rig ma de yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi reg bya rdo rje ma ma yin te/ de'i spro bsdu byas ma zin pa'i phyir ro/ /bgegs mthar byed ljang khur 'chad pa yang byung ba/ rgya skad du shya ma ces pa ljang khu la 'jug pa'ang yod mod/ 'dir utpal sngon po'i 'dab ltar rgyas/ zhes gsungs bas/ sngo sangs kho nar gsal/ mdor byas kyi dpe rnying mang po na/ khro bo lhag ma drug la sngo dang dmar dang dkar zhes 'byung la/ rdo rje snying 'grel gyi khro bcu yang phal cher 'di dang 'dra ba yin pa las/ de yang de bzhin du 'byung mod/ 'on kyang 'phags skor ba phal cher sku mdog nag po rnams kyi zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar du nges par 'chad do/ /rgyud las ni/ mi g.yo ba'i skabs su/ zhi ba ral gri zhags pa bsnams/ zhes dang*/ 'dod rgyal gyi skabs su/ rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ zhes sogs yod kyang*/ 'phags skor gyi man ngag las de ltar mi mdzad pa gzhung na gsal te/ khro bo bcu kar cher khros pa'o/ /lha ni sum cu gnyis rang bzhin/ ces pa la sogs pas/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor bstan no/ /slong mo za zhing mi bzla ste/ zhes pa la sogs pas rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang phyi rol gyi bzlas pa gnyis bstan no/ /slar yang sngags pa sogs kyis gtso bo de bzhin nyid la zhugs pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gnas pa yis/ sogs ni/ glus bskul zhing bzhengs pa'o/ /de ltar yang dag yon tan ni sogs ni bstod pa ste/ de ltar 'khor lo sogs kyis mchod pa yang bstan no/

/rang gi 'khor lo sogs ni nye bar bsdu ba/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang bcas pa bstan no/ /sngags pas ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa'i tshe/ zhes sogs kyis sgrub pa po gzi brjid bskyed pa ste/ spyi bo'i steng mtho gang tsam gyis spags par/ baṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin/ oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan no/ /de las ye shes lnga'i ngo bo bdud rtsi kha dog sna lnga babs pas/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi mthar thug pa'i lus thams cad gang bar bsam pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len no/ /de ltar slob pa'i sngags pa yis/ zhes pa la sogs pa/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bstan te/ de ltar sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis mdor bstan/ hūṃ gis legs sbyang sogs kyis rgyas par bshad do/ /de yang kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs nas/ lkog ma sbyang ba ni mgrin par hrīḥlas byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hūṃ sngon po las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dbus rwa sbubs can gyi rtse mor oṃ yig go /de las 'od zer 'phros pa zas la phog par bsam/ snying ga sbyang ba ni/ sna tshogs pad nyi la hūṃ sngon po las me lce rtse mo gsum 'phro ba bsam la/ lag pa dgang gzar blugs gzar du mos te/ oṃ gyi 'od zer 'phul bas rdo rje'i rwa sbubs brgyud nas/ snying ga'i hūṃ yig lha thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'bul te nang gi sbyin sreg go /'dir sprin gyi sgra zhes pa ni oṃ yig gi ming yin la/ kha cig mgrin pa dung gi rnam par bsgom zhes kyang zer te/ 'ga' zhig gis de ltar bshad pa ni/ mgrin pa'i ri mo dung gi 'khyil ba ltar yod pa'i don tsam zhig yin gyi/ dung gi gzugs bsgom pa min no/ /de'i rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rlung gis me ni 'bar byed pa/ zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ gsang gnas su yaṃ las rlung*/ lte bar raṃ las me/ snying gar laṃ las sa/

mgrin par baṃ las chu rnams bsgoms te/ rlung gis me sbar/ des sa bsregs/ des chu bskol/ des kha zas rnams zhu nas/ mgrin pa'i padma nas zhugs/ snying gar sleb pa na/ dngas mas lha rnams tshim/ lte bar sleb pa na ram gyi mes snyigs ma rnams bsregs te thal bar gyur pa/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo nas brgyud/ rlung shugs kyis brdas te 'og sgo nas thon par bsam/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor drag tu bzung ngo*/ /de ltar goms par byas na nad dang dug la sogs pas mi tshugs shing*/ dus min gyi 'chi ba bzlog pa yin no/ zhes pa'o/ de la kha sbyor zhes pa ni rlung kha sbyor dang*/ gsang ba'i padma zhes pa ni gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor ro/ /nang gi sbyin sreg gi phan yon bstan pa ni/ rim sogs med cing zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ / de la kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab dgos na/ gtor ma'i cho ga gang gi rjes su 'brang zhe na/ 'phags skor gyi rtsa ba'i gzhung la gtor chog med cing*/ bar skabs kyi mkhas pa chen po dag dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba las bshad pa'i 'dus pa'i gtor chog de sbyor bar mdzad pa dang*/ yang rjes su byon pa'i mkhas pa kha cig gzhi de ga dang mthun pa la/ bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba dang sgron gsal sogs las legs btus su mdzad pa'ang yod pa de dag kyang mi legs pa ma yin mod/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang rgyud 'grel sogs dang mi 'gal phyin/ brgyud pa'i man ngag la rtsis su bya dgos pas/ za hor gyi mkhas pa shanta de ba dang*/ rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga las shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba dpal mchog srubs shing gis zhes pa la sogs pa lugs 'di bshad rgyud gang la brten te brtsams pa dang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'o/ /gzhung 'di la chag lo'i 'gyur yang yod mod kyi/ lo tsa ba rin chen bzang bo'i 'gyur gyi dbang du byas te bshad pa'o/ /lugs 'di'i bskyed rim gyi gzhung mdor byas dang mdo bsre dang rnam gzhag rim pa ste gsum kar la/

snga rabs pa rngog ston yab sras kyi bshad pa yod cing*/ phyis kyi 'phags skor ba rnams kyis kyang bshad pa rgyas po mang du snang bas dang*/ bskyed rim gyi gzhung 'di rnams tshig don phal cher go sla bar yang snang bas rgyas par ni ma smos mod/ 'di tsam gyis lugs 'di'i rim pa dang po'i rnam gzhag phyin ci ma log par rtog par 'gyur ro/ /yang rnam grangs su na/ mkhas pa chen po abha yā ka ra gupta'i zhal snga nas/ 'di skad ces 'byung ste/ yud kyis lhag par mos pas bskyed pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi sku ni/ bar do'i srid pa'i gnas skabs bzhin no/ /de rim pas 'gog pa'i rjes su nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ padma dang yi ge gsum dang*/ brtan pa dang*/ g.yo ba ro mnyam par gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems phyag mtshan dang sa bon yongs su gyur pa'i dang po'i mgon po'i sku ting nge 'dzin gyi sems dpa'i ming can hūṃ 'god pa ji srid pa ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs bzhin no/ /de'i rjes su btsas pa'i gnas skabs lta bu ni/ gzugs dang lang tsho la sogs pas brgyan pa'i bu mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs so/ /de ni spros pa'i mi bskyod pa bcug pa las/ sngar ni 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid na yang gzugs dkar por mi 'gal te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu dag gzhan par nges pa med pas so /zhes dang*/ de nyid kyi phyir 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das kyang dri za 'jug pa med par yang zhu bar gyur pa bsdus pa'i rim par gsungs te/ de'i gnas skabs kyi yang gdul byar rung ba rnams ma byung ba na/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi sku kho nas gnas pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ byung na ni snying rje dang byams pa dang dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms chen po'i rang bzhin sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo spyan ma dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma rnams kyis slar yang slong bar byed do/

/zhes bshad de/ lhag mos bar do dang*/ dang po'i mgon po rdzogs pa yan chad mngal gyi gnas skabs dngos dang*/ de nas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i bar/ mngal gyi gnas skabs kyi yan lag byis pa'i dus dang 'dra bar dgongs pa sogs yin no/ kha cig 'di mi 'thad de/ rnam gzhag rim pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir zhes 'gog mod kyang*/ slob dpon 'dis rnam gzhag rim pa zhal gyis mi bzhes pa'i phyir de khegs par ni mi 'gyur la/ 'on kyang rang lugs la rnam gzhag rim pa gzhung shin tu bzang shing*/ klu byang gis mdzad par bla ma gong ma thams cad mgrin gcig tu bzhed pas/ re zhig lugs 'di gnyis las/ rnam gzhag rim pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa ni/ rgyas par abha yā ka ras mdzad pa'i man ngag snye ma las rtogs par bya la thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud dang*/ klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang*/ rnam gzhag rim par zhal gsum gyi dag pa sogs sbyar bas kyang nges pa rnyed par 'gyu ro/ /de ltar na khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor phra rags kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa des ni/ ji skad du/gzugs dang sgra dang ro ldan pa/ shes rab can gyis zla drug bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyod pa spyod pa'i dus sam/ rig pa'i rtul zhugs mi spyod kyang rung ste/ le'u bcu bdun pa las/ lus kyi rnam gsum thams cad ni/ /rdo rje las ni 'byung bar bya/ /sems can khams ni thams cad du/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas sku byed pa'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du/ dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams kyi sgra ji bzhin pa dag kyang*/ sems can gyi don du spyod par nus pa yin la/ gzhan yang lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ bde bar gnas na byang chub thob/ ces dang*/ 'das na rdo rje gsum bdag nyid/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje ma rungs 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dka' thub sgom pa mi bzad pas/

/bsten kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /brten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /sngags kyi spyod pa mchog spyod rnams/ /chos mchog mi g.yo brnyes pa yang*/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pas so/ /zhes pa la sogs pa 'dod yon lam du byed tshul ji snyed gcig gsungs pa thams cad kyang*/ gnas skabs de tsam na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa'i skabs kyang*/ spyir de bzhin yin mod kyi/ der ni ye shes kyi rnal rol mtha' yas pa nyid gtso bor 'jug pas/ phyi rol gyi 'dod yon rnam pa gcig tu na gtso che ba min pas/ phyi rol gyi 'dod yon lam byed gtso che ba'i skabs ni/ rim pa dang po'i skabs 'di dag yin par shes par bya'o/ /de ni bdag cag gi bla ma'i bla ma de ba sambha ba'i zhabs bzhin te/ rnam par dbye ba 'di yang*/ de nyid kyi bka' las 'byung ngo zhes thos so/ /'dir the tshom gzhan zhig 'byung ste/ las dang po pas kyang rang dang rjes su mthun pa sgom nus na/ sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi gnad rgyas pa yod pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa nyid bsgom pa mchog yin pa dang rgyas par rang dang rjes mthun yang sgom par mi nus pas ni/ dpa' bo gcig pa sogs bsgom pa de ni thabs gzhan med pa'i phyir 'os med kyi rig pa sbyar ba yin pas phyis bsgom par nus pa'i tshe/ rgyas pa kho na bsgom dgos sam snyam mo/ /de'i lan ni shin tu las dang po pas bsdus pa bsgom pa de yang*/ bya thabs gzhan med nas byed pa kho na ma yin te/ dran pa gcig pa la de tsam gyis kyang go chod pa yin no/ /phyis nus na rgyas pa bzang mod kyang*/ bsdus pas go mi chod pa ni ma yin te/ bskyed rim bsgom pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo tha mal gyi snang zhen bsgyur nas/ dag pa'i lhar snang khyad par gsum ldan du byed pa nyid yin na/

don gyi gtso bo de ni bsdus pa la yang tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi rim pa zhib mo rnams/ lam gyi rno khyad dang mos pa brtan pa'i phyir yin gyi/ dran pa gcig pa bsdus pa rnams kyis kyang*/ 'chi bar skye gsum gyi srid pa sbyor ba dang*/ sku gsum lam du byed mi nus pa ni ma yin no/ /'o na gsang sngags phyi pa'i sgrub thabs phra mo rnams la'ang de bzhin du 'gyur ro snyam na/ skyed chog gi khyad par mi 'dra ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyud sde so so'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi lha'i rnam pa dang*/ sngags kyi khyad par la/ byin rlabs 'jug tshul tha dad pa nyid du byin gyis rlabs pa'i phyir/ skyon de yod pa ma yin gyi/ dper na lha dang sngags gcig cing*/ cho ga phyogs 'dra ba la/ rgyud sde so so las gsungs pa rnams 'jug sgo dang spyod pa tha dad pa dgos pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa spyod bsdus las 'byung ba ltar lus rnam par dben pa bshad pa ste/ de la 'ga' zhig lus dben la bskyed rim gyis khyab pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig rdzogs rim gyis khyab pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gnyis kar ma yin pa'i ri thang mtshams pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig rigs brgya nas gsum gyi bar bskyed rim dang*/ gsang chen rigs gcig rdzogs rim mo/ /zhes pa lta bu gnyis kar gyi cha shas yod par 'dod pa sogs mi mthun pa sna tshogs yod pa ltar byung yang*/ so so'i 'dod pa'i phugs kyi blo rtse gtad mtshams la zhib mor bltas na 'gal ba chen po yang mi snang ste/ rdzogs rim gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'ga' zhig gis rdzogs rim du bshad pa dang*/ de ma thag pa'i dngos rgyu rnam rtog rang min yang spyir rnam rtog gi 'phen pa la ltos shing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu sngon byung ba rnams rnam rtog yin pa dang*/ bskyed rim dngos dang phal cher mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'i phyir gzhan 'gas bskyed rim du byas par snang zhing*/

de'i nang nas kyang zab mo bskyed rim yin par bzhed do/ /rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir gnyis min yang 'grub la/ gnyis ka'i cha 'dod pa yang*/ bde stong las lha skur ldang thub pa gsang chen rigs gcig dang*/ mi thub pa'i lha sku rnams rigs brgya sogs su bsam par snang pas mi 'thad pa ci rigs yod mod/ de dag rang la dgag sgrub cher mi dgos par snang ngo*/ /des na lus dben gyi rnam gzhag la dben gzhi'i lus dang*/ gang las dben pa'i spang bya dang*/ de las dben pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum mo/ / dang po ni/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa drug gi lus ni mtshan gzhi yin la/ de nyid la phung po dang*/ 'byung ba dang*/ skye mched la sogs pa mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba sna tshogs gnas pa ni/ so so'i mtshan nyid yin zhing*/ lus kyi yan lag la sogs pa nas mthar rdul phran gyi bar du bshig na/ rdul phran tsam 'dus pa dang*/ shes pa la rnam par phye na yang*/ blo rigs mi 'dra ba du ma'i rang bzhin dang*/ re re yang snga phyi bar gsum du rnam par phye na/ mthar skad cig ma sil bur gnas pa las gzhan med pa ni spyi'i mtshan nyid do/ /gnyis pa gang las dben pa'i spang bya ni/ mtshan gzhi dang*/ mtshan nyid de lta bu la phyin ci log gi blo gros log par zhugs te/ mi gtsang ba'i phung po nyid la gtsang zhing bzang bar rtog pa dang*/ du ma sil bu la dngos po rags pa gcig pu gong bur 'dzin pa dang*/ thun mong du bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ phung sogs dngos po bden par 'dzin pa dang tha mal du mngon par zhen pa rnams yin no/ /gsum pa de las dben pa'i ting nge 'dzin la/ ngo bo dang*/ rgyu dang*/ dbye ba dang mthar phyin pa'i tshad gsum las/ dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud sbyong bsdus su drangs pa/ 'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /gar mkhan dang ni ri mo bzang ltar snang*/ /gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu nyams ni du mas gar mdzad do/

/zhes pa ste/ bde bas sems lha skur shar ba gcig dgos la/ bde ba de yang sgom stobs kyis rlung dbu mar thim pa'i zhu ba de'i mtshan nyid can gcig yin pa/ de dngos su rnam rtogs la brten nas bskyed ma dgos par/ lha skur shar ba yin pa de yang yid ngo dang blo ngor lha skur shar ba tsam las/ gzhan dngos su lha skur langs pa ma yin pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa ltar na/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gi skabs su phra thig sgom pa ste/ le'u gsum par/ rin chen brtan par gyur na spro/ zhes sogs dang*/ le'u drug par/ utpal mthing ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /rtse mo lnga pa khyad par du/ /nas kyi 'bru tsam nan tan gyis/ /sna'i rtse mor rnam par bsam/ /tsa na ka yi 'bru tshad tsam/ /'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar bcas/ /sna yi rtse mor 'di shes te/ /bsgom pas byang chub gzhol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang ba'i sna rtse ltar bur/ yig 'bru phyag mtshan la sogs pa/ bsgom pa brtan por gyur pa na/ gnas de na kun rdzob kyi dbu ma'i mas sna yod pas/ der ro rkyang gi rlung zhugs pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ thim pa'i rim pas/ dbu ma las gzhan pa'i rtsa phran gyi 'bar 'dzag 'byung zhing*/ de la rim pas goms pas/ mthar dbu ma'i mas sna rlung dang thig le cung zad zhugs shing brtan pa'i bde stong gi nyams yang yang drangs shing goms par byas pa dang*/ ma mtha' yang lha gcig yan chad kyi gsal snang cung zad grub pa gcig dgos te/ de ni lus dben gyi rgyu yin no/ /dgyes rdor gyi sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las 'byung ba lta bu la sogs pa bskyed rim dang lhan cig 'khor lo bzhi'i gtum mo bsgom pa sogs la ni/ gong du bshad pa'i phra thig de 'dra mi dgos pas/ des na thun mong ma yin pa'i bde bskyed byed du phra thig de ni mtshon byed de/ gzhan yang dmigs pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /skabs 'di'i bde ba yang cha phra mod kyi/

de la bltos pa'i snang ba gsum mam bzhi'i cha shas su 'byung bas/ rang bzhin gyi rnam rtog mtha' dag 'gags pa min yang*/ rang bzhin rnam rtog gi cha shas phra mo tsam thim pa yin no/ /rgyu de las lus dben ji ltar bskyed pa ni/ lhar snang dang bde ba gnyis kar goms pa des/ sa bon phyag mtshan nam/ gtum mo'am las rgya la sogs pas/ bde ba sgrub pa'i skabs rnam rtog gi rtsol ba yod kyi bar du/ phyi nang gi dmigs pa la sems gtod bzhin du/ mi rtog pa'i bde ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba 'di las nam sad pa na/ rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par lha'i skur 'char bar snyam pa'i 'dun pa tsam sbyong zhing*/ de'i mthar dar cig bde la mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis sems gnas par 'gyur la/ de las langs ba'i skabs rtsol ba'i rnam rtog bskyed mi dgos par/ lha sku rang shar du 'byung zhing*/ de'i tshe mi rtog pa dngos sad kyang mi rtog pa'i zhad yod cing*/ bde ba'i rtsi ma yal te/ lha sku dang bde ba zung 'brel du 'byung ngo*/ bskyed rim phra rags dngos kyi skabs su dngos kyi rgyu rnam rtog gi rtsol ba med na/ mi rtog pa las gcig car ldang yang mi thub cing*/ mi rtog pa las langs thub kyang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bde ba ma thob pa'i phyir/ de las ldang rgyu med cing*/ langs kyang mi rtog pa nyid kyi rnam rol las/ bde ba dang lha sku zung 'brel yang mi 'byung la/ 'dir de dag 'byung bas/ spyir lus dben 'di bskyed rdzogs gang du bsdu dgos ni soms shig dang*/ yongs su grags pa'i bskyed rim phra rags rnams las khyad par du 'phags tshul ni de yin no/ /tshul rnam pa 'di lta bus lha gcig kho na las lhag po bskyed mi thub kyang*/ de thub na lus dben gyi rim par rtogs la/ rtog pa'i rtsol bas bskyed dgos na| dkyil 'khor rab 'byams sgom thub kyang*/ bskyed rim dngos yin gyi lus dben min no/

/des na rtog pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin nas dkyil 'khor mang po spro bsdu nus kyang*/ bde stong gi lha sku rtsol med du 'char nus pa la da dung yun ring du bslab dgos shing*/ rtsol bcas kyi skabs dkyil 'khor mang po 'char thub kyang*/ skabs 'dir rtsol med du 'char dgos pa'i skabs/ lha re re las bskyed mi thub pa yang yod la/ dbang po shin tu rno na rtsol bcas kyi skabs las 'dir mang pa yang 'char ba yang srid/ dbang po 'bring pos bskyed lugs kyi khyad ma gtogs/ mang nyung mnyam par 'chang ba yang srid pas/ kha cig rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob phyin lus dben rigs brgya la slob pa la dka' tshegs med cing*/ gal te dka' tshegs yod na/ bskyed rdzogs go rim nges pa can ma byas par rim pa thod rgal du byas pa'i skyon no snyam du sems pa ni pho tshod tsam yin kyang*/ spyir nas rim pa rgal yang skyon du mi 'gyur ba shin tu mang bar ma zad/ da lta'i gang zag la rim pa brgal ba nges par dgos pa'ang yod do/ /gsum pa dbye ba ni/ rgyud phyi ma las/ de nyid rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ gsang ba rnam pa gsum du bshad/ lhag pa'i lha ni gsang chen te/ dam pa rigs ni rnam pa brgya/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ dam pa rigs brgya'i lus dben/ de nyid rigs lnga'i lus dben/ gsang ba rigs gsum gyi lus dben/ gsang chen rigs gcig gi lus dben rnams so/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ zhes phung po lnga po rgyal ba rigs lngar bsgom pa las/ re re bzhin yang nang tshan rgyal ba rigs lnga lngas phye bas rgyal ba nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /sa ni spyan ma zhes bya ba yin/ chu'i khams ni mā ma kī/ dkar dang sgron ma zhes bya ba/ me dang rlung du rab tu bsgrags/ zhes 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhir dag pa las/ nang tshan rgyal ba rigs lnga lnga'i dbye bas yum nyi shu'o/

/rdo rje skye mched nyid dag kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog/ces skye mched drug ni sems dpa' drug yin la/ de re re yang rigs lnga lngas phye bas sum cu byung yang*/ yid 'jam dpal gyi lnga po logs su bzhag nas/ byang chub sems dpa' nyer lnga'o/ /gzugs sgra la sogs sngags pa yis/ lha nyid du ni rtag tu sgoms/ zhes gzugs sogs yum lnga ni rdo rje ma lnga'i dag pa can yin la/ de re re la'ang rigs lnga lngar phye bas/ lha mo nyi shu rtsa lnga yin pas/ de ltar na khyab bya dgu bcu go lnga la khyab byed ye shes lnga yod pa/ 'jam dpal lnga dang gcig tu bsres pas lnga tshan gcig ste brgya tham pa'o/ /spyod bsdus kyi bshad tshul de ltar yin la/ 'ga' zhig las 'jam dpal lnga ma bgrangs par/ rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma lnga bsnan pa yang yod de/ 'di rnams zhi ba rigs brgya'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /de yang brgya'i grangs kyi dbang du rtsis nas de ltar byas kyi/ spyir bye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas nges pa med de/ khro bo khro mo pho nya phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams zhi ba'i rnam 'phrul yin pas 'dir 'dus par dgongs nas ma bshad pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na de dag gi lus dben yang dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ /phung khams brgya'i dbye ba dang*/ rigs brgya'i lha bskyed tshul rnams 'gos lugs kyi khrid yig tu bshad zin la/ don gyi snying po gzugs phung stong nyid du sbyangs nas/ de'i rang bzhin rnam snang du sgom mo snyam pa'i 'phen pa sngon du btang nas/ bde stong la mnyam par bzhag pas de las langs dus rnam snang rigs lnga byung*/ 'di ni mnyam bzhag gi lus dben kho na yin/ thog ma'i skabs kyi rjes thob spyod lam ni/ bskyed rim dang 'dra bar mos sgom byed pa yin no/ /'di la brtan pa thob nas mnyam bzhag gong dang 'dra ba las rjes thob kyi lus dben bsgoms te/

lus dben gyi lha sku de ma yal bar byas nas/ gzugs snang lta bu gcig gi steng du de bzhag ste snang ba de dang bsres/ de bde bas rgyas btab/ de yang stong par rgyas btab ste sgom pas/ ma dag pa'i snang ba de 'gags te/ lus dben gyi lha'i rnam pa 'khor dang bcas par snang bar 'gyur la/ de shin tu goms na/ des kyang nang du bde ba 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du thams cad la sbyar te/ rigs brgya'am/ rigs sna tshogs pa du ma'am/ rigs brgya nyid nas lha mtha' med pa'i bar du yang 'gyur te/ rigs brgya'i sgom tshul ni de ltar yin no/ /phyi ma rnams la sgom tshul 'di nyid ma gtogs lhag po med na/ brgya la lobs nas/ lnga nas gcig gi bar la logs su bslab mi dgos par zhor la lobs par 'gyur mod kyang*/ sgom thabs lhag po re yod pas/ de dag phyis sgom par gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan bskyed tshul snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ lha de dag re re bzhin yang*/ rigs lnga'i rgyas btab can du shes dgos pas/ snang ba'i cha nas sku rdo rje/ grags pa'i cha nas gsung rdo rje/ stong pa'i cha nas thugs rdo rje/ bde ba'i cha nas yon tan rdo rje/ ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la snying rje 'jug pa'i cha nas/ las kyi rdo rje ste/ mos pa'i sgo nas lha thams cad la rgyas btab pas/ de dang de'i rnam par gsal snang 'char ba yin no/ /des ni rnam rtog gis ma brtags par rang shugs nyid du sngar gyi lha rnams phra zhing mang bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar mngon du gyur pa de la'ang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas btab byed pa ste/ rigs lnga'i ye shes rnam pa lnga po de rnams re re nas de dang de'i snang ba ni sku dang*/ snang ba de nyid rig pas nyams su myong ba ni gsung dang*/ de'i rang bzhin brjod bral mi rtog par bzhag pa ni thugs te/ de ltar rgyas btab cing bsgoms pas/ snga ma las kyang ches mang zhing phra ba/

rdul phran gyi mthar gtugs pa/ lha sku la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi snang bar dngos su rtogs par 'gyur te/ 'di dag kyang mos pa'i khyad par ma gtogs phyogs bcu'i snang ba thams cad de ltar 'gyur ba ma yin te/ rang lus tsam mam/ phyi rol gyi dngos po gcig sogs dmigs pa gang gtad pa la de ltar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ de dag thams cad la zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa rang bzhin stong par shar ba de kho nas rgyas btab pas/ lha sku'i snang ba de ma yal kyang*/ rdul phran ltar shin tu phra bar 'gro bas/ nyi zer gyi rdul bar snang la 'dres pa bzhin du stong pa gcig gi ngo bor snang ba ni rigs gcig tu gyur pa'i don no/ /de ltar man ngag las/ lha brgya phrag dang*/ lnga dang*/ gsum dang gcig tu sgom pa la sogs pa ni/ lus dben rjes mthun pa sgom tshul te/ de nyid lus dben dngos kyi bskyed tshul du mos pa byas pas lus dben gyi rtogs pa 'dren par byed pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba yin no/ /lus dben phyi ma 'di dag lus dben 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas mthar phyin pa'ang yod la/ phal cher 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rdor bzlas sogs dang bsres te bsgoms pas/ mthar phyin par 'gyur ba mang ngo*/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'phen pa mi dgos shing/ 'dod na rgyu bde stong dang 'bras bu lha sku gnyis ka /gang 'dod 'dod skyong yang thub la/ yang myur bar 'dod na/ skad cig tsam la bde stong gi nyams las lha skur ldang yang thub cing*/ dmigs pa gang gtad pa de/ lha sku rags pa gcig las lha sku phra mo mtha' yas pa/ bde stong gi nang du thim pa snyam byed pa/ de nam 'dod yong zhing ci 'dod 'khyongs pa yin no/ /da ni 'di dpyad par bya ste/ kha cig lus dben la bskyed rim dang*/ bskyed rim ma yin pa'i cha gnyis yod de/ /lhag mos lus la bsdus pa dang*/ lus dkyil la sogs pa bskyed rim gyi lus dben yin la/ rdzogs rim gyi lus dben ni skabs 'di'i yin zhing*/

rdzogs rim pa'i ye shes kyi sku dngos su ma 'grub kyang*/ phra thig gis rlung dbu mar bcug pa'i bde ba de rdzogs rim yin pas/ de las skyes pa'i phyir 'di yang rdzogs rim mo zhes 'chad na/ rdzogs rim yin tshul de la 'gal ba cher mi snang yang*/ lus dkyil sogs lus dben du 'dod pa ni/ blos btags kyis tha snyad gsar pa sbyar na ma gtogs/ rim lnga dang spyod bsdus su bshad pa'i lus dben dngos dang rjes mthun gang yang ma yin no/ /de dag lus dben yin na/ bskyed rim gyi bzlas pa yang dag dben dang*/ lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdu ba dang dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu sogs sems dben dang 'od gsal/ dang po'i mgon po bskyed pa sogs sgyu lus dang zung 'jug tu thal bar 'gyur la/ de yang de lta na bskyed rim la yang rim lnga yod pa dang*/ rim lnga'i go rim yang 'khrugs par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /des na lus dben du ma zad/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid nyams su ma slongs pa'i ngag dben man chad kyang*/ mtshan ma dang bcas shing rnam rtog gi rtsol ba'i rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bskyed rim du gtogs te/ man ngag gzhan las 'byung ba'i 'khor lo bzhi'i gtum mo la sogs pa dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim du grags pa thams cad do/ /'di dag la zab mo bskyed rim dang*/ dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim zhes rim pa gnyis kar gyi ming 'dogs pa ni/ rang gi ngo bo bskyed rim tu rtogs pa dang*/ rdzogs rim la shin tu phan 'dogs shing*/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes bskyed pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu'i bya ba byed pas na gnyis yin du btags pa ste/ dper na rgyal rigs kyi bu zhig/bram ze'i g.yog po byed na/ de nyid rgyal rigs yin kyang*/ de'i bya ba thams cad bram ze'i bya ba yin pas/ de'i byas pa rnams bram zes byas par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /des na spyod bsdus las/

rdzogs rim dngos sems dben yan chad du bshad pa dang*/ ngag dben la bskyed rim gyi yul las 'das par bshad pa gnyis kar mi 'gal te/ ngag dben la rdzogs rim dngos yin min gnyis ka yod pas/ rdzogs rim 'dres med nyag gcig ni/ sems dben yan chad yin pa dang*/ ngag dben dmigs bcas tshun chod kyang*/ bskyed rim zhes yongs su grags che zhing kun la grags pa'i dran pa gcig pa dang*/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i spyod yul ma yin pa ste/ des de'i phyogs su ma phyin pa'i don no/ /sngags kyi de kho na nyid la dmigs thub pa'i ngag dben ni/ rdzogs rim gyi lam dngos su 'jog go /'o na lus dben ngag dben gnyis kar dmigs bcas kyi rdzogs rim yin mnyam la/ ngag dben dmigs bcas bskyed rim pa'i yul ma yin pa dang*/ lus dben bskyed rim pa dang thun mong bar bshad pa ci snyam na/ lus dben ni phra thig mthar phyin pa'i rang shugs la cung zad 'byung ba yang yod de bskyed rim gyis drangs pa'i rdzogs rim mam/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gyi drangs pa'i rdzogs rim zhes zer ro/ /de'i phyir rtog pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i spyod yul du gyur la/ lus dben logs su ched du gtad nas sgom pa'i skabs yin yang*/ rtog pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa yin na/ 'bad rtsol gyis sgrub mi dgos par lus dben shugs kyis 'byung la/ der ma zad bde ba dang*/ lha sku'i nyams myong bskyed rim phra mo rtog pa'i rnal 'byor las ches bzang zhing khyad che yang dmigs pa sgom tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad thon pa med par/ bskyed rim gyi nang nas 'ga' zhig zur du bkol te sgom pa lta bur yod la/ ngag dben ni dmigs pa'i khyad par yang mi 'dra ba che la/ bskyed rim mthar phyin yang rtsal shugs phyung ste 'bad pas ma bsgoms na/ bskyed rim dang lus dben gyi zhor la 'dren pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lus dben bskyed rdzogs ri thang mtshams pa dang*/

gnyis yin dang*/ gnyis min du 'dod tshul rnams/ gnad 'di rtogs na phyogs re nas 'gal ba med do/ /phal cher la grags pa ltar/ dngos btags ma phye ba ltar na/ lus dben dang*/ ngag dben gyi rim pa thams cad bskyed par mi bsdu ste rdzogs par bsdu'o/ /yang glan rtsad tshal sogs pa 'ga' zhig gi bzhed pa ltar*/ spyod bsdus las/ dam pa rig brgya mthar phyin nas/ ngag dben la 'jug dgos par bshad pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin je bzang du gyur pa na lha je mang du spro ba 'thad par bsam nas/ rigs brgya mthar gcig gi bar du bsdu ba ni/ bshad pa'i go rim tsam yin gyi/ sgom pa'i tshe de las ldog ste/ mthar thug rigs brgya la skyel dgos so snyam du sems shing smra bar snang yang*/ ma yin te rigs lnga rigs gsum rigs gcig la sogs pa'i bar du/ lhar snang nyung du song ba ma yin pa dang*/ bslab bya gzhan ni chos lhag po yod tshul gong du bshad pa ltar yin la/ spyod bsdus las kyang*/ snga ma snga ma shes nas phyi ma phyi ma la slob tshul du gsal bas/ dngos po'i go rim nyid yin gyi/ bshad pa'i go rim tsam min no/ /rigs brgya la lobs nas ngag dben la 'jug par gsungs pa ni/ rigs brgya mtshon byed de rigs mtha' yas pa'ang yod mod/ ji srid du rgyas btab gcig pa 'di mthar phyin gyi bar du/ lus dben kho na bsgoms pas chog pas/ lus dben phyi rim pa dngos yin la/ lhag ma 'di rnams lus dben gyi rnal 'byor yin yang*/ lus dben kho nas mi thob pa shas che bas/ lus dben gyi rim par mi 'gyur ba mang la/ shas che ba zhig rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang lhan cig tu bsgoms pas rim gyis 'grub pa ste/ gsang chen rigs gcig dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa mthar phyin pa dus mnyam mo/ /de'i phyir go rim gyi skabs su/ rigs brgya dang ngag dben la go rim mdzad pa'o/ /da ni skabs 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i phyir/ phung khams rigs brgya po rnams kyi ming sdoms kyi tshul du sbyar bar bya ste/

rigs byed min dang dbyibs dang bdag gzhan bkod/ kha dog gzugs dang 'od snang gzugs phung lnga//'khris bcas 'dus pa'i tshor dang btang snyoms dang*/ /bad rlung tshor dang bde sdug tshor ba lnga/ /rkang gnyis 'du shes mi g.yo mi rgyu shes/ /rkang bzhi rkang med rkang mang 'du shes lnga/ /yid kyi 'du byed lus dang khams gsum las/ /ngag dang thar ba'i las te 'du byed lnga/ /lus mig rna ba sna lce rnam shes lnga/ /dri ma rgyu ma mkhris pa de bzhin snying*/ /skra dang rus pa bshang ba mchin pa snying*/ /spu dang sen mo rnag dang khrag dang snying*/ /so dang pags pa sha dang snying du 'dod/ /rgyus pa sha dang rtsib ma snying zhes bya/ /de dag nang gi sa khams rnam lnga yin/ /lus 'phags ri rab 'dzam gling ba lang spyod/ /sgra mi snyan te phyi'i sa khams lnga/ /dri chu mchi mar bcas pa'i bad kan dang*/ /rdul dang khrag dang mchil ma nang gi chu/ /rgya mtsho 'bab chu phra mo chu bo'i chu/ /bkod ma lteng ka phyi yi chu khams lha/ /snying ga mgo bo lte ba'i me drod dang*/ /yan lag pho ba'i drod ni nang gi me/ /rgyun gzhag rdo ba'i me dag me shel skyes/ /shing bu las skyes nags kyi me ste phyi/ /srog rlung khyab byed thur sel gyen rgyu dang*/ /ma nyams zhes pa nang gi rlung lnga ste/ /shar dang steng dang lho nub byang ste phyi/ /phyi nang sbyar bas 'byung ba nyi shur 'dod/ /nam mkha' rags pa'i 'byung ba min phyir bzhag/'di ni re zhig mdo dang bstun pa yin gtan nas 'byung ba min par mi bzhed do/ /mig 'bras gzugs 'dzin tshil bu'i cha dang ni/ /zur gyis lta dang dbye ba mig gi brda/ /sna dbang rna ba'i phyi gzugs sgra gsum 'dzin/ /bu ga rtsa ba'i rtsa ste rna ba lnga/ /sna yi dbang po sna gzugs bar bkag dang*/ /dri 'dzin bu ga sna yi skye mched lnga/ /lce dbang dbyibs dang lce rtse'i rtsa dang ni/ /lce rtser ro gsum 'dzin pa lce'i khams/

/reg gsum 'dzin dang lus dbang rus pa'i tshogs/ /sha yi tshogs dang lpags pa'i tshogs te lus/ /srog gi rlung ni dbang po lnga la brten/ /yum lnga'i snang ba sna tshogs 'char bar byed/ /'gying bag sogs dang rgyu bzhi las byung mthong*/ /chags pa'i gzugs dang gzugs gsum dbye ba dang*/ /bya byed gzugs te gzugs kyi skye mched lnga/ /sgrib g.yogs med dang snang dang yid spyod dang*/ /dbang po'i tshogs par ldan pa rgyu bzhi'o/ /mi shigs sgra dang rna ba'i nad sogs sgra/ /rgyud chen sgra dang kha las byung ba'i sgra/ /nags tshal chu dang rol mo la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs sgra ste dbye ba lnga ru 'dod/ /dri nga dri yi tshogs dang yan lag dri/ /dri gsum dbye ba dbugs bral lus kyi dri/ kha ba mngar dang bska ba lan tsha'i ro/ /skyur dang tsha ba bsdoms pas ro lnga ste/ /gnyis sbyor reg bya stan gcig gnas pa dang*/ /'khyud dang 'o byed 'jibs pa reg pa lnga/ /rtsub dang 'jam dang drod dang sil ba dang*/ /bkres skom sogs kyang phyi'i reg byar 'dod/ /las nyon rnam rtog dag byed chos dbyings te/ /mang po gcig car gsal ba me long 'dra/ /'gro kun sems su shes pa mnyam nyid de/ /dngos kun rang bzhin sangs rgyas ngo bo las/ /dbye ba'i khyad par shes pa so sor rtog /sgo gsum bya ba rdzogs byed nan tan no/ /phung lnga 'byung bzhi dbang lnga yul lnga la/ /lnga lngar phye zhing khyab byed ye shes lnga/ /de rnams rigs brgya'i dag pa phung khams brgya/ /ye shes lnga dang 'jam dpal don gyis sbyor/ /dbye gzhi nyi shu spyi dang mtshungs par shes/ /zhes pa'o/ nyi shu po re re bzhin du mi bskyod rnam snang rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ don grub kyi rigs rnams su sbyor zhing*/ de las rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ni/ yid ngor gzugs kyi gsal snang shar ba la dngos 'dzin zhing*/ 'di skabs kyi gzugs phung yang*/ gzugs kyi skye mched phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa la ngos bzung ngo*/

/spyod bsdus na tshor ba mnyam pa nyid ces gsungs pa btang snyoms yin/ sa'i skabs na/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i lung drangs te/ /snying ni lnga la nges gnas te/ /sgo lnga rnam par 'byung ba ni/ /rmi lam rlung dang ldan pa ru/ /'dod pa lnga rnams spyod par byed/ /ces don snod lnga'i snying gis kyang*/ /srog gi rlung dang yid shes kyi rten byed cing*/ /sgo lnga'i rnam shes bskyed pa'i rlung 'byung ba dang*/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi snang ba bskyed par bshad pas/ snying ga'i 'khor lo dang gnad gcig par 'ong la/ yang yul lnga rgyas bshad kyi 'gor/ srog la sogs pa'i rlung lnga ni/ phung po lnga la brten nas phung po'i bya ba byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rtsa ba'i khams lnga'i rlung dang cung mi 'dra ste/ rtsa ba'i khams lnga char cung zad 'dres shing*/ rnam pa gzhan du gyur ba yin pas/ 'byung ba las gyur pa dang*/ phung po'i ming gis btags pa yin no/ /'dir gzugs kyi skye mched gsungs pa dang*/ gong gi gzugs phung zlos par 'gyur ro snyam na mi 'gyur te/ dbye sgo tha dad pa'i phyir dang snga ma yul du gnas pa'i cha nas 'jog cing*/'dir rlung gi de rnams gsal bar byed pa'i sgo nas 'jog go /de lta na/ phung khams de dag gi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung sems rnams dngos su lhar gyur nas/ rnal 'byor ba'i lus kyi bya ba byed nus pa/ sgyu lus kyi sku lta bu'i stobs dang nus par ldan pa skabs 'dir ma thob kyang*/ de ltar bu'i rgyu lus thob byed kyi thabs khyad par can skabs 'dir grub pa yin zhing*/ de yang phung khams de dang de'i dngas ma rlung sems kyi cha shas las/ 'ja' tshon bzhin du snang char shar ba tsam ni yin te/ skabs 'di nyid du gtogs pa'i bde ba chen po'i rgyu rkyen dngos byas/ phung khams de dang de'i rang bzhin lha skur 'char 'dod kyi sems dang lhag par mos pas lhan cig byed rkyen byas nas bde ba de/

phung khams de dang de'i dngas ma'i cha shas dang 'dres pa las yid ngor shar ba yin pas/ de rnams kyi dag pa la sbyor tshul/ bskyed rim mos pa lam byed kho na'i skabs dang mi 'dra ste/ dngos su dag par byed pa'i rigs su gtogs pa dang*/ dngos su bskyed thub pa'i cha shas tsam yin no/ /spyod bsdus las/ rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid ni/ /rdo rje 'chang chen po lhag par mos par bya ba ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya bar bshad do/ /zhes gsang chen rigs gcig gi skabs su bshad pa ni/ lus dben gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre bas/ byin rlabs kyi rnal 'byor bskyed rim dkrong bskyed yin par 'dod pa ni shin tu ma brtags pa'o/ /bskyed rim dkrong bskyed 'ga' zhig de 'dra rjes mthun pa'am lam du byed pa yin pas so snyam na/ de ltar na de 'dra sgyu lus dang zung 'jug kyang lam du byed pa yin pas/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor kyang bskyed rim thal bar 'gyur ba ma yin nam/ zhes bsam par bya'o// //gsum pa gzhung 'di nyid kyi tshig don dang 'brel ba rnams rgyas par bshad pa la/ gzhung rim pa lnga rim can du yod pa las/ dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa dngos bshad de/ 'di la yang mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis so/ /dang po la rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs tshul/ lha mo bzhis zhus las gsungs tshul/ rgyud phyi ma las gsungs tshul te gsum las/ dang po ni/ de la dang po kho na rlung gi de kho na nyid bstan pa'i tshig rtsa ba'i rgyud la 'jug par bya ste/ sna yi rtse mor yungs kar bsam/ 'gro dang mi 'gro yungs dkar la/ /gsang ba'i sngags kyis brtags pa yi/ /ye shes mchog gi gnas bsgom mo/ /rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa//yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes bya ste/ 'di ni dgongs pas bshad pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'dis srog rtsol gyi yan lag mtha' dag bstan pa yin mod kyi/

rlung gi de kho na nyid sgos su yang cung zad gsal ba dang*/ 'og tu rgyas bshad kyi dang por yang rlung gi de kho na nyid 'byung ba de/ gzhung 'di dag dang bar ma chad par bsgrigs pa'i phyir/ rlung gi de kho na nyid la bshad par dam bca' ba mdzad pa yin no/ /de la sna'i rtse mo ni/ steng sgo kun rdzob kyi sna rtse zhes bya ba gdong gi sna rtse dngos dang*/ gsang ba'i sna rtse zhes bya ba/ rdo rje dang padma'i dbus na gnas pa dbu ma'i yal ga mas sna'i rtse mo dang*/ snying ga'i sna rtse zhes bya ba/ gtso bor snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi rtsa mdud kyi nang yin la/ zhor byung du bstan pa rigs mthun pa nyid kyi phyir/ spyi mgrin lte ba la sogs pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus rnams kyang snying ga'i brdas bstan pa yin no/ /yungs kar zhes bya ba ni rlung gi brda ste/ de yang gdong dang snying ga dang gsang ba'i sna rtse gsum du ldang 'jug gnas gsum gyi mtshan nyid can rlung gi thig le bsam dgos la/ 'gro ba bcud dang mi 'gro ba snod kyi sems can thams cad du snang ba 'byung ba'i gzhi rlung gi thig le la gsang ba'i ye shes sam sngags 'bru gsum gyi brdar 'brel zhing btags pa'i de kho na nyid gsum po de bsgom par bya'o/ /ji ltar bsgom zhe na/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes mchog gi gnas thob pa'i phyir du bsgom pa'o/ /ye shes gnas ni nyams dga' zhes 'don pa ltar na'ang de bzhin no/ /rtsa rgyud kyi tshig 'di la sgron gsal las ni drang nges gnyis kyi bshad pa byas so/ /de bzhin du le'u gsum pa las gsungs pa/ rlung gi rin po che'i 'byung ba lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rigs dang kha dog lnga tshogs pa/ yungs kar gyi 'bru tshod ltar phra ba/ sna'i rtse mo rnam pa gsum gyi nang du dus rtag par nan tan dang ldan pa'i tshul du rlung sngags gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor reg cing rtogs pas rtag tu yang dang yang du bsgom par bya'o/

/dgongs pas bshad pa'o/ /zhes pa ni/ dgongs pa dgongs min gnyis las 'di dgongs bshad yin te/ yungs kar rlung dang sna rtse yang sna rtse gsum du dgongs pas na tshig 'bru ji lta ba ma yin pas so/ /spyod bsdus las/ rgyud tshig 'di la drang nges gnyis kyi bshad pa mdzad cing*/ sgron gsal du tshul bzhi sogs rnam grangs du mas bshad la/ 'dir gzhi rlung gi de nyid dang*/ lam rdor bzlas kho na'i tshul gyis 'chad pa'i phyir/ 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi 'bru gnon rnams 'grel pa de kho na dang bstun pa'i bshad pa byed mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje'i tshig 'di'i bshad pa lha mo bzhis zhus pa zhes bya ba bshad pa'i rgyud las/ snying po las ni snying po mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /gang de thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /de ni lha mo bshad par bya/ /ye shes lnga yi dngos de nyid/ /yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam/ /de yi dbus na gnas pa'i lha/ /mi gsal gsal ba'i bdag nyid can/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ zhes pa ste/ rdo rje'i tshig ces pa ni/ rtogs dka' ba'i phyir rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi tshig go /snga ma de tshig 'dis ji ltar gsal bar byed snyam na/ kha dog lnga ye shes lngar bstan pa dang*/ gsang ba'i ye shes kyis brtags pa dang*/ rin po che'i don mi gsal gsal ba'i bdag nyid can gyi lhar bshad pas ngos 'dzin gsal du song bas yin no/ /de yang zab mo'i don thams cad kyi sbas pa'i don gyi snying po las kyang snying por sbas shing*/ shin tu zab pa'i mchog/'jig rten du che bar grags pa gzhan sus kyang ma shes shing*/ sangs rgyas kho nas mkhyen pas sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang bar 'gyur pa/ rlung ni rang bzhin gang de phung khams skye mched thams cad la khyab pa'i tshul du gnas pa de ni bshad par bya'o/ /lha mo zhes pa ni/ sangs rgyas spyan ma la bod pa'o/ /chos nyid kyi rlung ni 'byung ba lnga'i dngas ma don dam pa gdod ma'i ye shes lngar ngo bor ye nas gnas pa yin la/

de dang lhan cig spyod pa kun rdzob 'od gsal gyi rlung yang khams lnga'i dngas ma rnam shes kyi bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam du byas na lam bden gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes lngar gnas 'gyur zhing*/ gzhi dus nas kyang shin tu gsal zhing rig pa sna tshogs pa 'char ba'i gzhi yin pa dang*/ phra zhing 'dres la rtogs par dka' ba dang*/ rags pa'i khams lnga la srog gi tshul du zhugs pas na/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang ye shes lnga'i ming gis btags so/ /de lta bu'i ye shes lnga'i dngos po ste ngo bo rlung de nyid rnal 'byor pas cung zad lam du byas pa'i tshe/ kun rdzob rags pa'i snang ba 'di rnams re shig rtsa ba nas ma 'gags kyang rags pa'i snang ba 'di cung zad mi gsal bar 'gyur zhing*/ sngar 'dir rags pa'i gseb tu bag la zha ba de/ de skabs gsal bar gyur pas logs su gong bur 'gril ba ltar snang ba dang*/ phra ba'i brda nyid kyi phyir/ yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshod tsam zhes bya'o/ /kun rdzob 'od gsal gyi rlung de'i dbus na gnas pa'i chos nyid dngas ma'i ye shes lnga ni/ don dam pa'i lha ste/ mi gsal ba snod kyi 'jig rten dang gsal ba bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam gnas lugs kyi bdag nyid can no/ /de yang phung khams gzhan rnams kyi khog tu rags pa'i rlung lnga gnas shing*/ de'i dbus na phra ba 'od gsal gyi rlung lnga gnas pa dang*/ de'i dbus na shin tu phra ba chos nyid ye shes lnga gnas so/ /dbus na gnas pa'i go don gnas lugs su yod pa'i don yin gyi/ phyogs kyi chas bsdus pa'i dkyil ni ma yin mod/ 'on kyang kun rdzob tha snyad kyi tshul dang*/ gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi dang*/ rnal 'byor can gyi snang ngo dang bstun nas rtsa 'khor rnams kyi lte ba dang*/ khyad par du snying ga'i rtsa mdud kyi dbus su thig le dkar dmar kha sbyor gyi dbus su 'od gsal gyi rlung gnas so zhes pa'i rnam gzhag tsam ni byed do/

/gsum pa ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las kyang don 'di nyid gsal bar gsungs te/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dbugs/ 'byung ba lnga yis ngo bo nyid/ /gong bu'i gzugs kyis byung nas ni/ /sa yi rtse mor rab tu brtag/rin chen kha don sna lnga pa/ /srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad/ /rang sngags snying gar bsams nas ni/ /srog ni thig ler gnas par bzhag/ces gsungs pa dang*/ zhes pa'o/ /don 'di nyid ces pa gong gi rtsa rgyud kyi tshig la snyeg pa yin gyi/ de ma thag pa'i lha mo bzhes zhus kyi tshig la snyeg pa ma yin no/ /de yang 'phags skor gyi lugs 'di ltar na/ srog gi rtsol ba zhes byar bshad/ ces bcos te/ gong du smos pa ltar/ ye shes te gsal zhing dngas pa khams lnga'i dngas ma lnga po'i rang bzhin gyi dbugs de/ khams 'byung ba lnga rags pa'i rlung thig ler bcas pa dang lhan cig zhu ste/ gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid gong bu ste/ gong bur 'gril pa'i tshul gyis bde ba'i reg bya'am/ yig 'bru thig le phyag mtshan la sogs pa gong bu kha dog dbyibs kyi rnam par yang rung ste/ gzugs zhes pa'i don ni rnam pa'i don te thig le'i reg bya'am gzugs kyi rnam pas/ rdo rje'i lam nas phyung nas padma'i sna rtser rab tu brtag cig bsgoms par bya'o/ /de yang nor bur myong ba lhan skyes kyi bde ba nyid la dmigs pas/ rlung rnams gnas der thim par byed pa dang*/ nor bu'i dbus nyid dam/ thabs shes kyi rtsa phrad mtshams su thig le'i gzugs su bsgoms pas/ rlung thim par byed pa dang*/ shes rab ma'i padma'i sna rtser bsgoms pas de bzhin byed pa ste/ des mtshon nas gsang ba'i 'khor lo dang sked pa sogs kyang zhor la 'phangs pas/ 'dis ni gsang ba'i sna rtser rdzas kyi thig le sgom pa bstan no/ /yang rin chen rlung 'byung ba lnga'i rang bzhin kha dog sna lnga pa de dbu ma'i yas sna dang smin mtshams kyi 'khor lo dag par byed pa'i phyir/

steng kun rdzob kyi sna sgor rgyu ba na/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor nyid kyis srog gi rgyu ba ring du rtsol ba ste/ ring du rgyu bas gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya bar bshad do/ /'dir srog rtsol gyi go ba srog ni rlung rtsol ba ni ring por byed pa ste dbu mar yun ring du gnas pa'i don no/ /'dis ni gdong gi sna rtser 'od kyi thig le sgom pa bstan no/ /de ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'byung gnas 'jug gsum du bzla ba de ni/ rang sngags so zhes sbyar nas/ rang sngags zhes pa tshig gong la ma sbyor bar bshad pa'i lugs bzhin sbyar kyang rung ngo*/ /snying ga chos 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa 'khor lo rnams kyi snying ga ste dbus su yig 'bru thig le la sogs pa'i dmigs pa'i khyad par ram/ bde ba tsam mam/ ches mchog tu gyur pa/ ye shes kyi snang brnyan sogs la bsam zhing bsgoms pas/ srog rlung rnams ni/ mi shigs pa'i thig ler thim zhing gnas par gyur pa la mnyam par 'jog ces pa ste/ 'dis ni snying ga'i sna rtse sngags kyi thig le sgom pa bstan zhing*/ sems rnam par dben pa la sbyor ba'i man ngag ni 'di yin pas/ ngag dben gyi rim pa mthar phyin pa rnams kyis bsgom bya'o/ /'dis ni rtsa rgyud kyi tshig las/ sna rtser yungs dkar dang rin po che sgoms zhes gsungs pa'i sna rtse gang du rin po che'am yungs kar ci lta bu zhig tshul ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul gsal bar byas so/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ sna rtse gsum gyi mtshan nyid ni/ gsang ba snying ga gdong sna'i ming*/ zhes sna rtse gsum dang*/ rlung dang rdzas dang sngags rnams kyi/ thig le gsum ni bla med pa'o/ /zhes thig le'i rnal 'byor gsum po gsal bar bstan te/ 'phros don rgyas bshad mang po yod pa rgyud de nyid du blta'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ rlung gi de kho na nyid rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ sngags dang bzlas pa'i de kho na nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/dang po ni/ rlung rnams kyi kun rdzob kyi gnas thabs gang yin pa dang*/ don dam chos nyid kyi 'jug pa ci yin pa de la/ rlung gi gnas tshul lam de kho na nyid ces bya ste/ de 'dra de rnal 'byor bas go zhing rtogs la dmigs pa'i yul du byed dgos pa'i don no/ /de la spyi don cung zad brjod na/ spyir gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi ni/ gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung*/bkod pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/sems nyid 'od gsal te bzhi po de yin pa las/ rtsa dang thig le'i rnam gzhag 'phags skor gyi gzhung rnams las rgyas par mi 'byung bas/ re zhig 'dir yang rgyas par mi 'chad de/ shes par 'dod na bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba'am/ ma rgyud kyi rgyud gzhung rnams las rtogs par bya ste/ rags rim rnams bdag gis kyang gzhan du gsal bar bshad zin no/ /de yang rtsa bdun khri nyis stong ni rag pa 'khor lo bzhi dang*/ smin mtshams rlung gi 'khor lo 'dab ma drug pa dang*/ mgrin 'og me'i 'khor lo rtsibs gsum pa ste me rlung gi 'khor lo gnyis bsnan pa'i rtsa 'khor lo drug pa ni 'bring po yin la/ ro rkyang dbu ma gsum ni phra ba dang*/ dbu ma'i 'khor lo'i lte ba rnams ni shin tu phra ba'o/ rlung yang sna sgor rgyu ba dang*/ sgul skyod byed pa sogs rags pa/ lus nang du mi g.yo zhing 'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'byung ba lnga'i rlung dang*/ rnam 'gyur rlung bcu rnams dang*/ rnam rtog sna tshogs skyed par byed pa de rnams 'bring po yin la/ snang bzhi'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung phra ba dang*/ khyad par 'od gsal gyi bzhon pa ni shin tu phra ba'o/ sha khrag rus pa nang khrol la sogs pa khams bcu drug gam nyer bzhi la sogs pa ni rags pa yin la/ de rnams kyi rgyu dkar dmar gnyis ni 'bring po yin zhing dbu ma'i nang na gnas pa'i dkar dmar ni phra ba dang*/ de rnams kyi steng na gnas pa ka yin kyang reg thogs med cing*/

bkrag dang mdangs dang 'od kyi tshul du gnas pa ni shin tu phra ba'o/ /las bya byed dang 'brel ba'i dge sdig lung ma bstan rnam rtog sna tshogs pa 'di ni sems rags pa yin la/ yul snang sna tshogs pa 'char ba'i shes pa ni 'bring ba yin zhing*/ nang gi bde gsal nyams sna tshogs pa 'char ba ni phra ba yin pa dang*/ rig stong gi sems nyid nam yang 'gyur ba med pa ni shin tu phra ba'o/ /tha ma 'di ma gtogs gzhan rnams de dag kun rdzob bden pa kho na'i dbang du byas la/ don dam pa'i 'od gsal ni/ phyi ma 'di'i nang tshan du yod de/ rnam pa thams cad pa/ spros pa dang bral ba/ 'gyur ba med cing rang rig pa'i bde ba chen po'o/ /de ltar phra rags spyi ldog nas go bar byas nas/ da ni rlung gi rnam gzhag cung zad brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar yang rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ rnal 'byor bas ni rlung bsgoms na/ myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ zhes rlung la legs par gnad du bsnun pa'i phan yon dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ rlung gi sbyor ba mi shes dang*/ gang zhig shes kyang mi sgom pa/ /de ni sdug bsngal thams cad kyis/ /nyer 'tsho 'khor ba'i srin bur 'gyur/ zhes rlung gi rnal 'byor mi shes pa dang*/ shes kyang ma sgom pa'i nyes dmigs so/ /de ltar na 'dir rlung gi dbye ba dang*/ ming gi rnam grangs dang*/ phye ba so so'i don dang*/ ji ltar rgyu ba'i tshul dang*/ nyams len gyi gnad dang 'brel ba'i tshul te lnga'o/ /dang po ni rlung rnams kyi nyer mkho'i dbye ba ni/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang*/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcu'o/ /gzhan ni rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ rnam rtog brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rta rnams ngos bzung ba'i phyir/ rlung brgya rtsa brgyad du gsungs pa yang*/ rlung bcu'i nang tshan du ni 'dus mod/ spyir rtsa ba'i rlung khams lnga'i rang bzhin dang*/ snang ba bzhi'i bzhon pa'i rlung dngos rnams ni/ rlung bcur mi 'du la/

de dag la srog gi rlung du bshad pa ni/ rlung thams cad la srog gi tha snyad bzhag pa'i skabs kyi gtam tsam yin no/ /des na rang bzhin 'byung ba lnga'i rlung ni/ bzo rgyu gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa khams brgyad spungs pa'i phung po dang 'dra/ 'od gsal gyi rlung ni/ bzo'i bkod pa byed pa po dang 'dra/ snang gsum gyi rlung ni bzo bo dang 'dra/ rlung bcur gyur pa ni/ bzo po de rnams kyis bzo rgyu khams brgyad po de dag bsres shing spel nas/ mi gzugs dang glang po che'i gzugs dang*/ rta'i gzugs sogs sna tshogs btsaus pa dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud dang*/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa las/ rlung bcu po 'di la/ koṭa kṣa la sogs pa'i brdas bstan zhing*/ rdo rje sgo zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ srog 'dzin/ thur sel/ gyen rgyu/ mnyam gnas khyab byed te rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang*/ rgyu ba dang*/ rnam par rgyu ba dang*/ yang dag par rgyu ba dang*/ rab tu rgyu ba dang*/ nges par rgyu ba ste yan lag gi rlung lnga gsungs par bshad la/ dgongs pa lung ston dang*/ bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng pa las/rtsa ba'i rlung de dang 'dra ba las/ yan lag gi rlung lnga la/ klu dang rus sbal rtsangs pa dang*/ lha sbyin dang ni gzhu las rgyal/ zhes pa ltar bshad do/ /gzhan rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ las rlung brgya rtsa brgyad la ming yang so sor gsungs pa sogs mang du yod kyang nyer mkho chung bas re zhig bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ srog 'dzin ni snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor gnas/ byed las tshe gnas shing yid dga' bar byed/ rgyu ba'i lam steng gi sna bug gnyis nas rgyu/ rang dbang can gyi kha dog ni dkar po/ khams ni chu khams gtso che ba'o/ /thur sel ni gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo la gnas/ byed las bshang gci khu ba 'phen sdoms 'dzin pa'i bya ba byed/ rgyu ba'i sgo 'og sgo gnyis yin zhing*/

rlung 'di gsang ba nas steng gi sna rtse'i bar du 'gro ba sogs bshad pa ni/ lus nang du bya ba byed tshul tsam yin no/ kha dog ser po dang sa'i khams so/ /mnyam gnas ni lta ba'i me dang mnyam du gnas pa zhes grags te/ lte ba sprul 'khor na gnas/ byed las zas 'ju ba dang dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i bya ba byed/ rgyu sa rtsa'i sgo phyogs kun tu rgyu/ kha dog sngon po'am nag po dang rlung gi khams so/ /gyen rgyu ni/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor gnas/ byed las smrar ba dang*/ srog 'dzin gyi rlung kha sna nas 'dren pa dang*/ zas mid pa dang*/ sna bug nas khrag 'phen pa sogs kyi bya ba byed/ kha dog dmar po me'i khams so/ khyab byed ni spyir lus thams cad dang*/ khyad par du tshigs sum brgya drug cu la gnas/ byed las sgul bskyod/ brkyang bskum 'gro 'ong sogs byed/ 'chi ba'i tshe steng 'og gi lam gnyis kar nas rgyu/ kha dog shin tu dngas bas mi gsal ba dang nam mkha'i khams so/ kha cig 'di kha dog sngon po dang dkar por yang 'dod de/ dkyil 'khor lnga'i skabs su nam mkha'i khams kyi rlung gi kha dog mi 'chad pa ni shin tu dngas pas/ mi gsal ba'am thams cad 'dres par dgongs par snang ba/ de dang rigs 'dra ba'i phyir ljang khur rung la/ dkar po dang*/ sngon por byed pa mi legs so/ /rlung de dag thams cad 'khor gyi tshul gyis sna sgo nas kyang rgyu la/ de bzhin du bshang sgo dang rtags kyi rtse las kyang ngo*/ /rang dbang du rgyu ba ni kha dang sna las srog dang 'og sgo gnyis nas thur sel ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams phyi rol tu mi rgyu la/ rlung bcu kar yang lus kyi nang du ni/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du rgyu bar rig par bya'o/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba las srog gi rlung ni snying gar gnas/ mi bskyod bye brag rigs las skyes/ /'doms na gnas pa'i thur sel ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bye brag skyes/

/steng du rgyu ba lkog mar gnas/ /'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin no/ /mnyam gnas lte ba'i padmar gnas/ /don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin te/ khyab byed yan lag kun la gnas/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi ngo bo'o/ /zhes pa ni 'byung ba'i khams dang bstun nas rigs lnga'i dag pa mdzad pa yin pas sna sgo nas rgyu ba dkyil 'khor lnga'i rdo rje mgon po sogs dang*/ 'di dag gcig par rlom na ni/ nor tshabs shin tu che ba yin no/ kha dog so sor smos pa ni/ las byed pa'i gtso bo'i dbang du byas kyi/ gzhan thams cad kyang kha dog thams cad 'dres pa yin la/ 'byung ba'i khams kyi rim pa yang de dang 'dra ste/ thams cad kyang shin tu 'dres pa sha stag go /yan lag gi rlung rnams rim pa bzhin du dbang po lnga la gnas pa yin par yang bshad cing*/ yang rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ zla ba'i cha dang snang ba la/ /bsnyen bkur lkog zhal min pa ste/ /rtsa ni lnga yi ming can no/ /rtsa lnga la ni gnas pa'i rlung*/ /klu dang rus sbal rtsangs pa dang*/ /lha sbyin dang ni gzhu las rgyal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zla ba'i cha la sogs pa rtsa lnga las 'byung la rtsa lnga po de ni/ snying ga'i mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi dang*/ bdud 'bral ma las skyes pa'i rtsa gcig yod pa rtsa bdud bral de nyid dang*/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul du shar ba gcig yod de/ rgyud gzhan yang mchod pa'i rtsa lnga 'am/ 'dod yon lnga 'bab pa'i rtsa zhes bshad pa'i de'o/ /de la rgyur zhes bya ba'i rlung gis/ mig shes kyi bzhon pa byas nas rgyu bas mig gi dbang shes la gzugs kyi yul snang 'char ba la dbang byed pa nas/ nges par rgyu ba'i rlung gis lus kyi dbang shes kyi bzhon pa byas nas/ lus shes la reg bya'i snang ba 'char ba la dbang byed pa'i bar du byed la/ de lnga la khyab byed du yid kyi shes pa'i bzhon pa'i rlung yod do/ /de yan lag gi rlung gzhan lnga po la 'dres pa kho na las rang dbang du rgyu ba med pas/

rkang grangs logs su ma bstan pa yin te/ de ni yid kyi dbang po'i ming can snying la gnas bcas nas/ ye shes kyi bzhon pa byas te/ yid la chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs sogs yul rnam pa lnga char gyi snang ba 'char ba la dbang byed pa'i phyir ro/ /snying la khams lnga car gyi dag pa mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de'o/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ snying ga'i dbus na bde ba'i dngos/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma gsal ba'i 'od/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyis kyang*/ /de ni 'od zer bcu gnyis so/ /'od 'phel 'od zer gzi brjid la/ /mig la sogs pa la brtan nas/ /phyi rol gzugs sogs 'dzin pa'o/ /'od zer 'od ma snang ba ma/ /gsal mdzes gsal 'od nyi ma gsal/ /phyi rol gzugs sogs snang ba'o/ /drug po 'di dag 'od du 'dod/ /ces pa 'di rnams tshogs drug yul drug la g.yo ba'i bya ba byed pa/ 'dzin pa'i rlung drug dang*/ tshogs drug la gzugs sogs kyi snang ba tshur 'char bar byed pa drug gzung ba'i rlung drug ces bya ba de dag yin te/ rlung 'od zer bcu gnyis pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gyi rlung bcu gnyis zhes zer na/ yan lag gi rlung lnga dang*/ khyab byed yid kyi rlung ste drug la nang sel gnyis gnyis su phye'o/ /de dag gi 'byung ba'i khams dang rigs ni lha'i dag pas mtshon pa'i phyir rtogs sla la/ kha dog kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /rlung rnam shes kyi rta byed pa'i don ni/ rnam shes nyid gzugs can ma yin pas/ gzugs can dngos su 'dzin pa'i nus pa med pas na/ rnam shes de rlung dang 'dres nas yul la 'gro 'ong gi bya ba thams cad byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /yang rnam grangs kyi sgo nas tha snyad tsam du gzhi dus kyi 'chi ba sogs bskyed pa'i 'od gsal gyi bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ lam dus kyi dpe'i 'od gsal gyi bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ don gyi 'od gsal rtogs byed kyi rlung rnams ngo bo mi gcig kyang*/

dngos po'i rigs gcig ste/ gong du smos pa ltar snying ga'i thig le'i dbus na gnas pa mi shigs pa'i rlung zhes zer ro/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ snying ga'i pad sbubs nam mkha' la/ ye shes rdo rje rtag tu bzhugs/ zhes dang*/ gtso bo chen po mi bskyod pa'i/ /'jig rten khams ni de nyid du/ /der ni rtag tu bzhugs pa'i sa/ /srog gi ye shes ming can te/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ /gzhi dus dang lam dus kyi snang mched thob gsum gyi bzhon pa'i rlung ni/ snga ma las rags pa'i tshul gyis snying ga la sogs pa rtsa 'khor rnams kyi rtsa mdud kyi nang du gnas so/ /rlung de dag ni rlung gzhan thams cad kyi bdag po yin yang*/ gtso bo'am 'khor gyi tshul gang gi sgo nas kyang rung ste phyi rol du ni 'byung 'jug mi byed do/ /rags pa rlung bcu bo de rnams la yang*/ de rnams nyid la bltos pa'i phra rags gsum yod de rnam rtog gi rgyu byed pa las/ rtsa khams la 'dres shig mi 'gul par gnas pa ni phra ba dang*/ gnas so sor g.yo ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i tshul gyis nang gi khams 'phel 'grib kyi rgyu byed pa ni 'bring po dang*/ phyi rol gyi sgor rgyu zhing*/ lus ngag gi bya ba mngon gyur pa rnams dang*/ nad dang*/ rgas pa sogs bskyed pa ni/ rags pa yin zhing*/ rlung bcu rlung lngar bsdu ba'i tshe/ yan lag gi rlung lnga srog 'dzin las gtso bor byung ba'i phyir de'i khongs su bsdu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rlung bcu mngal du 'chags pa yin yang*/ 'byung rngub mi byed la/ mngal nas btsas te rgyu ba'i tshul ni/ nyin zhag gcig la 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la dbugs gcig tu byas pa'i nyis khri chig stong drug brgya re rgyu la/ de la cha bcu gnyis su bgos na/ thun bcu gnyis dang*/ nyi shu rtsa bzhir bgos na thun phyed pa nyer bzhi'o/ /thun phyed re re la rlung dgu brgya pa re re 'byung ba/ 'di la sna sgo nas rgyu ba'i mgon po bzhi pa'i ngos 'dzin gyen rgyu/

mnyam gnas/ srog thur sel bzhi po dgu brgya pa re re rgyu bar 'dod pa ni/ yang dag pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang yod pa ma yin no/ /des na sna sgor rgyu ba'i rlung de dag ni/ re re bzhin rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'am bcu kar 'dres pa yin yang*/ dbang bsgyur pa po dang*/ kha lo byed pa po dang*/ las byed pa'i bdag po ni srog 'dzin yin la/ khams kyang lnga car rtag tu 'dres pa yin yang*/ byed pa po srog 'dzin gyis lus su bya ba me khams la spyod pas 'go bsdu byas pa'i cha nas ni padma'i mgon po dang*/ rlung bcu 'byung ba gzhan gsum la spyod pa yang mgon po gzhan gsum mo/ /'chi ba'i tshe ma gtogs mkha' khams la gtso bor spyod pa med do zhes pa ni gzhung 'di dag gi dgongs pa'o/ /de yang rtsa rgyud las/ 'khor yang khyad par dag tu spro/ zhes pa dkyil 'khor gcig gtso bor rgyu ba na gzhan rnams zhor byung du rgyu'o/ /zhes pa'i don du 'grel pas bshad do/ /de dag ji ltar rgyu ba'i tshul ni/ zhag gcig gi snga dro'i cha dang po la/ me khams kyis gtso byas gzhan gsum gyis 'khor byas nas/ sna bug g.yas kho na nas dgu brgya rgyu ste padma'i mgon po'o/ /de rjes chu rlung gis gtso byas/ gzhan gsum gyis 'khor byas nas/ sna bug g.yas g.yon gnyis ka nas dgu brgya rgyu ste/ rdo rje mgon po'o/ /de rjes rlung khams kyis gtso byas/ gzhan gsum gyis 'khor byas nas/ sna bug g.yon kho na nas dgu brgya rgyu ste/ las kyi mgon po'o/ /de rjes sa khams kyis gtso byas/ gzhan gsum gyis 'khor byas nas/g.yas g.yon gnyis ka nas dgu brgya rgyu ste rin chen mgon po'o/ /de yang chus gtso byas pa'i mnyam rgyu ni/ 'jam zhing dal la/ sas gtso byas na drag la rtsub pa'o/ /gzhi dus su 'chi ba'i dus ma gtogs pa/ dbu mas dbang byas shing dbu ma nas dngos su sna sgor rgyu ba med la/ lam bsgoms na ni yod de/ don phal cher zhig mnyam rgyu shed mtshungs pa kho nar 'byung ngo skad/
