tshogs dkyil gyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang lha'i chas 'jug nges can du byed pa dang*/ mchod pa'i skabs su glu dang rol mo dang stang stabs dang*/ phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan dang*/ brda dang brda'i lan la sogs pa spros pa du ma zhig go rim dang khrigs chags sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas spyod pa ni/ spros bcas kyi spyod pa'o/ /tshogs khang dang gdan la sogs pa'ang ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ lha'i chas su 'jug pa yang ci bde ba las nges pa med pa dang*/ 'dod pa la ci dgar rol pa kho na las/ glu gar la sogs pa'i spyod pa dang cho ga'i nges pa dang khrigs chags spangs pa ni/ spros med kyi spyod pa'o/ /spyod pa de gnyis las/ dang por rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde stong bsgom zhing*/ de'i ngang nas so so'i skabs dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa rnams bskyed/ de nas 'dod yon sna tshogs la rol ba dang*/ yang las rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i lhan skyes kyi bde stong du spros pa thams cad bsdus nas mnyam par 'jog pa gnyis spel zhing bsgom pa yin no/ /spros bcas spros med kyi rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i dngos po ni rtag tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa yin zhing*/ de'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la yang bod rnams phal cher spros bcas la lha grangs dang mnyam pa kho na dang*/ spros med la rgyas bsdus gsum yin no zer yang*/ gnas khang dang*/ cha byad dang yo byad dang bya rtsol dang*/ cho ga'i sgo nas spros bcas spros med sogs su dbye ba yin gyi/ lha mang nyung gi sgo nas dbye ba med pas/ spyod bsdus las spros med kyi skabs gsum du phye ba ni mtshon byed de/ spros bcas la yang de dang 'dra zhing*/ der ma zad lha mang nyung gi dbye ba sna tshogs par 'byung ngo*/ /cho ga spros bcas kyi spyod pa la yang dbye na/ ji skad du/ nyin re 'am zla ba rer 'am/ /de bzhin lo ni re rer yang*/

/ji bzhin cho gas byin brlabs nas/ /sangs rgyas bde mchog gang bya'o/ /zhes nyin rer rtag tu spyod pa dang*/ /zla ba re rer lan re dang*/ /lo re la lan re spyod pa ste/ dus kyi dbye ba gsum yod par bshad do/ /shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ spyod pa de nyid kyi skabs su las kyi phyag rgya spangs pa ste/ de yang lus 'tsho nges pa'i yo byad las gzhan mi dgos pa dang*/ sems kyi snang ba tsam gyi 'dod yon la spyod pa yin na/ de yang rtog pa dang 'brel ba'i yid kyi phyag rgya la rol ba dang*/ rnam rtog med pa sgyu lus kyi phyag rgya la rol zhing dkyil 'khor sprul pa dang 'dod yon la rol ba dang*/ bde ba chen por bsdu ba sogs rim pa rnams gzhan gnyis dang 'dra yang*/ yid kyi rnam rol kho na la shar ba las/ gzhan lus ngag gi bya ba cher med pa dang*/ khyad par gnyid kyi 'od gsal lhag por sgom pa ste/ nyin mtshan rtag tu ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i bde bas 'od gsal gyi gnyid drangs te/ phung khams phra rags thams cad gnyid kyi 'od gsal du bcug nas/ yun ring du 'od gsal bsgoms shing*/ yang ldang pa'i tshe sgyu ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du slob par byed pa'o/ /yang spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron me las ni/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa zla ba drug tu spyad na/ mchog gi dngos grub dang nye ba'i rtags rmi lam gyi mtshan ma la/ rtsa rgyud le'u bco lnga pa drangs shing*/ phra yang gi yon tan brgyad gsungs na/ 'di spyod pa gang gi dbang du byas pa yin zhe na/ kha cig zung 'jug gi yin zer te/ zung 'jug thob nas phra yang gi yon tan brgyad de sdod sgrub dgos pa dang 'bras bu'i yid ches rmi lam gyi rtags la re ba ni bzhad gad kyi gnas yin zhing*/ mchog gi dngos grub ni zung 'jug nyid yin pas de ni shin tu mi 'thad do/ /yang kha cig phra yang brgyad thob pa slob pa'i zung 'jug yin pas/

de'i spyod pa yang 'od gsal gyi rim pa'i skabs de yin no zer te/ slob pa'i zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi skur bshad pa'i don ma rtogs shing skyon snga ma rnams kyang ci rigs pa 'jug go /kha cig phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub pas mchog gi dngos grub ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'o skad na/ 'o na slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sku de/ thun mong gi dngos grub yin nam/ dngos grub ma yin pa zhig/dang po ltar na/ de 'dra de 'jig rten pa su dang thun mongs yin/ gnyis pa ltar na/ slob pa'i zung 'jug thob pa de/ dngos grub thob pa ma yin par 'gyur bas/ grub thob kyi mtshan gzhi rnyed par dka' 'o/ /zhes kyang go bar bya'o/ /des na 'di ni 'phros don gyi tshul du bskyed rim pa gtso bo dang*/ sgyu lus kyi rim pa la gnas pa kha cig kyang ste/ bskyed rim pa'i spyod pa'i 'bras bu/ 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin gnyis phra yang brgyad ldan dngos yin zhing*/ bskyed rim la gnas pa'i gang zag rmi lam gyi ltas las nges shes skyed pa'ang 'thad la/ dngos grub de gnyis kyang mchog la nye ba'i ltas yin te/ de thob nas de yang 'grub par sla ba'i phyir ro/ /sgyu lus thob ma thag nas spyod pa ma spyad kyang*/ sgyu lus kyi rim pa mthar mi phyin pa ma yin la/ de nas 'od gsal gyi rim par 'pho ba la ni spyod pa nges par dgos so/ /de nas zung 'jug sgrub pa la yang med thabs med do/ /de 'dra des sgyu lus kyi rim pa'i skabs su spyod pa ma spyad de/ 'od gsal gyi rim pa sgrub pa nas brtsams te spyod pa spyad na/ nam mthong lam thob pa'i tshe rnam smin gyi lus ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba de ma gtogs/ de gong du rig 'dzin gyi lus su mi 'gyur la/ sgyu lus thob ma thag pas nas spyod pa rtag tu spyad na ni/ sgyu lus kyi rim pa mthar phyin pa dang lhan cig tu phra yang gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i lus su 'gyur ba yang yin no/

/sgyu lus kyi rim pa la gnas pa 'di ni/ rnam smin gyi lus rags pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ de yon tan brgyad ldan du gnas 'gyur ba yang 'os shing*/ gal te thob na legs pa thob pa yang yin la/ rmi lam sgyu lus lhag par bsgom pa'i phyir/ rmi lam gyi ltas 'byung ba yang 'thad pa yin no/ /de ni rdzogs rim la brten nas ched du byas pa mchog bsgrubs pas/ zhor la thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yin la/ de nas 'od gsal gyi spyod pa spyad pas 'jig rten pa'i rig 'dzin gyi lus de yang gnas gyur nas zung 'jug gi skur 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang*/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ grub pa'i khyad par 'ga' dang brtson ldan min yang rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pas lus gzhan nges par bsgyur/ zhes gsungs so/ /'o na rgyud phyi ma las/ mi snang la sogs dngos grub ni/ /tha mal pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid grub sangs rgyas kyis/ /dngos grub mchog ces gsungs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam/ slob pa'i zung 'jug mchog gi dngos grub ga la yin snyam na/ sangs rgyas nyid dang*/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan ces pa ni slob pa'i zung 'jug yan chad kyi spyi ming yin pa go dgos so/ /skabs 'dir yon tan brgyad ni/ /gzugs phra ba dang reg pa yang*/ khyab dang yang dag thob pa nyid/ /rab tu gsal ba nyid bstan pa/ /dbang phyug nyid dang 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la phyis kyi rnams/ shes rab sgron me'i 'grel bshad spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis byas pa khungs su bzhag nas/ sems can gyi 'jig rten skye 'jig byed pas phra ba dang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten skye 'jig byed pas yang ba dang*/ gnyis ka skye 'jig byed pas bdag po ste/ yang dag thob pa'o/ /de rnams rnal 'byor bas sprul pa dang*/ sdud par nus pa'i don yin zer/ gang bsam sar phyin pas gang yang khyab pa/ gzi brjid dpag tu med pas gzhan zil gyi non nas 'byung po kun gyis mchod pa ni rab gsal/

gang thob bar 'dod pa de thob thub pa ni dga' mgur gnas pa ste brtan pa/ tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gyi dbang yod pa ni dbang du gyur pa/ yon tan la 'dod dgur bsgyur ba ni/ 'dod dgur ldan pa ste/ gong ma rnams kyis gzhan du bshad pa ni 'grel bshad 'di ma mthong ba'i skyon no gsung*/ kho bos brtags na ni/ gong ma rnams kyi lugs skyon min zhing*/ 'di nyid skyon yon te 'grel bshad der/ byed pa po 'dod pa'i mu stegs kyi lugs drangs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang la yang thogs med du 'jug pa'i lus ni phra ba dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas bcad pa dang 'jig tu med cing*/ nam mkha' la mnyam par 'gro ba'i phyir yang ba dang*/ lus mang pos yul phyogs mang por gcig car don nus pa'i phyir khyab pa dang*/ snang ba rags pa sgyu ma ltar shar ba'i ting nge 'dzin shugs la 'byung ba'i phyir yang dag thob pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gzhan la ston nus pa'i phyir rab tu snang ba dang 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba med pa'i phyir brtan pa dang*/ skabs bab kyi rang gi 'dod don sgrub pa gzhan la rag ma lus pa'i phyir dbang du gyur pa dang*/ las dang dngos grub mang po bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub pa'i phyir 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'o/ /spyod pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /da ni slob pa'i zung 'jug gi sa bcu'i rnam gzhag mdo tsam bshad par bya ste/ de yang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ de la sa bcu po gang zhe na/ rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i sa dang*/ dri ma med pa zhes bya ba dang*/ 'od byed pa zhes bya ba dang*/ 'od 'phro ba zhes bya ba dang*/ sbyang dka' ba zhes bya ba dang*/ mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ba dang*/ ring du song ba zhes bya ba dang*/ mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba dang*/ legs pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba dang*/ chos kyi sprin zhes bya ba dang*/ sa thams cad don gcig ste 'di ltar ye shes kyi don to/ /ye shes kyang ci yang med pa/

nyon mongs pa med pa/ yi ge med pa/ don yod pa/ gdod ma nas dag pa/ dri ma med pa/ 'od gsal ba/ brjod pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la sa rnams thams cad ye shes yin la/ de yang gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs tshul yin pas/ rtogs bya gnas lugs de ni gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa ci yang med pa/ rang gi ngo bo rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'i 'od gsal ba/ gnas lugs mi 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis rtag tu gnas pas don yod ba/ de nyid la rang ngos nas glo bur gyi dri ma gang gis kyang gos ma myong bas gdod nas dag pa yin la/ de la rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa nyon mongs med pa'i mtshan nyid can gyis de rtogs nas de dang rnam pa mthun par shar ba'i lam gyi ye shes ni/ chos dge ba thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa'i phyir sa zhes bya'o/ /rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid spyi rnams pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs nas bshad pa bzhin yin pas 'dir re zhig ma bshad do/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ zhu bde yongs rdzogs gnas gyur pa'i rang bzhin lhan cig skyes dga' la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir rab tu dga' ba'o/ /de'i steng du rlung dang rnam rtog gi dri ma spangs pa la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir dri ma med pa'o/ /thabs kyi phyogs las rlung rnams gnas gyur pa'i ye shes la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir 'od byed pa'o/ /shes rab phyogs las rlung rnams gnas gyur pa'i ye shes la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir 'od 'phro ba'o/ /dbang po yul bcas kyi rlung gnas gyur ba'i ye shes phyi rol gyi rkyen gang gis kyang thub pa dka' ba la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir spyad dka' ba'o/ /rtsa rnams rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon du gyur pa la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir mngon du gyur pa'o/ /nyon mongs med pa'i snang ba gsum gyi dri ma yang phra mo tsam zhig ma gtogs spangs bas srid pa las thag ring du 'phags pa'i phyir ring du 'phags pa'o/

/sku mi g.yo ba 'pho 'gyur med pa la gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir mi g.yo ba'i sa'o/ /gsung gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mtshungs par legs pa kho nar 'gyur ba'i chos ston pa'i blo gros dang bcas pa'i phyir legs pa'i blo gros so/ /thugs mkha' ltar yangs pa la bde ba chen po'i sprin gyis khyab nas/ shes bya mtha' dag la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi char 'bebs pa'i phyir chos kyi sprin te/ sa phyi ma gsum po 'dir/ snang ba gsum po phra mo de yang dag tshabs shin tu che ba'i rim pa dang bstun nas sku gsung thugs kyi sar bzhag go /re zhig sa bcu pa'i yon tan dang*/ de nyid ye shes kyi sa bcu gnyis su 'jog pa yang rgyud de las/ ji skad du/ gzugs rnams kyi ni mchog gcig pu/ /ting nge 'dzin las dbang sgyur ma/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mchog gtso/ /sa dang pha rol la phyin pa stobs/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa chen po bzhi/ /dbang ni mchog tu 'bar ba dang*/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ /dbang po rnams dang stobs rnams dang*/ /rjes dran drug por gyur pa gang*/ /bsgom par bya bar rab tu gnas/ /de nyid bcom ldan gcig pu ste/ /byang chub yan lag bdun btags pa/ /mtha' gcig yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mchog gi mtshan/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam po che/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad btags pa/ /stobs bcu yi ni bcu pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi bdag nyid gnas/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos chen po/ /rnam par dbye ba sum cu bdun/ / mthar gyi gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug ni/ /dgu la gnas par gyur pa dang*/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po chen po bzhis/ /sems can bsdu bas sdud pa dang*/ /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ /de bzhin bsrung ba mi mnga' bar/ /bskal pa chen po'i mi 'jigs pa/ /mchog tu gyur pa nyid dang ni/ /bsam gtan gzugs med bzhi phrag gnyis/ /tshad med pa yang de bzhin no/ /byang chub kyi ni skyes mchog

gtso/ /bden pa bzhi ni ston pa po/ /nyon mongs can gyi mi mthun phyogs/ /zag bcas zag pa med pa'i mchog/de nyid bcom ldan rnam 'byor te/ /dbang phyug mchog gi dbang phyug dang*/ /skye dgu'i bdag po skye dgu'i mgon/ /mchog gi bdag nyid dbyangs bdag po/ /kun rdzob brjod pa thams cad dang*/ /sgra rnams kyi ni spyod yul 'gyur/ /brjod du med cing spros pa bral/ /stong pa mkha' mnyam mtshungs pa med/ /tshig mtha' sgra yi rnam dgod pa/ /'jig rten tha snyad tshul du rtogs/ /de tshe lus sogs dbye ba yis/ /sa rnams kyi ni yongs su btags/ / sku ni sprul pa nyid du 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa yang dag brnyes/ /rdo rje'i sku dang de bzhin du/ /ye shes sku sogs yongs su btags/ /mtha' yas sku dang sku chen po/ /rin chen sku ni 'od byed pa/ /padma'i sku ni snang ba che/ /thams cad sku ni las bzang byed/ /rtogs par bya ba las kyi sku/ /rnam pa gsum du'ang dbye bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /byang chub sems ni 'od gsal ba/ /kun tu 'od kyi sa chen po/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gzi brjid ldan/ /gnyis pa bdud rtsi'i 'od ces bya/ /zla ba'i 'od ni 'od gsal ba/ / gsum pa nam mkha'i 'od ces bya/ /mkha' bzhin legs par rab tu gnas/ / rdo rje'i 'od mtha' gang zhig sa/ /bzhi pa de ni yid 'ong ba/ /bsam pa brtan pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje zhes ni yongs su bsgrags/ /lnga pa rin chen 'od ces bya/ /dbang bskur bar ni rab tu gnas/ /drug pa padmo 'chang zhes bya/ /pad bzhin rab tu rnam par snang*/ /rang bzhin gyis ni chos nyid dag/bdag gi med cing yongs bzung med/ /bdun pa las kyi sa zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las mdzad pa che/ /brgyad pa dpe med pa zhes bya/ /dpe ni de la yod ma yin/ /dgu pa dpe dang bral zhes bya/ /dpe rnams thams cad rab 'jug pa/ /bcu pa shes rab 'od ces bya/

/sangs rgyas sa ni bla na med/ /bcu gcig kun mkhyen nyid ces bya/ /sa chen po ni 'od gsal ba/ /bcu gnyis so sor bdag rig pa/ / rnal 'byor ye shes yongs rdzogs nyid/ /sa chen po ni 'di dag rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam du/ /sangs rgyas dang ni sangs rgyas chos/ /rnal 'byor ye shes gang brjod pa/ /thams cad nyid ni mtha' yas mchog/chos dbyings mnyam dang mi mnyam pa/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'jig rten tha snyad tshul du rtogs/ zhes pa yan chad sa bcu pa'i yon tan te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad phyogs mtshungs su thob pa'o/ /de tshe zhes pa man chad sa'i dbye ba ston par bzhed de/ sku ni sprul ba dang longs sku gnyis yin la/ de gnyis kar yang sku brgyad du ston te/ de la ye shes kyi sku ni rnam snang*/ mtha' yas pa'i sku ni sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo pho nya phyag brnyan la sogs pa dang*/ sku chen po ni khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /thams cad sku ni khams gsum kun tu chos snang bar byed pa ste/ bzhi po de rnams kyi steng du/ rdo rje rin chen padma las rnams bsnan nas/ sku'i dkyil 'khor brgyad po re re yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dbye ba can yin la/ thugs chos sku ni sku de rnams kyi gnas te sa 'od gsal yin no/ /de la mchod pa dag pas/ ji snyed pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni kun tu 'od kyi sa'o/ /snang ba dag pas bde ba'i bdag nyid kyi phyir bdud rtsi'i 'od do/ /thob pa dag pas spros bral mthar thug pa'i phyir na nam mkha'i 'od do/ /yid 'ong bde ba chen po ste nam yang mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rdo rje'i 'od do/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yang yang dbang bskur ba'i ye shes las yon tan 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i phyir rin chen 'od do/ /'dod chags chen po'i bde bar rang bzhin yin yang bdag gi ba med cing yongs su gzung bas ma gos pas/ padma chus ma gas pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir padma'i 'od do/

/sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las thams cad sgrub pa'i phyir las kyi 'od do/ /rang bzhin dpe gang gis kyang mi mtshon zhing*/ nyams su myong ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ dpe med pa'i sa'o/ /dgu pa dpe dang bral zhes pa 'gyur gyi skyon te/ snga ma dang zlos par gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lhag pa'i don du bshad par bya ste/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i ye shes kyi phyir dpe thams cad kyi sa phyogs re nas mtshon du rung bas na dpe thams cad pa'i sa'o/ /shes bya thams cad kyi chos nyid mkhyen pa'i phyir shes rab 'od kyi sa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis gsal ba mthar thug pa'i 'od gsal rang gi ngo bo ni thams cad mkhyen pa po yin pa'i phyir kun mkhyen gyi sa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad pa de yang gnyis snang gi chos dang bral ba/ 'gal 'dus skyon med du gyur pa de ni gzhan gyis mtshon du med cing rang nyid kho nas rtogs bya yin pa'i phyir rang gis rig pa'i sa'o/ /sa bcu pa'i yon tan 'di dang*/ sa bcu pa nyid las bcu gnyis su phye ba 'di dang*/ sa la gnas pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor brgyad po 'di rnams kyis yar la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug kyang mtshon zhing*/ mar la rab tu dga' ba'i bar du yon tan rjes mthun pa yang shes par nus so/ /rgyud 'di rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis yo ga phyi bar bkral yang rdo rje dkyil 'khor rgyan gyi rgyud las nang par bshad cing 'dus pa la rjes su phyogs pa'o/ /da ni mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi rang bzhin bshad par bya ste/ de yang*/ dgongs pa lung ston las kyang*/ dngos po med pa'i de nyid 'di/ /rten 'byung chos zhes bya ba yin/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa bsdus te 'gyur/ /sprul pa bsam mi khyab chos can/ /zhes chos kyi sku stong pa'i ye shes dang*/ sprul sku rnam pa thams cad pa dang*/ longs sku de gnyis zung 'jug la ngos gzung ste zung 'jug de ni bde chen nyid do/

/yang rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ dngos dang dngos med las grol bde ba'i bdag nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las ni grol bar rtogs/ gnyis dang gnyis med rnam dpyod rang bzhin dang bral blo ni zhi ba'i bdag nyid can/ nyon mongs spyod cing 'jig rten kun rtog dang ni bral ba zhes gsungs pa/ shes dang shes bya'i rnam rtog spangs shing dben pa bden pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ mthar gyur kun khyab zhi ba mchog dang mchog rab de nyid zhi ba bde la stsol*/ zhes gsungs te/ 'dis rang don gzhan don gnyis kar bstan la/ dngos po dngos med gnyis ka ma yin pa dang*/ rang bzhin bde ba chen po dang*/ bden par grub pa yin par gsungs te/ 'di ni bde ba chen po'i sku yin no/ /de bzhin du/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi mar 'di skad ces/ gang du yang dag min zhes bden pa dkar po dge ba'i tshogs rnams rgyal ba rnams kyi chos kyi sku/ chos las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste mtha' dag skad kyi tshogs su'o mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyi ni/ phung po sprul pa'i sku ste mchog tu mi 'gyur ba yi bde ba chos sku ma yin de yi phyir/ sku rnams kyi ni mtshan nyid gang de 'dir ni bde bar gshegs dang 'phags pa klu bos kyis kyang ste/ zhes sku bzhi'i bdag nyid ngos gzung zhing*/ chos sku'i skabs su dkar po dge ba ste yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad kyang bden grub yin par gsungs so/ /sku bzhis bstod pa 'di ni da lta phyogs 'di ni klu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags kyang*/ 'dir bde bar gshegs dang zhes 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' mdo sde'am/ rgyud sde zhig gi nang nas 'byung ba yin no/ /bstod pa de yang 'di ltar/ gang zhig gcig min du ma yang min rang dang gzhan la phan pa phun tshogs chen po'i gzhir gyur pa//dngos med nyid min dngos po ma yin nam mkha' bzhin du ro mnyam rtogs par dka' ba'i rang bzhin can/

/gos pa med cing rnam 'gyur med pa zhi zhing mi mnyam mnyam la khyab par rab tu spros med pa/ /so so rang gis rig bya rgyal ba rnams kyi chos sku dpe med de la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang zhig 'jig rten las 'das bsam gyis mi khyab legs byas brgya yis 'bras bu bdag nyid 'byor pa ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyi dga' ba'i rgyur ni 'khor gyi nang du rnam pa sna tshogs rgyas par ston mdzad cing*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dam pa'i chos sgra rgya chen 'jig rten thams cad du ni rab tu spro mdzad pa/ / longs spyod rdzogs sku 'dir ni chos kyi rgyal srid chen por gnas pa de la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ gang zhig sems can rnams ni smin pa'i slad du 'ga' zhig dag tu me bzhin 'bar bar snang byed cing*/ /gang zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo la lar yang ni slar yang rab tu zhi bar ston/ /srid pa gsum gyi 'jig pa 'phrog pa sna tshogs thabs tshul rnams kyi rnam pa du mar rab 'jug pa/ /thub pa rnams kyi sprul sku don chen phyogs bcu rnams su rjes su son pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum gyi spyod pa las grol nam mkha' mnyam par gnas pa dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ /dag pa zhi zhing rnam par dben la mchog tu zhu ba'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor pa yis rtogs bya nyid/ / rtogs par dka' zhing rnam par dpyad dka' rang dang gzhan la phan pa khyab pa mtshan med rnam rtog dang*/ /bral ba gcig pu'i sku ni rgyal ba rnams kyi mi mnyam mnyam pa bde ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lung 'dren par mdzad de/ da ltar bod kyi dpe la/ klu bos kyis mdzad pa'i sku gsum gyi bstod pa zhes zer zhing*/ sho lo ka phyi ma med la/ phyi ma 'di da lta mdor byas kyi mchod brjod na yod do/ /'on kyang gong du bshad pa ltar rgyal ba'i bka' las 'byung ba/ klu bos kyis logs su phyung ba'i dpe dag pa rnams na bzhi kar yod par gsal bas sku bzhi'i bstod pa yin par bya dgos la/

phyi ma 'di'i don la brtags na/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bde chen gyi bshad pa gsal po mi 'dug pas/ 'di ni mdo lugs nyid kyi dbang du byas pa zhig ste/ des na mdo'i zab don gyi skabs 'ga' zhig du'ang*/ ngo bo nyid sku la bde chen gyi sku'i rnam gzhag byed pa zhig nges par yod snang bas/ ye shes chos sku spros bral gyi ldog cha dang*/ ngo bo nyid sku bde chen gyi mtshan nyid du gzhag pa 'di ngo bo nyid sku spangs pa tsam dang*/ chos sku ye shes rtogs pa'i cha nas 'jog pa'i chos skad kho na rna bar zhen pa'i mtshan nyid pa chen po rnams kyi blo bar ma chud cing chud par mi 'gyur mod/ 'on kyang chen po de dag bag yod pa'i tshul la brten na legs so/ /des na mtshan ma med pa'i chos thugs su chud pas/ rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa'i yon tan dge tshogs kyi gzhir gyur pa/ chos sku dang*/ dge tshogs thams cad kyi rang gzugs phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor par shar zhing*/ gsung chos kyi sgo sna tshogs pa longs sku dang*/ 'gro ba rnams la gang 'dul gyi sku mtha' med par ston pa sprul sku dang*/ ngo bo chos sku de nyid yin kyang*/ mtshan ma med pa'i sgo nas mi mtshon par/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba chen por gyur pa ni ngo bo nyid sku yin na/ theg pa 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i don ni/ chos kyi sku rnam pa thams cad pa dang*/ longs sku la kha sbyor la sogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ gsung chos sgo sna tshogs 'byung ba yang rlung dbu mar thim pa'i sgra yin pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid sku'i bde chen thig le 'gyur med yin pa dang*/ thig le 'gyur med kyi bde ba de sems can kun la khyab cing spro ba'i tshul gyis/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa'i thugs rje ni/ sprul sku'i rtsa bar 'gyur pa'i rnam gzhag rnams bsnan na/ sngags lugs kyi sku bzhi'i rnam gzhag dpyis phyin par 'gyur gyi/

gzhan gnad dang bral ba'i bshad pa mang pos/ nges shes dpyis phyin pa skyed par nus re rkan/ kha cig ni gsang sngags la rang bzo'i blun gtam kho nas blun po'i tshogs pa mgo skor bar byed la/ de dag phal cher stong skad kyi 'ud 'thag pa yin zhing*/ gzhan dag ni/ lag len dang dmigs pa phra mo re mthar thug 'gangs chen po rer bsgom pas zab don nyams smad par byed la/ la la dag ni rtog ge dang*/ mdo lugs kyi gzhung cung zad sbyangs pa'i ltag shed kyis/ gsang sngags rag gar 'chad par zad do/ /'phros tshig go yang dkyus bshad de/ de nyid thugs ye shes rdo rje dang dbye ba med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ yan lag dgu'i chos ston pa dang*/ thabs shes gnyis dang*/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang*/ bden bzhi rtogs pa dang*/ bsdu dngos bzhi dang*/ ye shes lnga dang*/ tshad med bzhi sogs brdas de kho na nyid mtshon par mdzad pa yin zhing*/ stong nyid bcu drug la brten nas snang ba gsum sbyangs bas/ yang dag pa'i dbyings shes rab kyis rtogs pa dang*/ gang du yang mi gnas pa'i ye shes mkha' mnyam gcig tu 'dres pa dang*/ chos nyid dang*/ mkhyen pa ngo bo gcig tu bsre ba la sogs pa/ thabs de rnams kyis yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i zung 'jug mthar thug de sgrub dgos pa yin no/ /zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir dpal gsang ba 'dus par thugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa gsungs pa de nyid nges pa'i don du bkral ba ni/ dpal dgongs pa lung ston zhes bya ba bshad pa'i rgyud las/ 'di skad ces gsungs te/ de nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog/rdo rje ye shes rab 'dra ba/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bshad par bya/ /'di ni dgu yi bdag nyid mchog/legs bsgril de bzhin nyid ston pa'o/ /sna tshogs lung gi brdar gyur pa/ /tshad ma bzang por de bshad do/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag/gnyis su med pa mdzes pa yin/

/shes rab 'di ni thig yin te/ / thabs ni de ye rjes 'jug pa'o/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa mchog/shes rab thabs kyi thig gcig gis/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis pa/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi ngos bzhi ste/ / tshangs pa'i gnas gzhi grwa bzhi yin/ /bsdu ba'i dngos bsgrags sgo yin te/ /re re'ang bzhi yi mig can no/ /chos kyi de nyid don gyi brda/ /'khor lo'i nang gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /mi phyed ye shes mtshan nyid de/ /rdo rje and+ra nī la'i rgya/ /rnam pa lnga ru phye ste bshad/ /rtse mo 'khor ba 'jig byed pa'o/ /shar gnas me long gzugs nyid ni/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i 'od kyis brgyan/ /lho ru mnyam nyid ye shes ni/ /rtse mo dgu pa'i rin chen te/ /nub tu so sor rtog padma/ /padma rā ga'i 'od 'dra ba/ /byang du mchog gi sems gang yin/ /'gro ba'i rnam rtog 'joms byed pa/ /bya ba sgrub pa ral grir gyur/ /'od zer 'bar ba 'dra ba'i mdog/ sprin sngon dang ni mnyams pa'i 'od/ /shar lhor byams pa'ang spyan yin te/ /lho nub snying rje zhes bya ba/ /mā ma kī yi rig rdo rje/ /nub byang sdong bu dang bcas pa'i/ /padma dga' bas yang dag gnas/ /byang shar utpal 'od zer ni/ /sngo dang bcas pa btang snyoms yin/ /de bzhin shar sgor sbyin pa ni/ /tho ba mdangs ldan 'od dang bcas/ /de bzhin snyan smra zhes grags pa/ /dbyig pa 'od bzang rdo rje 'bar/ /nub tu don spyod ces bya ba/ /rta mgrin gyi ni padma'o/ / don mthun pa ni rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje 'khyil pa rdo rje can/ /phyag rgya dgod pa'i mtshan nyid de/ legs par bshad pa 'di yin no/ /ji bzhin yang dag gnas mchod pa/ /rnam gsum bsgom pas 'gyur ba yin/ /dang por chen po yod pa yi/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor yin par bshad/ /nang la sogs pa'i dbye ba yi/ /stong nyid kyis lo bcu drug pa/

/ma skyes pa yi zhi ba gang*/ /de ni bud med ces byar bshad/ /zhi ba'i chos dang rjes ldan pa/ /mdangs bzang 'od ni yin par gsungs/ /rten 'brel bag chags dri yin te/ /ye shes kha bye me tog go / dngos po med pa rigs yin te/ /kun mkhyen ye shes dbus nyid do/ /chos dbyings nyid kyi bud med ni/ /shes rab 'di 'dras mnyes par bya/ /nang na ma yin phyi na min/ /gnyis kar ma yin gzhan gnas min/ /gnas med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor gyur/ /de bas mā ma kīr bshad do/ /de yi ngo bo nyid gcig pa/ /byin gyis brlabs zhes de bshad do/ /nam mkha' dang ni gcig tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas zhi ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /de bas yul du rnam brtags pa/ /sdud pa dag ni bshad pa yi/ /ye shes dbang po stong pa gcin/ /rnam dag chos nyid khu ba yin/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes khrag/gang zhig chos su yongs brtags pa/ de nyid lha rnams zhes bya ste/ /dngos med pa ni dbul ba'o/ /de byas sangs rgyas rgyal sras rnams/ khyad par du ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /zhes mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi yon tan dang*/ /slob pa'i zung 'jug la brten nas/ /mi slob pa'i zung 'jug sgrub tshul rnams rgyas par gsungs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du ind+ra bhu ti'i ye shes grub pa las kyang*/ /ji srid mi gnas nam mkha' ni/ khyab cing mtshan nyid rnams dang bral/ /'di ni don dam de nyid de/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med yin/ /kun tu bzang po zhes bshad cing*/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes kyang bya/ 'di ni chos sku zhes bya ste/ /me long ye shes zhes kyang bya/ /ji ltar gzugs brnyan le long la/ /rang nyid nges par snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin chos dbyings ye shes ni/ /snang bas me long zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes dang*/ /rang gi rang bzhin 'gro ba'i yang*/ /dngos nyid gcig par thugs chud pas/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes bya'o/ /gdod nas dag cing skye ba med/

/rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes pas/ /so sor rtog pa can zhes bshad/ /kun tu kun nas sangs rgyas kyis/ /mdzad pa thams cad la 'jug pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mdzad gcig pas/ /bya ba grub pa zhes bshad do/ /gang tshe nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib/ /thams cad las grol de yi tshe/ /rnal 'byor pa mchod rdo rje can/ shin tu rnam dag ces bshad do/ /ji ltar gdul bya'i chos rnams dang*/ 'dod yon kun las sangs rgyas rnams/ /thams cad longs spyod gcig pas na/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'dod do/ /mtshan rnams kun dang yang dag ldan/ /sna tshogs sku ste mtshan nyid med/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa bas/ /sprul pa'i skur ni bshad pa yin/ /phyag rgya chen por rab 'grub phyir/ /shes nas rnal 'byor pa des bsgom/ /kun rtog thams cad rnams spangs nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen zhes bshad par bya/ /grub ste du ma'i rgyud rnams su/ /dal 'byor mchog rnams la bstan te/ /mngal byung rim pa gang yin dang*/ zhing dang zhing du so sor rdul/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni/ /der ni yang dag brtul zhugs 'dzin/ / gzhon nu'i rol pa thams cad dang*/ /de bzhin bzo gnas yang dag bstan/ / btsun mo'i 'khor las mngon byung zhing*/ /bdud rnams 'dul bar mdzad nyid dang*/ /lha yul nas ni 'bab pa dang*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /mya ngan 'das chen yang dag ston/ /gang yang rol pa gzhan thams cad/ /thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin las/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu spros/ /'dir ni sngon chad ma byung med/ /sngon gnas pa ni sbyar mi bya/ /de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad pa ni/ /thams cad rdo rje'i dngos zhi ba/ /dus gsum lam gyi mthar thug pa/ / thams cad de bzhin blta bar bya/ /ngag gi spyod yul kun las 'das/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rnam spangs pa/

/sangs rgyas nyid kun ster ba po/ /rnal 'byor 'di 'dra bsam par bya/ /sa kun las ni rnam grol zhing*/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam spangs pa/ grub pa bzhin du rnam par bsgom/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes sku gsum bstan pa las/ /chos sku'i nang tshan ye shes lnga yin par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang sku gsung thugs gsum dkon mchog gsum dang*/ de nyid snang ba gsum dag pa dang*/ sku gsum yin pa dang*/ rtsa gsum dag pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi chos nyid dang*/ yi ge gsum gyi mtshon don yang yin te/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ /dri med sems ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ chos ni ngag tu yang dag gsungs/ /sku ni dge 'dun zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi gnas/ /sangs rgyas yi ge hūṃ du bshad/ /gsung ni yi ge āḥru brjod/ /dge 'dun zhes bya yi ge oṃ/ /kun nas 'phro ba'i bdag nyid do/ /sangs rgyas a wa dhu tir 'gyur/ /chos kyang la la nā ru brjod/ /dge 'dun ra sa nā ru brjod/ / 'di ni gsum po'i mtshan nyid do/ /gzugs med khams ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gzugs kyi khams ni chos dang ni/ /'dod khams de bzhin dge 'dun te/ /de ltar khams gsum mtshan nyid mchog/snying por gyur pa rang srog las/ khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /sgyu ma rlung gi khams gsum pa/ /rmi lam rmi lam bzhin du mthong*/ khams gsum bdag nyid de bzhin nyid/ /gcig pur myur bar mthong bar 'gyur/ /byin gyi brlabs nas de bzhin nyid/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /dam pa'i chos ni chos kyi sku/ /dge 'dun sprul pa'i skur ni 'gyur/ /de ni sku gsum bdag nyid can/ /snang ba sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs/ /chos ni snang ba thob pa'o/ /dge 'dun snang ba mched par 'gyur/ /de ni snang ba gsum mtshan nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa zhes pa bya ste/

/ji skad du/ sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /ci 'dod bskyed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes slob pa dang mi slob pa'i zung 'jug la thun mong du dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ / gsum pa gzhung mthar phyin pa'i bya ba ni/ /mchog gyur rim pa lnga po 'di/ /bshad las bsod nams gang thob pas/ /zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /'di yis 'jig rten pha rol shog/ces pa ste/ dpe 'ga' zhig las rim pa lnga pa 'di zhes zung 'jug gi gzhung kho na sbyor ba yang snang mod/ rang lugs ni thun mong gi dge ba bsngo ba yin no/ /de yang lam thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje theg pa'i rdzogs rim gyi lam rim pa lnga po 'di gsal bar bshad pa las/ klu sgrub bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa des/ 'jig rten 'khor ba pa rnams zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa'i stobs las pha rol 'am mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog cig/ces pa'o/ zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa ste rim pa lnga pa'o/ /zhes pa ni le'u'i ming ngo*/ /rdzogs so zhes pa ni yang dag par rtogs pa ste/ don thams cad tshang ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ / 'phags pas mdzad pa'i rdzogs tshul rim pa lnga/ lam lnga sbyang phyir bla ma'i bkas bsgyur bas/ sgrib pa lnga bral mngon shes lnga thob ste/ sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan sangs rgyas shog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsarya shraddhā ka ra barma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsa ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /slad kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang*/ yul dbus kyi dpe dang yang gtugs te gtan la phabs pa'o/ /zhes pa ni/ lo tsa ba'i 'gyur gyi smon lam dang*/ 'gyur byang yin te bla ma'i bkas/

zhais pa ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi bkas bskul ba'o/ /rim lnga lam lnga sgrib pa lnga mngon shes lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga zhes 'byung ba ni/ lnga tshan lnga tshan brjod tshul mthun par sbyar ba'i sgo nas tshig mdzes pa bskyed pa'i phyir yin no/ 'dir smras pa/ rgyud rgyal kun gyi gsang ba de nyid rnam lnga po/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /shin tu rtogs dka' rdo rje'i tshig ldan 'phags pa'i gsung*/ zab cing rgya che'i gzhung 'di shin tu gsal bar bkral lo/ /'di las dge ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /srid gsum khongs su spyod pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /mchog tu bde zhing myur ba'i tshul nyid du/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan go 'phang thob par shog/ces dpal rim pa lnga zhes bya ba'i gzhung gi rgya cher bshad pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po shākya mchog ldan gyi gdan sa pa/ dge bshes shākya bstan 'dzin gyis snga mo nas yang yang bskul ba dang*/ gzhan yang bar skabs su dge bshes du mas bskul ba dang*/ nye bar chos rjes ye shes rgya mtsho ba'i drung gis nan tan du bskul par mdzad pas rkyen byas shing*/ rang nyid kyang rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ dgongs 'grel gyi gsung rab zab mo 'di la lhag par mos shing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi ngal ba cung zad byas pa'i rjes gzhan la ston pa dang*/ gzhung lugs 'di la brten nas zab don mang po go bas/ gzhung 'di la sku drin bsab pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad gsal la 'dus pa mtha' chod par sbyar ba ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo zhe drug pa la gangs ri'i khrod kyi shambha lar bris pa'o/ /e ma ho/ chos skor 'di la brten pa'i rgya gar gyi gzhung 'grel 'gyur ba thams cad dang*/ bod kyi nag tsho dang*/ 'gos dang*/ mar pa dang*/ chag lo sogs lugs rnying pa thams cad dang*/ bu ston lugs dang*/ dge lugs dang*/

bo dong pa dang*/ gzhan yang rong ston dang*/ rtses thang pa gzhon nu dpal la sogs pa phyis kyis bshad pa gsar pa yang mang du mthong*/ rgya bod kyi man ngag phal cher yang thos/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyi nges pa la brten nas rtogs dgos pas/ rgyud gzhan gyi zab don mang po mthong thos la brten nas kyang 'di'i gnad mang du go /gsang sngags kyi zab don dpyis phyin pa shes pa la gzhung 'di mi shes kha med du 'dug cing*/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnams kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa go bar byed pa la yang 'di shes na shin tu khyad che ba yod/ rnam bshad 'dis gzhung 'di gcig pur ma zad/ spyod bsdus sgron me'i don gal che chad kyang bshad la/ las mtha' rnam 'byed dang*/ bdag byin brlab pa sogs gzhung phran rnams kyang dpyis phyin par go nus pa yod pas/ lugs 'di'i rdzogs rim 'chad pa la kun 'dus gcig chog yin par sems shing*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po nges don gyi bang mdzod chen po'i sgo lcags 'byed pa'i lde mig bla na med pa yang yin no/ khyad par gzhung 'di la nag po dam tshig rdo rje dang*/ /brtson 'grus bzang po dang*/ kha che la kṣiṃ dang*/ a bha yā ka ra dang thub pa dpal bzang po dang*/ skal ldan grags pa'i 'grel chung dang*/ klu byang la kha 'phangs pa'i 'grel chen nor bu'i phreng ba sogs rgya 'grel du grags pa mang po yod kyang*/ rgyud don dpyis phyin pa rang dkon par snang zhing*/ bod rnying pa rnams kyi yig sna mang du snang ba'ang de dag dang 'dra la/ bod du phyis rim lnga'i 'khrid yig dang*/ spyi don mtha' chod kyi bshad pa mang du byung yang*/ gzhung 'di la 'bru ṭīka gsal po byed mkhan ma byung bas/ lugs 'di'i srol ka 'dzin pa dag cig phyi ma'i dus 'dir 'byung srid na shin tu phan par yod do/ /gzhung 'di'i rim pa dang po ni lung khungs smos pa dang*/ ma smos pa'i sgo nas rgyud kyi lung bsdus pa kho nar snang la/

gzhan yang rim pa gsum pa'i me long gi gzugs brnyan dang sogs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshig yin pa dang*/ rim pa bzhi pa'i 'od gsal gyi gsol gdab dang*/ dbus min 'byung ba'am dbus su 'byung zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ rim pa lnga pa'i 'khor 'das zung 'jug la sogs pa tshigs bcad gsum bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las 'byung ba sogs te/ don gyis na rdo rje'i tshig bsdus pa lta bur snang la/ dngos bstan go bde bde 'dra ba mang po zhig kyang don gyi gting blangs na/ shin tu zab cing rtogs dka' bar yod pas 'bru gnon til tsam gyis don mi mthong bar rtogs nas/ khog don mtha' gcod kyi tshul ci rigs pa dang bcas te bshad pa yin no/ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa thams cad kyi rab dang phul dang mchog ni gzhung 'di yin te/ ārya de bas mdzad pa'i gzhung thams cad kyi yang mthar thug ni spyod bsdus so/ /klu sgrub kyi tshogs gsum gyi bstan bcos dang*/ ārya de ba'i bzhi brgya pa sogs mdo lugs nyag gcig yin pas/ de dag las gzhung 'di rnams theg pa mtho dman gyi khyad par yod par ma zad lam rim ston tshul gyi sgo nas kyang khyad che ste/ de dag las pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rim bsdus pa las ma bstan la/ 'di dag tu ni sngags kyi lam rim rgyas par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa yang smras so/ / gcig zhus dag/rgyud sde'i nges gsang 'byed pa rim pa lnga'i/ gzhung gzang rnam par bshad pa zab don mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang chen dgongs pa bris dang brkos/ dge bas zung 'jug go 'phang myur thob shog/ //bkra shis/ /'dir smras pa/ don dam chos sku 'khor 'das kun khyab dbyings/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang rgyal kun thugs/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sku dang zhing gi mgon/ /de las khyad par gsang ba 'dus par gus/ /gsang 'dus rgyud don klu sgrub yab sras kyis bral gdams ngag nyams len mdzad pa

bzhin/ /'gos lo rngog pa yab sras mar pa sogs kyis de ltar legs par bral ba rnams/ /rjes su phan tshun 'dres pa gzu lum 'ga' yi gleg bam gsor bzhag dag /dgag bsgrub g.ye bsal byas te khyad 'phags bsgrub thabs tā ra nā thas mdzad/ /nyams su len tshul bstan bcos khyad 'phags gangs ljongs spyi nor mchog/nam yang 'dzad med chu bo'i rgyun la 'gran pa'i thabs mchog 'di/ /gcig las du ma 'phel ba'i 'phrul 'degs legs pa'i gzhi nyid du/ / chos sbyin mdzad med spar gzhi'i phyi mo gsar ba legs par bskrun/ /'di byas las byung rnam dkar bsod nams 'di/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs smon chu klung dang*/ gcig tu 'dres nas sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho cher/ /yongs babs ngo bor ro gcig 'dres gyur cig/gu ṇa bha ṭas gcig stong dgu brgya go brgyad zla tshes la/ /gsang 'dus sgrub thabs 'bar ba'i 'od gsal spar gzhi legs bskrun 'dis/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe brtan zhing mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur khyab/ /dge 'dun sde rgyas 'dul khrims gtsang ma'i gzhi bzung byang sems dang*/ /gsang sngags rgyal bstan nam yang 'char nub bral zhing sra brtan gnas/ /skal ldan skye 'gro yongs kyi bgo skal 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ / der brten rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i nyams rtogs dga' ston la brten nas/ /ye gzhugs gsang 'dus sgrib gnyis las grol ji bzhin mngon gyur shog/sbyin bdag 'brel ba che chung gang yod dang*/ /pha ma'i thog drangs mkha' khyab sems can kun/ /zab chos 'di dang 'brel rnams gsang gsum bral/ /'di phyir bde zhing sku bzhi legs thob shog/rten 'di gang na bzhugs pa'i yul khams su/ / dus bzhi bsnyom zhing lo phyug rtag tu 'phel/ /nad mug 'thab rtsod bral zhing phan tshun byams/ /'gro kun rtag tu chos la spyod par shog/ //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rim lnga'i 'grel chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 106--PAGE 107--PAGE 1-
